Had an incredible meal at Hala Turkish Restaurant in London. I ordered the Hala Signature Platter and was absolutely blown away — the meats were grilled to perfection, bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. The selection of cold appetizers complemented the main perfectly and added a refreshing balance to the meal.

A special shoutout to Ferman, our server, who elevated the entire experience. His professionalism, attentiveness, and warm hospitality made our visit unforgettable. You can truly feel the pride he takes in his service.

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for authentic Turkish cuisine paired with top-notch service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

venues.name: Ishtar
venues.description: Charcoal-grilled skewers, modern & traditional Turkish dishes, plus live music & belly dancing.

reviews.text: What a night. Me and my sister wanted to celebrate our birthday 🎂🎉🎈at this restaurant. Glad we picked this restaurant 😁! From the beginning our waiter Niko made sure we were served all our food ( including our birthday cake) he was very lovely. The atmosphere was amazing. They had a belly dancer, cabaret act and an amazing DJ. Would 100% come back.  I would recommend this restaurant. The birthday cake tasted absolutely amazing 🤩!

We recently dined at Ishtar and had a pleasant overall experience. I had reserved a table for myself and two friends over the phone. Upon arrival, we were greeted warmly by a lovely waitress, which set a positive tone for the evening. We were served complimentary bread and hummus, the hummus, in particular, was delicious.

For our mains, we ordered Incik, a Mixed Grill, and sides of Jasmine Rice. The food was full of flavour, I especially enjoyed the Chicken Kofta, which was the highlight of the meal for me. We also ordered drinks including green and red mocktails, as well as still water.

To finish, we tried a few desserts.. Chocolate Cake, Firinda Sutlac, and Künefe. The desserts were decent, not overly impressive but certainly nothing to complain about.

The atmosphere was quite nice and added to the overall experience. However, one minor drawback was the lack of attentiveness from the staff after our mains were served. No one came over to check if we needed anything further or if we were ready for desserts, so we had to call someone over and wait.

Despite this small issue, I was overall satisfied with the visit. I’d recommend trying Ishtar at least once, it’s not necessarily an everyday restaurant, but definitely worth a visit. Best wishes to the team!

Lovely service, not too pushy, food was great. Maybe I would like to see more Turkish traditional food. I was hoping for Imam Bayildi but it wasn't on the menu. Nonetheless I enjoyed it and would be back.

venues.name: MASA TURKISH RESTAURANT
venues.description: MASA TURKISH RESTAURANT is a turkish restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, MASA TURKISH RESTAURANT provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine turkish flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.vicinity: One Fine Deli, 617 Fulham Rd., London

reviews.text: Highly recommend Masa. The food was wonderful, the people were so friendly and welcoming and the place was beautiful. Also everything was reasonably priced and big portions.

This restaurant is just recently opened may be couple of weeks ago.Since it has been opened,This is my 3rd time to come and try them.

Let me start with their menu;This is traditional Turkish cuisine however with loads of choices which is not many other Turkish restaurants have.This is one of the important detail that makes them privileged.They use fresh ingredients and daily preparation is taken place.
They are you experts what they are doing

I was lucky and had a chance to talk to owner and chef.
Owner has been in this industry more then 40 years which shows the outcome anyway from the location,taste to ambiance as well as the service.He is also fantastic chef as he also prepared something special to me by himself.
He is really very down to earth and very friendly
Also very funny guy.
I really loved the way he runs the business and also hosting his guests in his restaurant.

I also talked to the main chef  as he was standing behind the open kitchen.He is very approachable.He has been industry around 35 years.He said he used to work in hotel industry and was preparing variety of dishes for around 2000 people in one go and this was just for one round and everday.This is something incredible and beyond the admiration.I did all my best to try everything on the menu and even chef’s specials.They were soo delicious.

Plus,waiters are so lovely there.They are prompt,quick,responsible,smiley and friendly.
They really know what they are doing.
I admire them.

Quality wise from a to z is that this restaurant can be one of the top 3 not just in London also all across the UK.
They deserve the best and it is a must at least to be visited once in a life time.

Highly highly recommended
The most attentive and amazing staff, ambience and incredible food. We absolutely love this restaurant, live music( but not too loud) and the wine and food is incredible. It’s a must for all foodies!

venues.image_alt: MASA TURKISH RESTAURANT — turkish restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Kazan Restaurant
venues.description: Contemporary takes on Ottoman-influenced dishes in smart dining room with traditional touches.
venues.address: 93-94 Wilton Rd, Pimlico, London SW1V 1DW, UK

reviews.text:
Really good, eat here!

Amazing food, large selection. Staff were exceptionally professional and welcoming. We were a group of 8 with no reservation and they handled our visit perfectly.

Impressive representation of traditional Ottoman cuisine. They haven't changed in quality over the years. Red meat dishes - hünkar beğendi and şiş kebab are impressive.

The treats they've brought tasted excellent - ezme salad and olives!!🫒

Pretty good employee retainment as well. Great job overall.

I was around Victoria are so decided to give this restaurant a try. We were seated straight away upon entering the restaurant. Menu given and drinks order taken.

The restaurant has good decor and it felt nice and calm. There were a lot of tourists which is no surprise due to the location of the restaurant.

I ordered lychee sparking mojito. It was awful. It had no sparkle I'm afraid. Anyway the sparkling water was great.

They gave complimentary warm bread with some sauces. That is standard across all Turkish Cuisine.

Food itself was OK. The chicken was good. The fries were fantastic. Unfortunately the lamb was very salty.

Service was OK but could be better.

venues.name: Liman Restaurant
venues.description: Mediterranean specialties dished up in an understated destination with a warm vibe.

reviews.text: I’ve been here twice for lunch — and it’s honestly out of this world! Such a cozy, welcoming atmosphere, and the staff is incredibly friendly. The food is absolutely amazing: you must try the meatballs and the chicken kebab — they’re perfection. And their fish was fresh and beautifully cooked. This is one of those places you just keep coming back to 🙌Highly recommend!

Absolutely fantastic! The lamb chops were the best lamb I’ve ever had. Succulent and cooked perfectly. The hummus starter with crispy pitta was beautiful too, and the service was brilliant. Couldn’t recommend any higher! I asked for some more sauce for the lamb because it was absolutely beautiful. Gizem was a super helpful waitress!

What a great find! I recently had dinner here and was thoroughly impressed. I kicked things off with the calamari, and let me tell you, it was a home run. It was perfectly crispy and flavorful, and they certainly don't skimp on the portion. The real star of the show, though, was the lamb shank. It was cooked to perfection—so tender it practically melted off the bone. On top of all that, the service was top-notch. The staff were on the ball, always checking in and more than happy to help with anything we needed. Highly recommend!

venues.image_alt: Liman Restaurant — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Tower Mangal
venues.description: Informal restaurant offering generous Turkish dishes & teas, plus a take-out option.
venues.address: 55-57 Tower Bridge Rd, London SE1 4TL, UK

reviews.text: Great experience here! We’ve got a family with some picky eaters and everyone LOVED their food here!!! Everything was so good and the service was fantastic as well! 12/10 recommend!

This is honestly one of the best kebab places you can find in London. Whether you come with a group of friends or on your own, you’ll feel welcome and comfortable here. You can choose to grab a takeaway if you’re in a hurry, or sit down and enjoy the food in a relaxed atmosphere. The meat wrap is absolutely delicious – tender, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic and satisfying kebabs.

Arrived around 10:45pm, the staff was kind and did not hesitate to seat us right away. We ordered hummus as a starter and the tower 1 for 2 people. The amount and quality of food was astonishing! We received a plate stacked with meats and rice and veggies— all delicious! My favorite was the chicken wings as they were both flavorful and crispy. I didn’t enjoy the beef or goat too much as it was a bit too gamey for me but other people in my party enjoyed it. The hummus portion was a bit small but it was 10/10 with the bread that was served alongside. The salad and dipping sauces were tangy and very enjoyable. We were able to eat our food as the staff closed up around us and we left by 11:30pm just because we didn’t want to stay too long as they were closing— they were still taking walk in wrap orders as we left. Overall, the staff was welcoming and kind and the meal was delicious. Would recommend but maybe come a few hours before closing as the area is a bit sketchy at night.

venues.name: Güneş Restaurant
venues.description: Polished locale with outdoor seating offering classic Turkish entrees, kebabs & mezes.

reviews.text:
Very good and tasty food. Well presented and good quality food at good prices. The service was very good and friendly. Special mentioned for Mr Ali who is very knowledgeable and smiling with good services. Surely will come back again. Highly recommended.

Easily accessible by Tube and few minutes walking to restaurants.

Excellent service and delicious food! We’ve visited a couple of times and it never disappoints. The vegetarian options are fantastic, and the meat dishes are equally tasty. Portions are generous, making it great value for money

We visited Gunes Turkish Restaurant and had a great experience. We tried their menemen and lunch deal, and the breakfast items were full of flavour. The lamb donner was perfectly seasoned, and the halloumi was especially delicious. They also offered a complimentary salad, which was a thoughtful and appreciated gesture.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and always on hand, creating a welcoming atmosphere. While the prices are mid-range, the quality of food and overall experience made it well worth it. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Turkish flavours.

venues.name: BEST TURKISH RESTAURANT
venues.description: BEST TURKISH RESTAURANT is a turkish restaurant located in London. With a 4.4-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, BEST TURKISH RESTAURANT provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine turkish flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 483 Green Lanes, Harringay Ladder, London N4 1AJ, UK

reviews.text: As someone who used to work at this restaurant, I can say that the staff are definitely very rude and the environment is not clean at all — I do not recommend it.
A great deal of nice meat and some lovely salads and dips.
Quality food, can’t go wrong with this place. Kid friendly great service. Price for Turkish food has hit the roof nowadays.

venues.name: ANA Turkish Restaurant and Bar
venues.description: ANA Turkish Restaurant and Bar is a turkish restaurant located in London. With a 4.9-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, ANA Turkish Restaurant and Bar provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine turkish flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 263 Old Brompton Rd, London SW5 9JA, UK

reviews.text:
As a big fan of Middle Eastern cuisine, I can confidently say Turkish cuisine holds a special place in my heart, and this restaurant delivered wonderfully on that front. The food and quantity were amazing every cold meze we tried had a great balance of flavors, though I personally found the salt to be a pinch more than my preference. Nonetheless, well done to the chef for putting together such a delightful spread.

The atmosphere was decent not over the top, and not in your face, just right for a comfortable meal.

Service wise, it was fast and efficient, which I appreciate. However, there’s a difference between being served and feeling welcomed. While the male server was warm and smiling, the female server seemed like she was simply going through the motions, without much warmth or hospitality. These little touches make a difference, especially in an otherwise empty restaurant. Still, overall, the experience was great, and I’d happily come back for the food.

We had a fantastic experience at Ana Turkish Restaurant in Kensington! From the moment we walked in, we felt warmly welcomed. Our server Moh was absolutely wonderful – friendly, attentive, and genuinely kind. He made us feel at home and looked after us throughout the meal with such grace.

The food was incredibly tasty and truly authentic – every dish was full of flavour and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into the cooking. Whether you’re a fan of Turkish cuisine or trying it for the first time, this place will not disappoint!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for delicious food, great service, and a lovely atmosphere. Thank you, Moh, and the Ana team – we’ll definitely be back!

What a find! A truly delicious experience. The food is so well cooked, beautifully seasoned with such a freshness that is hard to beat. We had the best time here and the service was outstanding. Highly recommended.

venues.image_alt: ANA Turkish Restaurant and Bar — turkish restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Selale Restaurant
venues.description: Bright, simple dining room with tiled floors, for traditional menu of Turkish kebabs and meze.
venues.address: 1-2-3, Salisbury Promenade, Green Lanes, Harringay Ladder, London N8 0RX, UK
venues.vicinity: 1-2-3, Salisbury Promenade, The Coliseum, Green Lanes, London

reviews.text:
Door-to-door kindness and service, just like being hosted by a Turkish family.

The warm and competent service started right at the entrance, and there was never a “no” to any of my requests.

I ordered the Turkish breakfast, which is world-famous and often rated as the best breakfast in the world.
I truly enjoyed the traditional spread with sucuk, olives, different kinds of cheese, börek, and more — and of course, unlimited Turkish tea.

I can highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to experience genuine Turkish hospitality and delicious food.

Great job, guys 👌

Upon entering till leaving Selale the customer service has just been exceptional, the servers are friendly, warm and welcoming.

The Selale special platter was delicious and enjoyable.

The only thing I found strange was the price of the chips and soft drinks, very high in price for something that was not exclusive nor special. However that would not stop me from coming back haha.

At the end of our dinner me and my family were served Turkish tea and baklava on the house and the baklava was just delectable! Absolutely tasty it was.

I would recommend this place, family friendly, kid friendly and a relaxing atmosphere.

Thank you for your exceptional service Selale.

Excellent food and beautiful restaurant. The mix meze and fresh orange juice were unreal.  Our meal was topped off with the amazing service we received from Ahmet. We only needed to lift our heads away from our plates and he was there making sure we was happy. The complimentary Turkish tea and baklava at the end was the cherry on top. Can’t wait to go back!

venues.name: Lokma Westfield
venues.description: Lokma Westfield is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.4-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Lokma Westfield provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 105 - 106 Westfield Shopping Centre The Street, London E20 1EN, UK
venues.vicinity: 105 - 106 Westfield Shopping Centre The Street, London

reviews.text: I had my birthday dinner here yesterday and was amazed with the service. The food was amazing - tasted lovely and the portions were really big for the price. Aida was so helpful and attentive and made sure everyone was satisfied at the dinner. She really made me feel more at ease. Another waiter played a game with us at the beginning which was a nice way to get us having fun.

Went here for a catch up with a friend and the atmosphere was really nice. The shisha was pretty standard, even though we went for a premium flavour—and at £45 it felt quite pricey for what it was.

We also ordered 3 starters, 2 drinks (hot chocolate + latte) and a pitcher jug, and the bill came to over £100, which felt super expensive considering we didn’t get that much. On top of that, they only accept cash, which was a bit annoying. Service was okay, nothing special, but overall the vibe of the place was nice 😊

Definitely my favourite Turkish in London. Would highly recommend.

I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve been here over the years, with groups of 2 to 10+, and it has always been consistently good. Went here the other day on a lovely, warm, sunny day and sat in the outdoor area - felt like I was enjoying an al-fresco dining experience abroad. Lovely relaxed atmosphere.

Massive portions and the food is full of flavour and the meat/ chicken was tender and moist and always cooked to perfection and the chilli sauce is amazing. The kunefa is the show stopper though, and probably better than those I’ve had in Istanbul - there’s not many Turkish restaurants that sell it so I was so glad to find out that they do a few years ago - is the main reason I come here tbh - it’s cooked fresh and not heated up out of a box, it’s just the perfect dessert to end the meal.

Staff are friendly and polite and the service is excellent. Reasonably priced for what you’re getting compared to other places in a prime location.

venues.image_alt: Lokma Westfield — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Yeni
venues.description: Elevated, seasonal sharing plates & natural wines served in an industrial-chic Turkish venue.
venues.address: 55 Beak St, Carnaby, London W1F 9SH, UK

reviews.text: Phenomenal time and food. My partner and I had the tasting menu to share, and what a memory it was. I am blown away by the kofte and scallops, lamb and dumpling. When I say these dishes evoked a smile from within, I mean it. We are both of Middle Eastern descent with refine palettes and we appreciate flavour, quality and execution when enjoying a culinary experience. I’m actually shocked that food can be this amazing. We want to come back before we’ve even left! Thank you for feeding, hosting and giving us an opportunity to enjoy an amazing date with insane food.

starters and dumplings were very tasty! main courses were a bit underwhelming. the main course of my friend took ages to come result to us finishing with our food and still waiting, so she got it for takeaway. When we try to cancel it waiter was insisting to bring it and we heard no apology.

Yeni is an absolute gem. Every dish we had was a creative masterpiece — modern, bold, and beautifully executed. The chef’s take on Turkish cuisine is imaginative and unforgettable, with each bite bursting with flavour.

The mantı is a must — truly the best thing I’ve ever tasted. It’s not just food, it’s art.

Service was fantastic too — warm, attentive, and welcoming.

Highly, highly recommended. If you love food that surprises and delights, Yeni should be at the top of your list.

venues.name: Bursa Restaurant
venues.description: Bursa Restaurant is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.1-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Bursa Restaurant provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 1 Connaught St, Tyburnia, London W2 2BH, UK

attributions: Green Sea Shells Mag: Wellness by KK

reviews.text:
I want to start by saying Ali and Hanim provided us excellent customer service. They frequently checked on us and were engaging and nice to talk with. We enjoyed the opportunity to practice speaking Turkish with Hanim and learning new words. Thank you Ali and Hanim for a wonderful dining experience!

My friend and I ordered lentil soup, tabbouleh, grilled halloumi, chips, hot mezze platter (burger kibbeh and sucuk substituted with beans and potatoes), Turkish tea and for dessert I ordered Turkish maras ice cream. Ali gave us marinated olives to try.

The marinated olives, food and sauces were very flavorful and perfect temperature, the exception being the grilled halloumi. The grilled halloumi seemed dried out (the reason for 4 stars rating for food).

For dessert I was sold on the Turkish maras ice cream as soon as Ali told me it was pistachio, I love pistachios and this ice cream was really good. Be warned, the texture of Turkish maras ice cream is different but the flavor is very good. Also, disregard the tea glass in my photo, my/our Turkish tea refills were provided in traditional Turkish cup and saucer.

We were so excited about our food we started eating before I took pictures🤭. The same is true for the Turkish maras cream. That’s the reason the photos do not have full platters/bowls.

The interior decor is very nice, well designed, it feels inviting and relaxing.

reviews.author_name: Green Sea Shells Mag: Wellness by KK
reviews.text:
Had a vegetarian ‘mezze’ lunch at Bursa, near Marble Arch and not far from Mayfair. The space is large and comfortable.

The hummus was decent, the baba ghanoush smoky, and the ezme had a good kick — though I thought it would be even better with walnuts, which are sometimes used in the dish. The foul was fine but came in a very large portion, more than expected for one plate, and we ended up leaving half. The lentil soup arrived unseasoned but was fine once we added seasoning at the table. The bread was warm and paired well with the dips.

Bursa describes its menu as Anatolian cuisine — a broad regional style from mainland Turkey known for meze, soups, flatbreads, and hearty, rustic dishes. That’s reflected here, though in this case the flavors felt more solid than standout.

Service was uneven — water only arrived at the end of the meal, and there was some confusion around payment despite the restaurant not being busy.

Overall, Bursa offers a straightforward take on Anatolian staples.

We tried the İskender, the mixed platter, and the chicken wrap at Bursa Kebab House, and everything was absolutely delicious. Each dish was prepared with great care and full of flavor. Hanım took excellent care of us, and we enjoyed plenty of Turkish tea. The attention to detail made us feel truly special. We will definitely be coming back to this restaurant. Even the gyro, made with ground meat, was wonderfully tasty.

venues.name: Lokkanta
venues.description: Relaxed restaurant for a menu of Turkish meze and barbecue on wooden tables in a simple space.

reviews.text: This restaurant was a hidden gem! The food was so good I completely forgot to take pictures at the start, I’ve been to a lot of Turkish restaurants but this one was full of flavour, cleanliness and perfect hospitality. You won’t feel heavy after eating the food, it’s so fulfilling and cooked really well. Will definitely come again.
I really like this small Turkish resturent. The food is so yummy

Absolutely delicious meals on reasonable prices considering the aria. Everything we ordered tasted very authentic and in-house made. I would definitely be coming back to try other things from their menu.
We ordered the felafel meal and the chicken grill meal, with couple of vegetarian starters. Everything was superb.

venues.name: Diyarbakir Kitchen
venues.description: Turkish comfort classics prepared on a charcoal grill with lots of natural light & bright interiors.
venues.address: 52-53 Grand Parade, Green Lanes, Harringay Ladder, London N4 1AG, UK

reviews.text: Diyarbakir Kitchen exceeded all expectations, we were greeted with genuine warmth and hospitality that instantly made us feel at home. The staff are exceptional: attentive without being intrusive, friendly, and clearly passionate about what they do. The food absolutely phenomenal. The lamb ribs were the highlight: tender, smoky, and bursting with flavour. Cooked to perfection, they practically melted off the bone. Every dish we tried was fresh, beautifully presented, and deeply satisfying. The portions are generous you won’t leave hunger and the prices are more than fair for the quality and quantity you receive. The menu ofers a rich variety of authentic Turkish and Kurdish dishes, and everything feels crafted with care. The bread was warm and fluffy, the salads crisp and refreshing, and the grilled meats full of depth and spice. You can taste tradition in every bite. The atmosfere is relaxed yet vibrant, perfect for both casual dinners and special occasions. Clean, spacious, and welcoming. Highly recomended for anyone who loves bold flavours, hearty portions, and top service. Diyarbakir Kitchen isn’t just a restaurant it’s an experience.

Ordered the big platter for 3 to share. Could easily feed six people though.

Food was absolutely delicious. Juicy and well prepared.

Fantastic service - they act as though they are genuinely happy for your custom and make you feel very welcome.

Check this place out in Green Lanes.

Wow! Nothing more to say!

Just go and try this place, trust me!

One of the best Turkish food I have ever had in London, the quality of the meats and the flavours were just 10/10

Complimentary salad, bread and Turkish tea with rice pudding dessert at the end was the cherry on the cake.

Restaurant was clean, modern and top customer service.

This is now my favourite Turkish spot, I will definitely return and will definitely recommend to everyone to try it.

venues.name: Istanbul Cafe & Bistro
venues.description: Modest restaurant with tiled floors and terrace, for traditional Turkish kebab, grill and meze menu.
venues.address: Great Portland Street Tube Station, London W1W 5PW, UK
venues.vicinity: Great Portland Street Tube Station, London

reviews.text: My wife and I came here, we ordered the lamb meals. I forgot exactly what they are called, but they were really good. The meat is incredibly tender. In fact, this was probably the best lb meat I have ever had. I definitely recommend. The inside has some great ambiance too. The bathrooms are nice also.

I visited last Saturday with my dear friends. I can't thank the staff enough for accomodating my dietary requirements. The Chef made a special dish just for me , which was really tasty! I appreciate the effort, kindness & understanding they had about my medical condition I suffer.Definitely will return again in the future! Thank you so so much guys 😊

I went to this place a few times last few weeks on my trips to Harley street. It’s a very well
Located place. Gorgeous food lovely people. The service is amazing. I wish I asked the name of the lady that gave me halwa on the house. It was absolutely delicious ! It’s a little hidden gem if you have not tried it. Am a vegetarian and have so much choice. My friend and husband loved the meat too. Highly recommend it :)

venues.name: Midpoint Restaurant
venues.description: A menu featuring classic Turkish cuisine & drinks in modern, rustic setting with hanging plants.
venues.address: 3, Anchor Iron Wharf, Ballast Quay, London SE10 9GL, UK
venues.vicinity: 3, Anchor Iron Wharf, Ballast Quay, London

reviews.text:
We visited a Turkish restaurant by the Thames in Greenwich. The food was very tasty, and the portion sizes were just right. The presentation was nice, and everything was fresh and well-cooked. The staff were friendly and gave great service.

We had our meal in the garden. It was beautiful and peaceful. There are special flowers in every season, and everything is very well cared for. We asked the owner, and he said his father takes care of the garden as a hobby. It was a lovely experience.

The restaurant has a nice view on the river as you approach it, the staff is friendly, quick and helpful. They have great portion sizes. I ordered the mixed kebab and sigama boregi which where all very lush, I like that the borek came with some chilli jam and the salad that came w the kebab had pomegranata which was refreshing. Cocktails are great too here, not too strong but also not a faint taste. Honestly, no complaints and I'd 100% return here.

This place is set in a lovely location by the river. The decor is appealing and the seating is well planned. All staff are immaculately dressed. Went with some friends and we ordered the Turkish breakfast. The waiter took time to listen to our orders and requirements. The food didn’t take too long to come and was presented beautifully. The only thing that I would say could be improved were the eggs. I asked for runny yolks, not snotty, but they came overcooked. That’s the only thing I would say needed improvement. Nice low level of music in the background so you don’t have to talk loudly at all. Overall, a lovely experience.

venues.name: Brasserie Zedel
venues.description: Grand French art deco restaurant with classic brasserie dishes and choucroutes in 1930s building.
venues.vicinity: Twenty Air Street, 20 Sherwood St, London

reviews.text:
After being swept away by the glitz and glamour of Moulin Rouge the musical, we had a dinner booking at the Brasserie Zédel, a perfect match to the show. While waiting for our reservation, we had drinks in their bar, Bar Americain, which was an experience in itself, moody lighting, classic cocktails, and a vibe that whispered old-school elegance. It was the ideal spot to decompress and relive our favorite moments from the show.

Once seated in the brasserie, the atmosphere shifted into full Parisian charm. The grand Art Deco dining room is stunning, like stepping into 1930s Paris. The menu was classic French fare, with comforting favourites. Everything we ordered was delicious and beautifully plated, and the service was warm and friendly.

Brasserie Zédel isn’t just a meal, it really is an experience. Whether you’re coming from the theatre or just looking for a slice of timeless sophistication in the heart of London, it’s a place that delivers on ambiance, flavor, and charm.

We came here for dinner, and had a great time.

Although reservations are not necessary, I would really recommend doing so at least 1 hour in advance.
The food tasted fantastic, and there was a large selection of individual dishes and set menus.
The service was also very good. The staff members were really friendly and helpful at all stages, and even provided us with slightly modified dishes without an allergen.
The atmosphere is also great. Although the entrance is in a medium-sized cafe, the restaurant itself is located in a massive basement.

Overall, the place was pricey, but a very nice experience.

A really great dining experience. I chose the starter, main, and dessert preset menu. Everything I had was amazing but I really enjoyed the pea and mint soup. The staff was professional and hospitable. If you have the opportunity to experience a meal here do not pass it up. I went for lunch and there was a really nice band to provide entertainment. The band wasn’t too loud and you were able to have an easy conversation at the table as well.

venues.image_alt: Brasserie Zedel — french restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Riviera
venues.description: Riviera is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Riviera provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 23 St James's St, London SW1A 1HA, UK

reviews.text: Celebrated my birthday at Riviera on Saturday. It was absolutely amazing! Our waitress Gayu was so lovely and her attention to detail was impeccable. She made the most amazing martini and she also made me feel really special. My seabass was delicious and myself and my guest loved this restaurant. Also to mention the decor is stunning!!! I highly recommend riviera!

I celebrated my birthday at Riviera and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. A special thank you to Omar, who went above and beyond with his impeccable service. He was professional, attentive, and made the evening feel extra special. Truly a memorable experience, highly recommend Riviera!

An absolutely exceptional fine dining experience from start to finish. Every detail, from the ambiance to the presentation of each dish, was flawless.

A special thanks goes to Omar, who elevated the evening even further with his outstanding service. He was attentive without being intrusive, knowledgeable and ensured every moment of our dining experience felt special. His warm professionalism made us feel truly valued as guests.

Without a doubt, one of the finest dining experiences I’ve had in London— highly recommended for anyone seeking excellence in both cuisine and service.

venues.name: Bouchon Racine
venues.description: Bouchon Racine is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Bouchon Racine provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: Upstairs, 66 Cowcross St, London EC1M 6BP, UK

reviews.text: Beautiful setting. Staff couldn’t be more helpful. We thought the mustard in our ham and celeriac starter & the rabbit was just too overpowering. The terrine and steak were excellent though. Great wine recommendations from the staff paired perfectly with our food and the dessert she recommended was our favourite dish of the night.

Came here for a birthday dinner with my partner, and the experience was truly exceptional!

The food was absolutely delicious, where the calf brain stood out as an especially memorable dish. The snails, lamb, and pheasant were all super delicious.

On top of that, the serving was absolutely excellent, where the waiter was incredibly helpful, friendly, and nice.

It was such an enjoyable experience that we booked in our next visit for my birthday dinner before we left.

Very highly recommend place, and I would argue it is the best place to eat in the area!

Had a wonderful experience at this restaurant!
Everything was delicious — each dish was prepared with great care and full of flavour.
The atmosphere was top-notch — cozy, stylish, and very welcoming.
Service was excellent — friendly and attentive staff.
I really enjoyed it! 💫

venues.image_alt: Bouchon Racine — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: La Palombe Kensington
venues.description: La Palombe Kensington is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.9-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, La Palombe Kensington provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 267 Kensington High St, London W8 6NA, UK
venues.vicinity: Leonard Court, 267 Kensington High St, London

reviews.text: Don't have enough good things to say about this place, the food, the team, the atmosphere.  I had my birthday here and I can't imagine going anywhere else where literally everyone (with a lot of foodies) couldn't stop having about the food, combined with being so very well looked after by James and his outstanding team.  Every dish was perfection, great wines, outstanding service and wonderful people.  Thank you for making my birthday so special Palombe.  I hope I've helped send a few more loyal customers your way :).  I was having too much fun to take pictures of the delicious food on my birthday, but have plenty from our anniversary we also chose to celebrate here!

I absolutely love this restaurant. I’m sure this isn’t my first review, and it certainly won’t be my last. They update the menu quite often, but every dish I’ve tried has been excellent. It’s become my favourite restaurant in London. The prices feel very reasonable, especially given the quality of both the service and the food — well deserved.

We went here to celebrate our anniversary and had an amazing experience. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the cocktails were amazing.

The venison croquettes were delicious. We had the octopus and duck leg for entrées, then venison and pork belly for mains – all were exceptional and full of flavour. Even the side of fries was the best we have ever had.

The chef even surprised us with a special treat at the end. Highly recommend – incredible food, excellent drinks, and wonderful service!

venues.name: 64 Goodge Street
venues.description: 64 Goodge Street is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, 64 Goodge Street provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.vicinity: 64 Goodge Street, Greater, 64 Goodge St, London

reviews.text: Well presented and delicious food at a price. I had the pleasure of watching the chefs working from my seat which added to my experience. The waiters are quick and efficient and they serve half bottles of wine in carafes which is a bonus.

I’m surprised this place has a Michelin star. The set menu was hit or miss. First course (duck and quail) was better than main course (pork and venison). The appetizers (snail and frog lollipop) and side dishes (pomme something) were extra costs, as tiny as the bouche amusee, not flavorful at all, and very greasy. The desserts were regular size and actually quite good. Drinks were okay…my sparkling wine had a tiny serving as well. Overall, would not recommend…for this price, you can get much better food elsewhere.

I recently celebrated my mum's birthday at this wonderful restaurant, and it was an experience to remember! From the moment we arrived, we were greeted warmly and shown to a our table.

The food was absolutely delicious. Each dish was bursting with flavour, and you could really tell that everything was made with care and quality ingredients. We enjoyed a variety of appetizers, mains, and desserts, and each course was better than the last. We have tried the snail bon bons, frog's leg lollipops, petite gougeres, smoked eel, quail forestiere, saddle of rabbit and the veal. For dessert we had the Rhubarb vacherin and Paris Brest. Everything was 10/10!

The service was impeccable. The staff were attentive, friendly, and really went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed. It was clear they were genuinely focused on providing an exceptional experience.

What’s even more amazing is that I’ve been to this restaurant before, back in 2023 when they first opened, and even then, the food was absolutely amazing. It’s incredible to see how they’ve maintained such high standards and consistently delivered a fantastic dining experience. They definitely deserve their michelin star!

All in all, it was a fantastic experience, and I couldn’t have asked for a better setting to celebrate my mum's special day. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for spectacular food and top-notch service!

venues.name: L'Escargot Restaurant
venues.description: London's oldest French restaurant offering fine-dining classics in a grand Georgian townhouse.

reviews.text:
L’Escargot – London

We chose L’Escargot for dinner after learning it was one of Princess Diana’s favorite restaurants, and my wife insisted we try it. Our group of five had a 7 pm reservation.

Service: The staff was warm and friendly. Even though the restaurant wasn’t very busy that evening, service was on the slower side—something to keep in mind if you’re used to the faster pace of American dining.

Food:
•	Appetizers: The French onion soup was one of the best we’ve ever had—rich, flavorful, and perfectly comforting. The seafood lobster soup was creamy and indulgent. And of course, the escargot was excellent—the butter and green pesto sauce made it a standout.
•	Mains: The smoked haddock was not our favorite—it came in a heavy cheese-based preparation that wasn’t clearly described on the menu. On the other hand, the lamb was tender, flavorful, and highly recommended.
•	Dessert: If you plan to order a soufflé, do it early—it takes at least 30 minutes to prepare, but it’s worth the wait.

Extra Tip: Don’t miss the charming live piano bar upstairs—just follow the staircase after dinner for a lovely way to end the evening.

Overall, L’Escargot offers a classic French dining experience with standout starters and a touch of royal history. Perfect for a special night out in London.

This restaurant is always keeping in my pocket and go to enjoy the authentic French cuisine when I visit London. Although they not provide big variety of food, that’s enough for me. Great value on the meal set and the menu will be changed time by time. Price is reasonable in city centre and the service is attentive and professional. Remember to enjoy other glass of drinks with friends on their bar on top of the same building.
P.S. booking through open table which will have special steak+ champagne set offer.

We had the 3 course set menu for £28 each, which was fantastic value. The quality of the French onion soup, the fresh bread and the lemon tart were outstanding. The additional champagne offer of a whole bottle for £48 made it incredible value.

venues.image_alt: L'Escargot Restaurant — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Galvin La Chapelle
venues.description: Galvin La Chapelle's little sister, next-door to the gourmet spot, with a French/Italian cafe menu.

reviews.text:
I came here for dinner by myself.

Overall, this place has a Bailie, unique and magical ambience. The interior of an old chapel is one of the more unique and charming Settings for a restaurant that I have ever seen.

I will say that my expectations were very high, as a place has Michelin  star. Overall, the Service was very good, but not extraordinary. The food was excellent, but again – I was not as impressed with the food as I would have expected – I feel the food that I got at sketch. Two nights ago was much more, outstanding, and culinary. Perfect and unique.

Overall, I would be unlikely to return at the Price point, but it is a quality restaurant, and I do feel that it is deserving of it status.

Loved my experience here for a romantic date. The place itself is truly a vibe, I was mesmerised by the sheer size of the architecture. Our server was amazing and so attentive. We went for the tasting menu and it was so decadent and perde for the start of autumn. We loved everything but the desserts, they weren’t particularly outstanding.

We had dinner at Galvin La Chapelle and it was excellent. For a Michelin Star, the price for the summer special was very affordable. The dishes were all excellent. If you are starving, it might not have been quite enough food but it was all very tasty for a great price.

The service was also excellent here - warm and inviting.

venues.image_alt: Galvin La Chapelle — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Chez Bruce
venues.description: High-end Modern French dining, fine wines and an extensive cheese board in a simply decorated space.

reviews.text: Very impressed with the place. We tried a few dishes, and they were all very well executed. Special mention to the sea bass, which came with a beautifully balanced buttery and acidic sauce — very, very nice. The bread and focaccia were excellent as well. Everything was good, including the desserts. The restaurant's reputation is well deserved. I’d also add that, for what it is, lunch offers decent value. You could spend around £80–£100 per head, and I’d say that’s definitely fair for the level of food.

Incredible lunch! Not only the food was insanely delicious, but also the service was impeccable. Everyone is so nice, genuine and welcoming. Not wondering why the restaurant is there since a long time! The care of the team in every single detail is second to none. Favourite restaurant ever!

I was looking forward to try this place! As is a classic in the area, however I was bit disappointed. Yes the food is good, but I have tried better food in places that has no Michelin star, I was pretty shocked. I was expecting better quality of food, prettier platting and just tastier, that is what you would expect in a place with 1 star. I wouldn't recommend it at all!

venues.image_alt: Chez Bruce — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Maison François
venues.description: Upmarket bistro offering classic French cuisine in a chic setting, plus a basement wine bar.
venues.address: 34 Duke Street St James's, London SW1Y 6DF, UK

reviews.text:
For full transparency, I have dined here many times for lunch and dinner and also had a birthday party in the private dining room too.
Today was my first experience of their afternoon tea at the bargain price of £25 during August 2025. I have tried pretty much every place in London for afternoon tea so would say I know what I like and what's good value.

The staff as always were knowledgable, friendly and attentive.

In August, this is a great value for a new offering especially if you're new to trying out afternoon tea and don't want to fork out £100+ per person in London.

Limited range of teas, which isn't a bad thing, sometimes having a long menu can be somewhat perplexing. They had the usual stars, Earl Grey, English Breakfast and Darjeeling etc. The only one that was missing for me was Assam.

The servings are generous - 5 finger sandwiches. The best one was the vadouvan chicken, the worst one was the rilletes de thon (tuna sandwich), which in my opinion has no place in afternoon tea!
Of the patisserie the chocolate and peanut slice was the champion in this category, think a luxourious snickers. I could have easily eaten three of these.

Now what really differentiates MF's afternoon tea from others is that instead of scones (my least favourite part) is that they serve two warm babkas which are superb. Soft like a cloud and served with homemade strawberry jam, hazelnut spread and clotted cream.

Harry asked for my thoughts on the offering which I gave willingly.  I suggested they add their cabbage with achoiade in a petit pan instead of some of the finger sandwiches or a shot of the french onion soup.

Definitely worth a visit.

A bit overpriced but as expected given its superior  location. Quality of food was good overall, not the most extraordinary but still we enjoyed everything especially the onion soup! Added onion soup to my “to cook” list right afterwards. Staff is not rude for sure but I don’t remember feeling particularly welcomed so a solid 4 instead of 5.

Absolutely beautiful experience from start to finish. Great service particularly from the manageress going above and beyond. The food was outstanding — the steak tartare and gougères are must-tries, and the oysters were fresh and top quality. Venue itself is stunning too. Highly recommend.

venues.image_alt: Maison François — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Chez Antoinette Victoria
venues.description: Traditional French restaurant offering breakfast & all-day dining amid a retro-style interior.

reviews.text:
My family is visiting London from the USA and we stopped here for a Friday breakfast! What a pleasant choice!! We all loved everything we got. I personally ordered the Hollandaise Poached Egg with Ham, a side of Alsace Bacon, and the French Breakfast Mariage Frere tea! Everything was lovely!!!

The Poached Egg was phenomenal and tasty, and the Hollandaise was delicious. It was the perfect horton size. The bacon was my favorite bacon I’ve had in London so far, and the tea was the perfect breakfast choice!

Not to mention, the atmosphere and decor was beautiful! My family continued to rave about how lovely the music was, the pretty inside and outside seating, and the presentation of everything! It was all lovely and we would all dine here again!

P.S. I also tried my sister’s banana and nutella waffle and that was delicious too! She has a health issue that allows her to usually only eat small portions and she feels nauseous when she eats, but she ate at least 2/3 of the waffle and loved it!

Cute place with friendly staff. The food was good, as well as selection of drinks. They have gluten-free options. I just would not order again the gluten-free bread and butter. It's just toast. Otherwise we were happy with everything else we ordered and can definitely recommend a good spot for lunch.

We enjoyed our first visit so much we came back here for our last dinner in London. Excellent menu for casual brasserie that can be good for single business, couples or family.  Atmosphere is very warm and “feels like” France.   Cocktails were well made - great wine list and again food was quite good.  Cannot wait to go again where I’m in London again.

venues.name: La Trompette
venues.description: High-end Modern French food with charcuterie and foie gras dishes in stylish contemporary space.
venues.address: 3-7 Devonshire Rd, Chiswick, London W4 2EU, UK

reviews.text:
We had such a fantastic experience here! For starters, we ordered the scallop lobster bisque ravioli and the foie gras chicken liver pâté, and both were exceptional. The ravioli had a generous amount of lobster, and the bisque was perfect – rich and flavourful without that bitter aftertaste you sometimes get. The pâté was unbelievably soft and smooth, one of the best we’ve had. (No photos of these dishes as we absolutely devoured them 😂)

For mains, we chose the beef and the pork cheek. Again, both dishes were outstanding - the pork was succulent, and the beef was tender and full of flavour. I especially loved the sweetcorn with the beef; it was such a lovely touch.

For dessert, we had the chocolate salted caramel délice and the banana soufflé. My husband is a big salted caramel fan, so he was in heaven with the délice, while I much preferred the banana soufflé. It was light, not too eggy, and beautifully done - I especially loved the crispy bits in the soufflé. It came with a very sharp passionfruit sorbet, which at first felt a little mismatched, but it ended up being oddly addictive and I ended up enjoying them separately.

Excuse my bad photos, which were a bit of an afterthought – I promise everything looked even better in real life!

Food was nice. Service was basic; serving each course without much description, but the menu had captured the key ingredients (I usually took pictures of the menu so that I could refer back to). I was expecting something more exciting from a Michellin star restaurant at this price tag for 3 courses. Rather low value for money in a very competitive F&B scene in London in general. Dessert was too sweet and tasted artificial for my liking.

the experience was great overall, it is located in a very quiet neighbourhood in west London. When we were there, the majority of the customers inside were people who were above 50 yrs old. But the food was good. Standard high end restaurant quality.

venues.image_alt: La Trompette — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Le Relais de Venise L'Entrecote | Marylebone
venues.description: French restaurant, part of petite chain, serving set menu of salad, steak and fries plus dessert.

reviews.text: Enjoyed my first time experience at this popular restaurant. Waited for one hour for an early dinner. Arrived at 5.40pm before opening - there was already a large queue however it went fairly quickly considering. Security on hand to ensure everything ran smoothly. Guests were buying drinks at the restaurant bar next door which was nice (if that’s your thing whilst waiting). We were served by some lovely ladies who were organised - food came out quickly and we didn’t feel rushed. Nice authentic French brassiere feel. Loud but you can still hear each other. Chose medium for the meat which was nicely pink. Enjoyed the desserts too, not too sweet. If you’d like to get in early for dinner I’d say arrive at 5-5.15pm

I’ve been here many times, and I keep coming back — and will continue to do so. For starters, there’s a salad with mustard and walnut served with slices of baguette. The main course, of course, is the steak and fries it’s truly delicious. As for desserts, the profiterole and the tower-shaped version of it are great; the classic one tastes better, but the tower is perfect for sharing.

The service is excellent — the staff are very elegant, kind, and genuinely beautiful in the way they present themselves, and they always look so polished and well-put-together, which adds to the restaurant’s charm. Everything is clean,beautiful and well-organized.

The only downside is that it can get crowded and there can be a queue in the evenings and on weekends, and the tables are a bit small, but that’s understandable since it’s always busy inside. Definitely a place worth visiting not just once, but many times.

Wanted to visit this French steak house for a long time and eventually came with three friends.  It was Sunday after 1pm, we queued and waited for half an hour for a table, which was not too bad.  There only one set menu that covers bread, salad, steak and fries.  They offer one refill of steak and fries.  The food was good but not great.  The seat setting was very close to each others.  We had two bottles of house red at £27 a bottle, that was reasonable.  Unfortunately we didn't check the bill when we pay until two hours later when I looked at the photo of the receipt and found that they had charged us three bottles of red.

venues.image_alt: Le Relais de Venise L'Entrecote | Marylebone — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Mon Plaisir
venues.description: Busy bistro serving French classics in intimate dining spaces, with 50+ years of history.

reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic! I’d always wanted to visit this cozy French spot in Covent Garden and it truly exceeded my expectations. The slow-cooked beef cheek was one of the best I’ve ever had melt-in-your-mouth perfection. The waiter was so friendly and gave great recommendations for both food and drinks, which made the experience even more special. The decoration made me feel like I was in France, adding to the charm. Such a lovely evening overall, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality. Can’t wait to go back!

Although the food was good, we received such a poor welcome and service..  This French restaurant had a fantastic reputation back in the days and we were excited to have a nice quick meal while shopping in the area. Prices are mad...over £100 for 2 (one main course each and a glass of wine!!), service was so poor to a point the manager in charge did not speak to us once...until she took our payment..."have a great day" !! The waitress seemed to be the only one really working that day. The food was good, tasty and well presented...but not exceptional. There were spelling.mistakes in the menu. This was a disappointment....

Fantastic evening and great service from all staff. The food tasted exceptional and definitely worth the visit.
Mussels to share along with a prawn cocktail. The bread and French butter to soak up the sauce. The butter was 10/10! As was all foods.
Atmosphere was lovely, staff were attentive, decoration on point.

Great wine choice.
I was enjoying myself soo much i forgot to take pics of the mains.

venues.name: Pierre Victoire Soho
venues.description: Bistro specialising in set and pre-theatre menus, with candlelit evenings and occasional pianists.

reviews.text: I love restaurants that are elegant and stylish without being showy, and this one was exactly that. I’m so happy we found it and had the chance to experience it. The food was so good that I highly recommend trying it. We love Rioja wine, and having it with our meal made the evening even more wonderful. We also ordered entrecote steak, and it was cooked just the way I like it. I usually have trouble with that, but not here. I forgot to take a photo of it because I immediately started eating :) The place has two floors, and both are really lovely. Just take whichever floor you’re given and enjoy it.

Delicious French meal, perfect for a dinner with friends post theatre. Great location, close walking distance from most theatres and other central attractions. We were celebrating a friends birthday and they treated us to a little song to help celebrate.  Service was friendly and efficient. Great wine list too.

Wha a delight this place is! Right near The Nellie Dean, a pub I love, a great location. Food was absolutely delicious, absolutely singing with flavour and lots of seasoning. Dishes were skillfully cooked and presented (halibut beautifully done, clearly butter-basted), pricing much fairer than many similar restaurants (including the wine - nothing's cheap now, but the options were appreciated and the Cotes du Rhone lovely), and all the staff were so friendly, polite and professional. I want to thank the staff/chefs as this was a birthday dinner for my partner, and she loved it as well!

venues.name: Clos Maggiore
venues.description: Modern French restaurant with notable wine list, flower-filled conservatory and log fire.

reviews.text: We had the set menu pre theatre menu and it was out of this world and excellent value for money. The interiors, and service was impeccable and the ambience was lovely. Most diners were doing the set menu at the time and we felt very relaxed and not rushed. Between the three of us I think we had one of everything off the menu and it was all divine - you won’t be disappointed

From start to finish, the experience was excellent. The starters, mains, and desserts were all beautifully presented and full of flavour. The décor and atmosphere are truly stunning, making the setting feel very special. Service was attentive and professional, complementing the high quality of the food. Overall, a memorable dining experience that I would highly recommend to anyone.

We celebrated a mix of birthdays and new jobs at Clos Maggiore, and it was absolutely perfect. The restaurant has a beautiful, romantic atmosphere, with the stunning floral décor making it feel really special for an occasion. The service was attentive and professional without being intrusive, and the food was excellent – every dish beautifully presented and full of flavour. It made for a memorable evening and felt like a real treat. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a place to celebrate something special in London.

venues.image_alt: Clos Maggiore — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Sabor
venues.description: Lively, 2-story Spanish eatery offering tapas plates plus bar & countertop dining in casual digs.

reviews.text: The food was excellent—on the pricier side, but definitely worth it. Service was outstanding from the bar staff through to management. A special mention to Karolina at the front desk: even though we didn’t have a booking, she kindly found us seats at the bar and later welcomed us warmly to a table as soon as one became available. The premium beer and margarita were both fantastic. I’d give this place 5 stars and will definitely be returning.

The food is indeed fantastic and the Counter experience is recommended. Went there in June. Arrived 15 minutes before the 17 o'clock opening on weekday and all the people in the queue plus whoever arrived within 20 or so minutes got a spot at the Counter. Your next best chance is around 18:30 to 19:00 when the first people with happy tummies start leaving.

Either ask for recommendations or choose what you fancy. Pan Tomate was absolutely delicious, and so was the Mackerel. The Cuttlefish pappardelle were lovely too. Well, everything was good. Cremoso de Chocolate at the end was a fantastic finish.

I really wanted to love this place and had been looking forward to this visit for a celebratory occasion. We were sat at the counter and ordered similar dishes as the group of 3 next to us. Yet from the time stamps on our photos, we were only served 2 lukewarm (albeit tasty) croquetas in the 45min from placing our order. We didn’t want to complain but eventually when one of the staff asked if everything was ok we replied honestly that we were hungry. The group next to us had received 4 dishes in that time including the tortilla and octopus which we had also ordered. He then told us that these dishes take time as they are made on the spot - no apology or I’ll check with the chef but the implication that we were impatient - this seemed not in keeping with any good customer service much less Michelin starred. The second dish (arroz negros) eventually came in nearly an hour from when we ordered, which understandably is a dish that might longer to cook but we had also ordered a gem lettuce side and tortilla etc that could have staved off our hunger in the meantime. The food was delicious although a tad salty and all chefs were working hard if inefficiently. They seemed to make one dish at a time despite multiple orders of the same being made and then the dish will go on a little journey up the counter to be garnished then down the counter to be dressed then around again as they looked whose dish it was for - which probably explained why some dishes ended up being lukewarm. I really loved the dishes but feel underwhelmed by the service for the price and how delays were handled. Eventually when he realised we hadn’t received our tortilla after more than an hour our wait staff apologised. We didn’t feel appreciated as customers and probably won’t go back as we’ve had better service with same level of food at Barrafina.

venues.name: Barrafina Dean Street
venues.description: Cosy, diner-style tapas bar with stools for Spanish small plates, served with sherry, cava and more.

reviews.text: Absolutely loved all the food! Our favourite was the tortillas. This is so far the best tapas place we have been in London. We would definitely be back & will try the other dishes. Waiting time wasn’t too bad for a Saturday dinner time, but it’s worth the wait!

A delightful surprise! We stumbled upon this tapas restaurant and were absolutely blown away – it's hands down the best tapas experience we've ever had. Every dish was a flavor explosion, and we would highly recommend the squid and chicken thigh!

A huge thank you to our server, Kelvin, whose recommendations and attentive service truly elevated our meal. We can't wait to return next time when we are in town again!

We were lucky have a table for 4 , when we visited,  despite the restaurant was almost full, yet the chef or manager still took the time to explain almost all the dishes to us.
Such lovely people and happy staff!
The freshness of the food is clearly the key to this great tapas place. Thank you for the wonderful experience.

venues.name: El Pirata Of Mayfair - Tapas Bar Español
venues.description: Informal tapas bar with authentic menu, Iberian wines and informal, dark-wood decor.

reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful experience here! The atmosphere is lively and authentic, perfect for a night out with friends. The seafood paella was absolutely delicious – rich in flavour, with perfectly cooked rice and generous portions of fresh prawns, squid, and mussels.

The tapas were also spot on – the garlic prawns were juicy and fragrant, the patatas bravas had the perfect crisp, and the pan con tomate tasted just like in Spain. Everything paired so well with the sangria, which was refreshing and fruity without being too sweet.

Service was friendly and attentive even though the restaurant was busy, and we never felt rushed. Definitely a place I’d love to come back to when craving proper Spanish food in London!

I chose the appetizer~
🥖Toasted Bread with Tomatoes: A truly authentic appetizer! The bread is super crispy! The freshly cut tomatoes with a little sea salt and olive oil are absolutely delicious!
🐟Grilled Cod Skewers: So fresh and tender! The meat is so tender, it looks like it's right on the cheek!
🍗Seared Chicken: This dish is so delicious! The skin is fried to a crispy crisp, and the chicken is fried just right, so soft and tender! I can't wait to order another plate of bread to finish all the sauce!
🦐Grilled Prawns in Garlic Sauce: A must-order for almost every table! Sizzling and sizzling, eat it while it's hot! The seasoning and olive oil complement the prawns so well!

🥘Seafood Paella: A Spanish must-try! The portion is huge and it's easy to slice! The side dishes included mussels, prawns, fish, and squid, perfect for two people!

🍮For dessert, we tried the caramel pudding: it was beautiful! The caramel layer was super crispy! You could literally take a chunk of caramel right off! The pudding had a rich, eggy aroma! It was the perfect ending. ~ My friend ordered the traditional Spanish cake with ice cream: it felt a bit like a nutty sponge cake, and it was delicious with the ice cream!

Amazing Spanish food! The seafood paella was full of flavour, the grilled octopus was perfectly cooked, and the sangria was fresh and fruity. Great atmosphere, friendly service – can’t wait to come back!

venues.image_alt: El Pirata Of Mayfair - Tapas Bar Español — spanish restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Salt Yard
venues.description: Spanish & Italian small plates & wine served in a chic, warmly decorated dining spot.

reviews.text: Lovely atmosphere, great food and drinks. We especially enjoyed the octopus and the tuna! The cocktails were also delicious. One downside was the drinks took too long to come out, but was not an issue in the end. Will definitely be coming back!

Delicious Spanish food and lovely atmosphere. The vibe is order a bunch of dishes to share between yourselves. Highly recommend trying the octopus and the courgette flower - very tasty. The lamb is also very good. Great value for money

Every dish was amazing. Especially the croquetas, courgette flower, lamb, Patatas bravas and churros. The wine was great, they had a really good selection with descriptions on the menu. The staff were all lovely and attentive. The decor was nice as was the music and general atmosphere. I’d recommend booking as they did turn people away when we were there as they were fully booked. We ate pre theatre which was great because it’s a lot quieter area then closer to the theatres and it’s only a 16minute walk away.

venues.image_alt: Salt Yard — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Copita
venues.description: Informal tapas bar with stools at wooden counters, wines, sherries and leche y leche coffee.

reviews.text:
2025/06
Delicious Spanish tapas with rich, authentic flavors! Everything we tried tasted great and was beautifully presented. It is on the expensive side, but the quality of the food makes it worth it. Overall, a very good experience!

Visited for birthday celebration. The drinks and food are great! Especially the gin tonic with basil & rosemary, also the pork! We ordered a cheesecake and the staff smartly deliver it with a candle. Enjoyed a nice time there!

I've been here twice, and every time I come, it's delicious and the service is also very good.
Especially recommend the octopus, ox cheek, prawns, buns
Last time I had apple pear & ice cream for dessert, miss it so much

venues.name: Hispania
venues.description: Imaginative takes on classic Spanish dishes and tapas, with a grand, tiled upstairs dining room.

reviews.text: Best Spanish restaurant in London. Exceptional produce, service, and ambience, pure perfection. Oscar was outstanding, explaining dishes and wine pairings, offering great recommendations, and making us feel at home. Stunning food, warm atmosphere. We’ll be back and can’t recommend it highly enough.

We recently visited Hispania, located in the financial district of London City, and I must say it was a delightful experience. As a Spaniard, I often find myself feeling a bit let down by Spanish restaurants abroad, but this was definitely not the case with Hispania. It was refreshing to see a restaurant that not only respects traditional Spanish cuisine but also elevates it with a touch of luxury.

The ambiance is warm and welcoming, offering a perfect balance of privacy and comfort. The interior design, paired with the attentive and professional service, makes you feel genuinely valued as a guest. The staff, including the manager, went above and beyond to ensure our experience was nothing short of excellent.

The food was genuinely delicious. While every dish was well-prepared and flavorful, the mushroom croquettes were a particular highlight—simply exquisite! The menu offers a broad range of authentic Spanish dishes, all prepared with evident care and quality ingredients.

One pleasant surprise was the pricing. Considering the location and the elevated dining experience, the prices were quite reasonable. I left feeling not only satisfied with the food but also pleased with the overall value.

If you’re looking for an authentic Spanish dining experience in London, Hispania is a must-visit. Whether you’re Spanish yourself or simply a lover of good food, this restaurant offers a genuine taste of Spain with a level of service and ambiance that makes you want to return. I’d definitely recommend it!

Absolutely delicious! The croquettes are so delicious and melt in your mouth I would eat these everyday if I could (and not put on any weight!!). I want to make everything I tried at home, that's how utterly scrumptious the food was. If I could give 10 stars I would!

The staff were super attentive and friendly even though it was very busy, which is a wonderful touch.

A lovely place, lovely atmosphere, beautiful plates and decorations.

Also the women's toilet wallpaper, wonderful.

venues.name: Luna Llena
venues.description: Luna Llena is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Luna Llena provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 119 Stroud Green Rd, Finsbury Park, London N4 3PX, UK

reviews.text: Great Spanish flavours, great wine, with decent portions. Everything tasted nice. The paella, the artichoke salad, and bread with salsa dips were fantastic. Stylish and fun decor, with a relaxing atmosphere. I love the red chairs and the writing wall. I came here for brunch with friends during the Easter weekend. It was the only restaurant open in the area, as the others closed at 3pm. So it's a great place to go at any time, with no time restrictions. I would love to come back for the flamenco dancing night.
5***** food and service. The food was outstanding. Everything was freshly cooked and tasted wonderful. The service was very attentive without being over the top. We will definitely be returning.

I was not too sure at first because I know tapas is normally small portions and to be honest I was quite hungry. But to my surprise the portions we decent, food was fresh and if great quality. Wonderful selection of wines and fantastic desserts. Wonderful ambience and great service. I will definitely be coming back 👏👏👏

venues.name: Lobos
venues.description: Warm tapas bar with wood furnishings & a laid-back vibe offering steaks & Iberico pork.

reviews.text:
Had a very enjoyable dinner with friends at this tapas restaurant.
The dishes were superb (the lamb cutlets, steak and octopus were my favourites) and it was a nice touch for the chef to send us a complimentary octopus which was delicious - thank you.
The restaurant has a fun vibe, a downstairs bar with some interesting wolf-themed quotes. The staff were super friendly and attentive. Special mention to Jasmine who looked after us - she was superb! All in all - a gem of a restaurant in Soho - I recommend it!

I love that  they location is very central,  food portions on tapas are big.  Like 3 to 4 tapas can be shared for 2. Cheesecake is fantastic.  Lambchop is a must. Strawberry daiquiri and sangria are exquisite.

I honestly have to say everything was exceptional! I'm so glad I chose to celebrate my birthday here 🎈it was the perfect decision. The food was absolutely delicious, every dish better than the last. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, which made the evening even more special. I truly appreciate the lovely birthday cake. Thank you for making it such a memorable night!❤️🌹

venues.name: Copita Fitzrovia Tapas Bar
venues.description: Airy tapas bar with dark wood tables and a tiled floor, for small plates, Spanish wine and sherries.

reviews.text: We rarely had tapas like this outside of Spain! Everything was great and beautifully prepared. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. The ceviche was our favourite, but everything was great. We will definitely come back.

All the dishes are cooked to perfection! I highly recommend the artichoke dish!! Martha was super friendly! We had sangria, mushroom croquettes, artichoke, tortillas, ox cheek, beef onglet, octopus and miso basque cheesecake😋😋

Wonderful meal!
Delicious tapas, nice desserts and a bottle of good wine.

venues.image_alt: Copita Fitzrovia Tapas Bar — spanish restaurant in Central London

venues.name: El Ganso Cafe
venues.description: Modern and fusion tapas in a compact, casual Spanish restaurant with simple tables and banquettes.

reviews.text: The staff at El Ganso was so kind and accommodating for my birthday dinner. We were 11 total and had the tasting menu, which was such a great option for us. Because of different dietary needs, they were able to swap out some of options for the folks at our table. The food was tasty, and the portions were generous! We were able to get refills on any of the tapas we wanted.

El Ganso is Head & shoulders above the competition on Broadway Market. Sensational food. Great service. Lovely, relaxed atmosphere. No wonder it’s so busy, they deserve every bit of success. Best brunch in Hackney & gorgeous tapas too.

Great food, service, and staff! I had the best octopus I’ve had in a long time (I preferred it grilled), and the prawns and croquettes — oh my word... Everything was reasonably priced, and there's a nice selection of wines. The staff were incredibly helpful in recommending the best pairings and sharing plates based on our preferences and group size.

Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: omg i love this place. If you want nice tortillas, pan con tomato, peppers, croquettes you must go. Its located in Fitzrovia,

This has quickly become one of my favourite restaurants in London! The food is incredible - authentic, full of flavour, and perfectly seasoned every time. The tortilla and pan con tomate are my favourite dishes! The service is just as impressive, with Daniel being a particularly outstanding server - attentive, friendly, and genuinely welcoming. I highly recommend this place!
The food was absolutely delicious. Honest, down to earth Spanish cooking. The croquetas and tortilla were divine. I left here full and very happy and I'll definitely be going back.
