Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: A small gem. Just what w where looking for. Just good food. Had a very nice platter of ibérico ham and manchego. The paella was also very tasty. Very good wine to top it off. Service was very friendly and generally only good vibes. Had a lovely evening thank you for making our only night in london one to remember!

I'm italian and not accustomed to asian food that is easily enjoyable in London. Thus, after two asian meals coming here was like fresh air. The dish I post as a photo was 10£, fair for London prices, and a "sandwich" that I ate before was 7£. It was really really good with Iberic cheese and ham. Even the red wine was really good.

Fantastic tiny place for a sit-in meal. Quality and authentic Spanish meat and cheese from people who know what they're doing. Beautifully cold Mahou served on a very hot day. Their tomatoes are sweet and delectable. Great honest service too.

venues.name: Camino
venues.description: Tapas, platters, brunches and Spanish wines in an informal brick and wood space, with terrace.

reviews.text:
Visiting Camino felt like stepping into a sunlit corner of Andalusia. The space is cosy yet elegant, perfect for family meals, quiet dinners, or lively evenings. Shreyas, our waiter, welcomed our toddler with warmth while guiding our meal with calm confidence.

My wife couldn’t get enough of the pulpo. It was tender, lightly charred and impeccably cooked. My solomillo(ordered rare)was a masterclass in flavour. Gambas al ajillo, rich with garlic, transported me straight to Malaga. And the anchovies on bread were clean, briny perfection.

Desserts concluded the evening beautifully: a delicate Basque cheesecake for me, lightly spiced churros for her. Don’t forget to order a bottle of Cava and a glass of sherry! Camino doesn’t just serve tapas - it captures the heart of southern Spain. Thank you!

A little gem of a bar in King’s cross. Perfect for a glass after work. Fab Spanish wines to choose from and they even have Pincho Happy Hour! Get a free pincho with every glass of wine between 5-6 pm. I love the gildas. Arthur & Domnal behind the bar are knowledgeable and fabulous! Great service :)

During a recent visit to London, we stopped for lunch at Camino, a stylish restaurant nestled beside King’s Cross station. The interior is beautifully designed, sophisticated yet inviting, with an understated elegance that sets the tone for a refined dining experience.
The staff were exemplary: highly professional, attentive without being intrusive, and clearly dedicated to ensuring a seamless meal. We sampled a selection of tapas, most of which were well executed and flavorful. The only slight letdown were the potatoes, which felt underwhelming compared to the other dishes.
While prices lean toward the higher end, the quality of the food, coupled with the restaurant’s ambiance and impeccable service, justifies the cost. Camino is a standout choice for those seeking a taste of Spain in central London, perfect for both casual lunches and special occasions.

venues.name: Barrafina Drury Lane
venues.description: Cosy, diner-style tapas bar with stools for Spanish small plates, served with sherry, cava and more.

reviews.text:
We had a lovely experience at Barrafina. The menu offered a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and everything we tried was absolutely delicious. The wine we ordered was also excellent and complemented the food nicely.

The service was outstanding. We were immediately greeted and seated, and the staff kept everything running smoothly. The dishes came out at a perfect pace, and as we finished each plate, they were quickly cleared to make room for the next – a small detail that really made the experience feel seamless.

The only downside was the price. The total came to around £200 for two people, which felt a bit high for the amount of food we had.

Overall, it was a fantastic evening with great food, wine, and exceptional service – just be prepared for a higher bill than you might expect.

This wasn't in the plan, but our itinerary took a detour and we decided to have lunch near the theatre. Ended up at @barrafinalondon which turned out to be an unexpected but amazing experience.

The food was simply topclass but what blew my mind away was the Spanish tortilla. Omelettes but absolutely out of the world. Crispy on the outside but layered and runny on the inside. And so tasty and absolutely delicious. Sometimes the simplest thing can turn out to the most amazing if it is done right (in this case, eggs 🥚).

Highly recommended, and tortilla - out of this world 👍⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

#London #greatfood #Spanish #Barrafina #tapas #arroznegro #paella #croquetas #tortilla #braised #porkcheek #coventgarden 🇬🇧🇪🇦🍴

One of our favourite ever dining experiences. The food was absolutely gorgeous! It was clear that a lot of care went into the taste and presentation. Huge shout out to the iconic Tortilla - perfectly gooey! But the staff!! What a lovely, warm group of people. It felt like we dining with friends. We loved our server, Kelvin, who was super helpful with the menu (as we had a few dietary requirements) and hilarious. We then stayed chatting to manager, who was super friendly. The atmosphere was relaxed - we stayed for hours and didn't feel rushed at all. We only went out for a little date, but it turned into a night that felt very special. Can't wait to return!

venues.description: Maresco is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Maresco provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: A little gem you don’t want to miss! If you love seafood, this is the place – the razor clams, scallops, and cottage flowers are my absolute favourites. Everything is fresh and full of flavour. The staff are super nice and helpful, which just makes the whole experience even better. Can’t wait to go back!

Disappointing and rushed dining experience
I had a dinner booking at Maresco yesterday, from 18:00 to 20:00. The food quality was only fair and not as authentic as Spanish tapas, with small portion sizes. However, the main issue was the service.

Throughout our meal, the staff made us feel incredibly rushed. A staff member came to collect our plates while we were still eating, with several bites left on the dishes. After we explained that we were still enjoying our food and conversation, he returned about 15 minutes later to ask again. This made us feel pressured to finish quickly and ruined the relaxed atmosphere we were hoping for.

The same pushy approach continued after our desserts. The staff member came to our table and asked us to pay, which I understood was because our two-hour booking slot was nearing its end. However, I was surprised by this unnecessary rush as I couldn't see any queue outside the restaurant, and it didn't seem particularly busy. The staff's behavior was rude and significantly detracted from our dining experience. I would not recommend this restaurant.

Fresh seafood with bold Spanish flavours! Every dish was beautifully presented, especially loving the scallops, ceviche and venison. Great vibe, friendly service, perfect spot for sharing plates and a casual night out!

venues.vicinity: Mary Queen of Scots House, 142 Fleet St, London

reviews.text: Very lovely staff and the owners wife was also there to suggest food! There was nothing on the table that didn't taste good. Highly recommend if you want some easy-going Korean food.

My wife, our baby boy and I came here twice for lunch in April 2025.

The food is super fresh and delicious! The staff is very friendly and professional. If you happen to meet the owner he will take the time for a little chat and tells you the beautiful history of the restaurant.

We will definitely be back!

The best Korean restaurant I’ve been to in London! Both the chicken and the stews were amazing. The tteokbokki was sweet and spicy, and the cheese hot dogs are something I definitely want to have again. I feel like every item on the menu would be delicious. On top of that, the staff were incredibly friendly!

Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Majang Dong provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: We had a great experience dining here! We found the atmosphere to be just like in Korea. Staff were super kind and welcoming! The food was amazing. Fresh and high quality meat, juicy, perfectly seasoned. Exceptional taste that had us ordering more and more. Korean inspired cocktails like the Makpuccino rounded off our evening. Looking forward to return to our new favorite Korean restaurant!

We came here on a Friday evening without a reservation. We had brought drinks with us and were worried we’d have to finish them before going in, but the staff kindly stored them in their fridge for us - which we really appreciated.

The food was absolutely top tier. My sister and I were so caught up enjoying every single dish that we barely spoke throughout the meal. We ordered the seafood pancake, jajangmyeon, and fried chicken - and each one was incredible. As someone who truly loves Korean cuisine, this place completely blew me away

The staff were lovely, and the food came out quickly even though it was a busy Friday evening in a lively area. We were also pleasantly surprised to receive complimentary side dishes - we thought they would be extra, so that was such a nice touch. I’ll definitely be coming back!

we had amazing dinner in this restaurant. place were bit busy considering it was weekend but didn't take long queue and food came quickly. all was absolutely fantastic and staff were super nice, thanks for all taken great care of our table! short rib is THE best!!!

reviews.text: Great food! We walked past this restaurant and decided to give it a try — surprisingly, it turned out to be very good!

As my first time having Korean bbq I cannot complain. I really enjoyed the food especially the pancakes and the seaweed rice dumplings but also the bbq was tasty maybe too hot for me but that’s just my personal taste. All the staff were so polite and nice I will definitely go back.
Great Korean BBQ experience... The service was exemplary... Food was great and filling... A bit expensive, but then the portions were big

venues.name: YORI Korean Restaurant (Covent Garden)
venues.description: Casual outlet providing traditional Korean dishes & drinks, plus tabletop grills & hot pots.

reviews.text: Went there for dinner, had lovely food and the service was great. I had vegan bibimbap with tofu, the scallion pancake, we shared some japchae and drinks. All came to about 40£ per person. Would go again

We had such an amazing evening for my birthday here this evening Hsu and Kia were incredible changing the playlist to suit my favourite songs and constantly wishing me a happy birthday! Food was incredible! Super service will be back!

Disappointed with the quality compared to the other Korean restaurants we tried last week. It might be because it’s a chain, so perhaps expectations shouldn’t be too high. Not terrible, but definitely underwhelming.

venues.name: Ssam Ssam Korean Restaurant
venues.description: Ssam Ssam Korean Restaurant is a korean restaurant located in London. With a 4.9-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine korean flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Stumbled across this restaurant the a few weeks ago and decided to try it out today. Everything we ate was so delicious and of high quality! We ordered the wagyu salad and pork bone broth from the specials and then the grilled black cod. Everything was cooked and seasoned perfectly. The staff were really lovely and attentive and the restaurant is nice and clean. Only con was that the mocktails were too sweet but others may still love it. Defo coming back!

Came a year ago and loved every bite of the Matcha Crème Brûlée. Came back and tasted just as delicious. Has become an all time favourite now. Food and atmosphere is 10/10, super friendly and attentive staff, very warm and welcoming. Thank you, we will be back🤩

Great selection of food and great service. I’ve tried other BBQ spots in New Malden but I much prefer this one.
The spicy pork was full of flavour. I really enjoyed the fried chicken so ordered x2 portions.

venues.name: Bibimbap Soho
venues.description: Bright, modern eatery serving multiple varieties of the signature Korean mixed rice dish.

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic time at this restaurant, which offers delicious and authentic Korean cuisine.

We ordered several dishes, including bibimbap, sweet and spicy Korean fried chicken, and the spicy rice cakes tteokbokki, all of which were tasty. My favourite dish was the fried tofu bibimbap, which paired wonderfully with their iced plum tea.

I highly recommend visiting this place!
Minimalism interior eat-in Place in really nice location. Love the atmosphere and here we enjoyed Bibimbap. A rainbow colour of rice and veggie. Will try Bingsu next time.

Tried Bibimbap in Soho for the first time. It’s a small Korean spot with great food and fast service. I had the chicken bibimbap, which is halal and was served in a hot iron bowl—delicious and fresh. I was honestly surprised how quickly it came after ordering. Staff were friendly and polite throughout. Spent £23 for the meal and an apple juice. Worth it. Will definitely go again.

venues.image_alt: Bibimbap Soho — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Arang Restaurant
venues.description: Smart modern Korean restaurant with large menu of classic kimchi cabbage and banchan side dishes.

reviews.text:
We recently visited this restaurant and had such an incredible experience from start to finish! The atmosphere was warm, lively, and welcoming, perfect for enjoying a hearty Korean meal. We also had an amazing server SJ, who served the three of us and was attentive the whole time.

Recommendation Dishes:
Jajangmyeon with beef, Kimchi pancakes, tteokbokki with cheese, beef bimbibap.

For any Muslims coming here, there's plenty of halal dishes and you can substitute the pork with alternatives like beef, seafood or chicken.

The food was absolutely delicious. The tteokbokki had just the right amount of spice and sweetness, with chewy rice cakes that were cooked perfectly. The kimchi pancake was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, packed with flavour and easily one of the best we’ve tried. The jajangmyeon with beef was rich and savoury, with a delicious flavour that paired so well with the noodles. The sides from the kitchen were also fantastic, everything from the kimchi to the pickled radish and other small dishes tasted fresh, well-seasoned, and perfectly complemented the mains. You can really tell that care and attention go into every dish.

We also tried the miso soup, which had a gentle umami flavour and a great palate cleanser between dishes. Personally, I found it a little mild for my taste, but my friends really enjoyed it, describing it as wonderfully soothing and comforting. It's like the kind of warm soup you’d crave when you’re feeling under the weather.

We ordered a few other dishes too, including the japchae, bibimbap, and mandu. The japchae had a good texture, the glass noodles were slightly bouncy but it wasn’t as flavourful as the other dishes we tried, so it felt a little dry and underwhelming in comparison. The bibimbap was enjoyable and nicely presented, though since we ordered quite a variety, it was naturally a bit overshadowed by the stronger flavours of the tteokbokki and jajangmyeon. The mandu was good, though it wasn’t particularly standout compared to the other dishes on the table.

But what truly made the evening special was the outstanding service from SJ. He was friendly, professional, and incredibly attentive throughout our meal. He checked in at just the right moments, made thoughtful recommendations, and went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable and happy. His positive energy and genuine hospitality really stood out and made our dining experience unforgettable.

We’ll definitely be coming back, not only for the amazing food but also because SJ made us feel so welcome. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great Korean food and top-tier service!

This restaurant was such a discovery! We ate so well today. The portions are big, the food is super tasty and the girl working was very nice. They play Kpop and the prices are totally ok for the center of London (actually cheaper than many other restaurants we saw).
Food was so good! I had Bulgogi set menu with my friend and could try so many different things. After the meal, they even served fruit! I definitely want to go again :)

venues.image_alt: Arang Restaurant — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Bunsik Chinatown
venues.description: Bunsik Chinatown is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Bunsik Chinatown provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Bunsik is such a fun spot in London! Loved how quick and easy it was to order at the kiosk — super smooth, and the food came out fast and freshly made. The Crunchy Chicken Ramen-covered corndog was amazing, and the Spicy Chicken corndog was just as delicious. Great flavors, fun vibes, and definitely a must-try if you’re in the mood for something different and tasty. Can’t wait to come back! 🎉🌭🔥

Really delicious and cheesy corn dogs. I like the kiosks that you can order on which is quick and efficient. However the place is quite small and can feel quite claustrophobic considering it gets busy easily. Not much seating inside but was happy to stand outside and eat. The potato and cheese corn dog was actual perfection, loads of cheese and crispy potato and you can choose whatever sauce you want

Visited Bunsik in Chinatown and had the buldak mayo bites – absolutely delicious! They were perfectly cooked, full of flavour, and had the right balance of spice and creaminess. The presentation was impressive, and it’s clear the team takes pride in their food. Definitely a highly recommended spot if you’re in London’s Chinatown and looking for something tasty and satisfying!

venues.name: Taeyang Pocha Korean BBQ SOJU Restaurant
venues.description: Sparsely-decorated spot serving traditional Korean standards from seafood pancakes to bibimbap.

reviews.text:
everytime i eat here, there are at least 10-15 food delivery drivers that come to pick up food. that alone says a lot.

this place is very clean and the customer service is excellent.
the food tastes amazing and the portions are reasonably priced.
this is one of my favourite restaurants to eat at.

巨伏 鹹到仆街 救得一個得一個

Came here after seeing all the good reviews but honestly so disappointing. Kalbitang was way way way too salty. The spicy pork bibimbap was soggy and the pork tasted cheap and not fresh, more like scraps than proper meat. Definitely not worth it. 😢
There’s two of us and we ordered three dishes - definitely too much! I’d say the food is not bad considering the area , but I’ve had better elsewhere. I like the ddukbokki the most.

venues.name: YORI Piccadilly Circus Korean BBQ
venues.description: Compact restaurant serving traditional Korean cuisine & BBQ specialties in relaxed surrounds.

reviews.text: Wonderful place for Korean food in London ! We didn’t try the BBQ but standards plates, all delightful ! The tteokbokki and the pajeon were so good, as well as the soy garlic chicken bites. We tried different bibimbap and the tofu and sea food stew, so tasty and not too spicy, which was great for us ! Plates are really affordable in my opinion. And the service is great ! I highly recommend this place !

It was very easy to make reservation on Google Maps. We were craving for some Korean barbecue and we ordered the beef selection.

Some of the smaller pieces come with very nice marble however the quantity wasn’t that much there is a piece of bigger steak, and some other that are marinated.

When we first put the meat on the grill, the grill wasn’t completely heated up so the steak wasn’t the best and no staff told us when the grill  would be ready.

On top of that we ordered a Seaford pancake, mushroom fried glass noodle and a soup with rice.

The rice wine in a bowl is a must to order. It is very delicious and with low alcohol percentage.

We had a very nice time there drinking rice wine and eating. Three of us and we had a full tummy.

It was £120 for 3, not bad for London price, especially we had alcohol.

Took my daughter here for a celebration meal We went for the set barbecue (chicken) we also got beef, 2 rices and some kimchi glass of coke and a big water total £82 lovely atmosphere, great customer service.My only downfall is if 2 people are going the tables aren't big enough apart from that I lovely experience

venues.image_alt: YORI Piccadilly Circus Korean BBQ — korean restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Seoul Tokyo
venues.description: Seoul Tokyo is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Seoul Tokyo provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 168 Borough High St, London SE1 1LB, UK

reviews.text:
If you’re craving authentic Korean flavors in the heart of London, this place is an absolute must-visit. I ordered 5-6 dishes and there were packed with rich flavors.

One thing I really loved is how they use high-quality ingredients. The portion sizes are great for sharing, so it’s perfect for a casual dinner with friends or a cozy date night.

Prices are reasonable for central London, and honestly, the food is worth every penny. I can’t wait to go back and try more dishes. If you’re looking for an authentic taste of Korea without leaving London, this spot is a gem.

Friendly staff. Clean. Excellent food with just the right amount of salt.

Came here with a friend for lunch. We ordered cabbage kimchi and beans out kimchi as cold starters.

We also got a seafood pancake. It’s fresh, chewy and not too oily.

We each ordered a stew dish. My friend got a spicy ox tail stew with rice. I got a pork and tofu kimchi stew.

Both stews came to us pipping hot. I didn’t find any of the dishes excessively salty or greasy. The rice was a mix of white rice and red rice.

My friend also ordered a Korean soda drink.

We also got 10% off by paying in cash.

The cold dishes, pancake and two stews with rice portion came to a total of £38.50 (including the discount). This is great for value considering the quality of food was also great!

I was able to grab a table for one here yesterday as a walk in just before the rush started. I was expecting smaller portions so I over ordered but it’s fine because I took the rest home.

I ordered a half portion of the Yangnyeom KFC (5 pieces) £7 and the cheese dalggalbi £14. I also ordered regular cabbage kimchi £2.5 and cucumber kimchi £2.5. I finished the dalggalbi and cabbage kimchi because it was lighter and the sourness and spiciness of the kimchi went well with it. I wrapped up most of the KFC to go home.

The staff were really friendly and attentive. I think towards the end they were ready busy between the tables as well as the telephone calls for reservations and takeaway orders. Even though I did ask for a plastic takeaway box for the kimchi which is watery, I was given an aluminium one. It was my second time asking so I couldn’t be bothered to ask again, and yes, it did end up spilling inside the bag despite trying to wrap it up tight inside the plastic bag I was given.

The chicken tasted fresh and the portions were good. I think I’ll definitely come back if I have the chance.

venues.name: Bento Bab (Authentic Korea food) - Commercial street
venues.description: Compact restaurant offering traditional Korean snacks & meals & drinks, plus sushi.

reviews.text:
The food was absolutely incredible! Every dish was full of flavour and well presented. The staff were very attentive and made us feel welcome throughout our visit. The atmosphere in the restaurant was lovely and added to an overall great dining experience.

The only downside was the toilets, which were located down some dark basement corridors and felt a little unclean with an unpleasant smell. It’s a shame, as everything else was fantastic.

I was excited to try this restaurant for the first time, but the service left a lot to be desired. My partner and I ordered through the online system, which was easy enough, but his food arrived 20 minutes before mine. In the meantime, two customers who arrived and ordered after us received their meals (at least in part), and no one checked in with us until we followed up. My partner even waited to start eating, yet when my order finally came, there was no acknowledgment or apology for the delay.

The flavor of my kimbap was fine, but nearly half of the pieces fell apart before I could even pick them up, which further soured the overall experience. Unfortunate, but oh well!

During my 7-day stay in London, Bento Bab has been my go-to restaurant. The food is always freshly cooked and served hot, which speaks volumes about its quality and consistency. Serving time is reasonable, ensuring a smooth dining experience without long waits. The pricing is fair for the quality offered, making it an excellent choice for both regular meals and casual dining. Highly recommended for anyone looking for freshly prepared, flavorful dishes at a good value.

venues.name: Kimchee Restaurant & Bar
venues.description: Meat & vegetables are grilled at the table at this casual venue serving Korean cuisine.
venues.address: Unit 4, 2 Pancras Sq, London N1C 4AG, UK
venues.vicinity: Unit 4, Two Pancras Square, 2 Pancras Sq, London

reviews.text:
Very satisfied from our lunch on Kimchi . First of all Helena she was amazing . Very kind and welcoming.
Also the waiter changed us the table to be close to the heater as we were cold .
Very happy and the food also delicious.
Defo we will come again .

We loved it! me and my friend were here for the night and the atmosphere was just amazing. The service was excellent, always on point and ready to help.

As for the food, it exceeded my expectations. Everything was so flavourful and hot straight from the grill. We got 3 dishes to share and that was more than enough for the 2 of us. The sauces/dips complimented the dishes so well, it was delicious!

The drinks were great too, me and my friend both had the Jeju Island. we both liked it so much that we ended up getting another round of it.

I'd love to come again such a wonderful experience :)

One of the best Korean restaurants in the area!

Always busy but walk-ins are welcome, staff will manage to get you a table asap. It's recommended to try a bit of every traditional Korean dish on the menu and I could only agree. Everything tasted great, we would have ordered even more if not full!

Cocktails are piece of art!

reviews.text: Awesome food, lovely staff, fast service and terrific atmosphere. Place is clean, service is top class. Highly recommended.

Stumbled across this place whilst searching for Korean restaurants for my daughters birthday. We came here lovely small restaurant everyone of the staff were very friendly and this made us feel very welcome. The food portion sizes were very good. My favourite thing that we had were the amazing honey garlic sticky wings. The crunch, size, taste amazing. This was my first time and not my last thank you team for amazing service.

The restaurant's food is just nice and testy. Service is also awesome.
Wish to be there often .

venues.vicinity: Harbour Island, 10 Harbour Exchange Square, London

reviews.text:
First time trying Korean food and it didn’t disappoint!

The hotel recommended this spot, and I’m so glad they did. I had no idea what to order, but the owner was super friendly and suggested the Korean fried chicken — it was absolutely delicious. Fresh, full of flavour, and perfectly cooked. The service was great too, really welcoming and helpful. If you’ve never had Korean food before (like me), this is a brilliant place to start. Highly recommend!

Surprisingly tasty! The atmosphere is very homely, quiet, and the view of the dock is really nice. It will be my go-to comfort food. Also I want to highlight the beef is not overly sauced but very well balanced!

The food is out of this world! I’m such a fussy eater and the amazing man behind the till went out of his way to assist me. It’s in the perfect spot as well! Will definitely be back! The cakes are incredible!

venues.name: Cu4tro Restaurant & Tequila Bar
venues.description: Cu4tro Restaurant & Tequila Bar is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.9-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Cu4tro Restaurant & Tequila Bar provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 21 Great Windmill St, London W1D 7LB, UK

reviews.text:
Located just a couple of minutes’ walk from Shaftesbury Avenue and the heart of Theatreland, and about five minutes from Piccadilly Circus, Cu4tro is a relatively new Mexican restaurant that’s been open for around four months.

The interior is spread across two floors — the bar and a few tables occupy the ground level, with additional seating upstairs. We were seated at a table for three on the first floor, which unfortunately hadn’t been properly cleaned — there were crumbs on the surface, and it felt a bit sticky.

We started with margaritas, but both the classic and mango versions were overly sweet and unbalanced, lacking the refreshing tartness you’d expect.

The Nachos con Guac were underwhelming — both the portion size and the flavour were average, with guacamole that didn’t stand out.

For mains, we tried a few dishes:
•	El Pescador (crispy fish, creamy slaw, pico de gallo, coriander, and house mayo served with salsa verde) — the taco arrived lukewarm, and the fish wasn’t particularly crispy.
•	Burrito King of Flavour (Mexican-style rice, cheese, lettuce, creamy slaw, black beans, pulled pork) — the pulled pork was fine, but overall the flavours felt muted.
•	Backstreet Tacos (pulled pork) — again, fairly average, and the fries on the side were limp with an oddly sour sauce.

Churros was also too oily and too much sugar on it with the accompanying chocolate sauce was inedible!

Service on the first floor was patchy — staff only appeared when bringing dishes, and there were noticeable gaps between courses. Payment is taken at the exit, though this wasn’t explained, so we sat waiting at the table for a while before finding out.

Overall, Cu4tro feels like it’s still finding its footing. The atmosphere is fine, but both food and service need polishing. If compared to a fast-casual Mexican benchmark like Wahaca, it would sit below that level in both quality and consistency.

It you're looking for purist Mexican food then this is not the place for you. Good for people keeping an open mind on Mexican cuisine. We had a small misunderstanding about our order but the server was super nice! Food fresh and tasty.

We had a good food here, we ordered many different tacos and quesadillas, most of them were great, however, i think we should had more compared to the price we payed, and two dishes were alright.
The staff are nice and friendly, the place is clean and looks good.

venues.image_alt: Cu4tro Restaurant & Tequila Bar — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Mestizo Mexican Restaurant & Tequila Bar
venues.description: Fine Mexican cuisine plus tequila shots and cocktails in smart, scarlet space.

reviews.text: We went to this restaurant to celebrate my mother-in-law’s birthday, and everything was absolutely amazing! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the food was delicious from start to finish. What really made the evening extra special were the two waiters who looked after us. They were attentive, friendly, and went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed. They even made my mother-in-law feel celebrated, which meant so much to us. Their professionalism and kindness truly elevated the whole experience. Thank you for such wonderful service—we’ll definitely be back! Special thanks to Damian and Hatzy

Tasty Mexican food which changes from your typical London chain and has some proper special dishes like mole etc. We had salsas with totopos for starter and then for main tried the 3 different enchiladas: a mix of verde and rojo, the mole and Cancun. Great service, delicious margaritas (recommend the jalapeño and tamarind!).
The only downside perhaps is that it’s really loud downstairs

Had lunch here today with my husband (who’s Mexican). Food was incredible. We normally have a difficult time finding good Mexican food around Europe. My husband even said the tamales tasted just like his mom’s. Juan Carlos was our waiter and he was super friendly. Will definitely be going back as often as we can

venues.image_alt: Mestizo Mexican Restaurant & Tequila Bar — mexican restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Los Mochis London City
venues.description: Los Mochis London City is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.5-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Los Mochis London City provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.vicinity: Liverpool Street Station, 100 Liverpool St, London

reviews.text: Took our daughter here for her 18th birthday lunch. And what a lunch it was. We were welcomed right from start and ushered to our table right away. The place is huge and we were surprised at its size. The service was great - attentive, helpful and prompt (without feeling rushed). The cocktails were spot on and we did have quite a few - Tikki Tulum, Tokyo Trailblazer, Tropical Paloma and Pelino Jalapeño Margarita. We were disappointed that a couple of unique cocktails such as the bartender’s competition drink were not available (though they were on the menu). The best part was the food. The starters - asparagus yakiniku, chipotle calamari, truffle guacamole on crispy rice and shiitake, left us smacking our lips and craving for more. The main course was equally good - dynamite prawn and courgette dynamite tacos were yummy. To top off a great afternoon, our daughter was surprised with a complimentary birthday dessert and sake, which made her very happy. We will be back for more.

We visited Los Mochis London City and tried a selection of small plates alongside a couple of cocktails. I did however go with someone who unfortunately doesn't like seafood (so there's a lack of sushi in this review - but luckily Los Mochis caters for all).

For food, the chipotle calamari was good, though I’ve had better elsewhere. The chipotle mayo that came with it was delicious & smokey which made all the difference. The pato on crispy rice (duck) had a tasty batter but was quite heavy, making it tricky to eat with chopsticks but I still thoroughly enjoyed it. The chutoro (medium fatty bluefin tuna) melted on my tongue. Both the shrimp tempura maki rolls and the dynamite prawn tacos were excellent, with the tacos easily my favourite dish of the night: sweet, spicy, and perfectly balanced.

For drinks, the Pepino Jalapeño cocktail was outstanding. Unlike similar versions I’ve had elsewhere, it was refreshing, light, and had just the right gentle kick. It was so good I had to order it again. The margarita was a safe but smooth classic.

Service was polite and attentive throughout. They are strict with table timings, and once our time was up, they kindly moved us over to the bar so we could continue our evening without feeling rushed.

Something I don’t usually review, but worth mentioning: the restrooms. They were impressive - clean, stylish, and with a refreshing yet relaxing ambiance. I love when a restaurant makes a statement with its facilities, and Los Mochis definitely delivered on that.

Overall, Los Mochis offers a great mix of creative Japanese-Mexican dishes, fantastic cocktails, and stylish surroundings. A spot worth visiting, especially for the dynamite prawn tacos, Pepino Jalapeño cocktail, and yes, even the restrooms.

Went with a friend to Los Mochis, we were originally booked for the sushi counter and asked on arrival if there were any standard tables available. They were able to accommodate us straight away and gave us a table next to the window.  We had a selection of dishes as it's small sharing plates paired with a few cocktails. We really enjoyed the food, really good quality and you could taste the different flavours in each dish. Very vibey with a house ambiance on a Friday night. Good for a high end London city date night.
I highly rate the service, they were great at offering recommendations on drinks and dessert and I was able to charge my phone for a bit at the front desk. Also can't not mention a view of St Paul's in the distance.

venues.image_alt: Los Mochis London City — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Wahaca Covent Garden
venues.description: Mexican restaurant with a lively soundtrack for small plates of market-style food & cocktails.

reviews.text:
The menu was expansive and if you're like us and you're not sure what to order, go for the 'Feasting Menu'. It says it's for two but we could share two sets amongst 5 of us, 3 below 15 years old.

The highlight for us were the vegetarian options such as the Sweet Potato & Feta Taquito. The sweet potato was baked and the insides were creamy and sweet. Topped with feta cheese, tomatoes and a mixture of sauces (I have no idea what!) and they just go so well. The Beet Tartare Tostadas was also a splendid surprise. Buttermilk Chicken Tacos and Grilled Brindisa Chorizo Quesadilla were our faves as well.

Just make sure that you make reservations on their website. We were there on a Friday evening and I heard that it was an hour wait if you walk-in.

I can’t recommend Wuhaca in Covent Garden enough. As someone who lives for great vegetarian and vegan food, I found myself returning at least once a day just to try more of their incredible dishes -each one bursting with creativity and flavour.

What makes the experience even better is the team who works there. The staff aren’t just friendly; they’re vibrant, caring, and they clearly enjoy working together, which creates an atmosphere that’s uplifting to be around. By the time you leave, you don’t just feel like a customer- you feel hugged, held, and genuinely cared for.

Wuhaca is more than a restaurant; it’s a place where good food and good people come together in the best way.

We recently celebrated my brother’s birthday at Wahaca, and it was a fantastic experience from start to finish. Even though we arrived without a reservation at 18:30 on August 27th, the hostess greeted us warmly and ensured we were comfortable throughout the evening. The vibrant atmosphere and delicious Mexican cuisine made our meal truly memorable. The staff’s friendly service, especially our hostess, made the occasion special—we hope she knows how much we appreciated her help.

venues.image_alt: Wahaca Covent Garden — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Fonda
venues.description: Fonda is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Fonda provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
FONDA is an upscale, modern Mexican restaurant that specializes in what I would call classics with a twist.

The menu is designed so that each guest should order 3-4 plates and share. It’s a great way to sample many menu items.

We ordered as instructed by the very knowledgeable server and were blown way by the quality and flavor combinations of every dish!

We washed everything down with Fonda Margaritas.

The only drawback is that FONDA is not just expensive it is VERY expensive, socially considering this is Mexican cuisine.

I love Mexican and am willing to pay for great food. (Which I did). I did not expect to walk about paying £428 for 4 people.

Would I go back? Yes, because it was that delicious. I would focus more on the larger mains and less on the small tapas plates that require multiple orders per item to feed the table so they add up quickly!!
Example: £10 for a small plate but then the server advises we order 1 plate per customer so that one “starter” alone was £40.

Second time dining out this week where an automatic 15% gratuity was added to the bill.

This is becoming more and more common here. It’s too bad. There was always something refreshing about the 10-12% gratuity cap. Feeling more like the US these days.

From hearing about this restaurant on the Off Menu podcast I had very high expectations. I can honestly say these expectations were exceeded threefold. The staff were so genuinely passionate about their food and felt so proud to share it - I can see why though it was fantastic. Never did I think I would enjoy a pumpkin seed dip but it was one of the best things I’ve eaten. I can’t wait to go back (hopefully the cheesecake will be back on the menu by then!!!)

We had lunch at Fonda yesterday and were truly impressed by the whole experience. The location itself is beautiful — stylish and welcoming, with a lovely atmosphere that made us feel comfortable and relaxed right away.

The staff were incredibly kind and attentive from the moment we arrived. Their warm hospitality and willingness to help with recommendations really stood out and added a personal touch to our meal.

As for the food — it was simply outstanding. We ordered a variety of dishes to get a good sense of the menu, and every single one exceeded our expectations. Each plate was not only visually appealing but packed with flavor and clearly prepared with high-quality ingredients. It’s clear that the chefs at Fonda take great pride in their work.

Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience. Great location, amazing food, and exceptional service — we couldn’t have asked for more. We’re already looking forward to our next visit!

venues.name: Santo Remedio - Asador, London Bridge
venues.description: Modern take on Mexican street food with casual, idiosyncratic vibe and a creative drinks menu.

reviews.text: We came here with friends and had an amazing evening. We had no reservation but were offered a table right away. The food was amazing and the service was great! Olivia was very attentive and even kept up with us constantly switching between Spanish and English :) many thanks, seguramente volveremos pronto!

Delicious food and great service! My friend and I went for the £44pp tasting menu, which was a fantastic way to sample a variety of dishes. Both my friend and I used to say that we aren't Mexican food fans but we were obviously eating rubbish, this food is exceptional.

The tuna tostada was the standout for me absolutely bursting with flavor.  We had the beef short rib and absolutely every single ingredient owns its space on the dish. Who would have thought plantain and feta cheese go well together?!

The hibiscus margarita was amazing too, super refreshing. Love the fresh guacamole, I regularly order it just to enjoy at home.

The space is cute, homely, and not at all pretentious. Highly recommend, and I will be back in the very near future.

Food tasted good, the reason why my review is only 3 stars was because the prices were just too much for the serving. Serving of the seabass ceviche was so cute, looked like it was a lot on the plate but the plate was super flat. Tacos were good but so tiny, the lamb shank was amazing probably the only reason why I added 2 more stars. We were also shocked that there was a service fee on top plus the tip 💀 Felt like we were only paying for the "Michelin" on the front of their entrance nothing else.

reviews.text:
We had a most memorable experience and meal, went there for El Pastor and Friends with Elena Reygadas.

The food was absolutely fantastic, especially dessert. Drinks were great. Staff is so kind, welcoming, friendly, and attentive, and goes above and beyond. Special thanks to Juan and Mary.

Music selection was great, and ambiance really takes you back to Mexico City. The place does get noisy, but everything else was so good that we didn’t mind.

The pictures really don’t do the food justice. Everything was spectacular.

El Pastor in Soho is a fantastic spot for authentic Mexican food in London. Their salsas with totopos are a must-try, and the tacos and chicken tostadas were full of flavor. Great atmosphere and delicious food, we’ll definitely be back!

My friend and I went there for a cosy lunch, we booked through The Fork and we had 30% off on the food. It was our first time and I have to say that the service is very efficient and all the staff is very polite. The food is fresh and tasty and we shared few dishes. The drinks are tequila's based with different combinations of fruits and flavours. I would definitely recommend this place.

venues.image_alt: El Pastor Soho — international restaurant in Central London

venues.description: Ixchel is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Ixchel provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
We came here for my birthday and was the perfect atmosphere - we were treated with a complimentary dessert as well / staff were very kind.

The star of the show was the beautifully set vibe of the whole restaurant, but the food was equally impressive. The shrimp tacos was my favorite personally and the crab tostadas was my partner’s. We also got a t-bone with a side of potatoes and fresh, warm tortillas which we definitely recommend - meat was very tender, juicy, and seasoned.

Has become my favorite Mexican restaurant in London but is a little bit on the pricier side if you’re looking to get a casual bite.

We had such a lovely Sunday lunch at Ixchel. The restaurant itself is stunning, right on King’s Road, with thoughtful design touches everywhere (even the bathrooms are gorgeous!).

The food was seriously impressive—everything we ordered was so flavourful and beautifully presented. The fish tacos were a real standout and perfectly balanced. You could tell each dish had been prepared with real care and attention to detail. We also noticed a really lovely private dining space downstairs, which looked ideal for a more intimate celebration.

Although the service was a little on the slower side, we honestly didn’t mind. It suited the pace of a long, relaxed lunch, and our servers were genuinely kind and attentive, clearly wanting to make our experience a great one.

We finished with the tres leches cake and it was truly exceptional. Will be thinking about it for a long time!

Ixchel is such a great find—fantastic food, a beautiful atmosphere, and ideal for a slow, indulgent afternoon with good company. We’ll absolutely be back.

Though the space can get lively, the energy adds to the experience. It creates an atmosphere where you can enjoy a fun, social vibe without it ever becoming overwhelming or uncomfortable. Conversations flow easily, and the overall mood is joyful and relaxed.

Whether you’re stopping by for a casual meal, a special occasion, or just looking to try something different, this place delivers on all fronts. With its remarkable food, top-tier service, and inviting ambiance, it leaves a lasting impression. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a truly special dining experience.

venues.name: Wahaca Paddington
venues.description: Mexican restaurant with a lively soundtrack for small plates of market-style food & cocktails.
venues.address: Unit 42, 1 Paddington Sq, London W2 1DL, UK

reviews.text: Everthing thing that came out to our table was fantastic. I have nothing but good things to say about this place. The sunshine bowl was both  vibrantly colorful and delicious. The pork tacos were tender and perfectly seasoned. The drinks were worth it. Highly recommend the trio margaritas. Would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone.

We were looking for someplace to eat near Paddington Station and this came up, but were surprised at how nice it is.

When you first walk in there's a spiral staircase and hanging lights and everything looks clean and modern.

Then when you go upstairs there are decorations that touch on Mexican culture and it's bright with all the huge windows.

When the food comes out, it's equally well presented, like I ordered the Sunshine Bowl, which is basically a salad, but it was so colorful and well arranged that I almost didn't want to eat it. It tasted as good as it looked.

Meanwhile, our waiter, Camacho, was funny and attentive, adding to the likeability of the place.

The bathrooms are clean and modern, although we were a little confused since the stalls are hidden behind paneled doors that look like they're part of the wall.

Then I'm used to leaving the stall and washing my hands outside, but when I went out and didn't see any sinks, I realized it was back inside the stall.

From the decorations, to the food, to the waiter, it was an overall good experience that I'd recommend.
This place is super cool! Food feels very fresh - and was creative and flavorful. They’re great with allergies too. Staff was wonderful and welcoming.

venues.name: Mestizo Chelsea: Mexican Restaurant & Margarita Bar
venues.description: Mestizo Chelsea: Mexican Restaurant & Margarita Bar is a mexican restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Mestizo Chelsea: Mexican Restaurant & Margarita Bar provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine mexican flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Had a wonderful dinner here with friends. We all went for the Taco Tuesday offer of unlimited tacos. As a pescatarian there were plenty of veggie options to choose from. The time in between ordering your tacos and getting the next ones was not too long. Our waiter Damian was also great, very knowledgeable and attentive.

First Time at Mestizo – Blown Away!

I’d never been to an authentic Mexican restaurant before, but after hearing my colleagues talk about how amazing Mestizo is, I had to check it out..and I’m so glad I did! The food was seriously delicious and looked just as good as it tasted.

The place itself has a really cool vibe, perfect for a Friday lunch that eased us right into the weekend. Big shoutout to Prasun who looked after us..his service was spot on and really made the experience even better.

If you’re after some proper good Mexican food and a great atmosphere, I’d definitely recommend giving Mestizo a try. I’ll be back for sure!

Had a lovely experience with my family Saturday afternoon, it was my mother in laws pre birthday dinner.
We particularly enjoyed the atmosphere, which was more informal than expected.  Alberto was our main server, he has a really lovely character and made us felt at ease and respected. He spent time talking us through the menu and guided us to what would suit our group, this is reflected in his staff as well, who are incredibly professional and clearly take pride in their work. We enjoyed our meal (amazing volcano hot pot to share) and as it was a surprise birthday meal, we were given good treatment with dessert and a surprise performance that made my mother in law smiling. Highly recommend this place, we would definitely go back, we were all left feeling content with smiles. Alberto was a fantastic host and super attentive.

venues.image_alt: Mestizo Chelsea: Mexican Restaurant & Margarita Bar — mexican restaurant in Central London

venues.name: El Pastor
venues.description: Tacos al pastor & other South American–inspired food & drinks served in buzzy, colourful digs.

reviews.text: A fun, casual, and delicious spot in Borough Market serving up tasty tacos, guacamole, ceviche and more. We got the beef brisket tacos which comes with salsa verde, al pastor tacos, and agave prawn tacos which were a special. There’s not a lot of filling in each taco so if you’re hungry, order a couple more. The prawn tacos could use a little more flavour, but get yourself a sauce on the side and you’re good. The service was so nice, prompt, and attentive. Also try the mezcal!

Fantastic Mexican food. Started with nacho’s with a choice of 5 dips, watch the hot one, it’s very hot!  I had soft shell crab tacos and then shredded beef tacos. Both were good, but the crab was the best. If you want quiet this isn’t the place for you, it was noisy and busy but that added to the great atmosphere. The staff were also great.

This was my first Mexican restaurant in London, and it did not disappoint.
I adored the crab tacos, al pastor, and the limited crispy potato. The corn cake was just perfect—nothing to add.
If you can’t handle spicy food, just ask them for recommendations. The staff were really helpful and super nice.
A bit expensive, but worth it.

The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Mexican Seoul provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine mexican flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
Fantastic restaurant. The restaurant is welcoming, its lovely and the staff are kind, friendly, and attentive. The food was amazing, so yummy. The pork belly taco was incredible.

They stock PRETTY DECENT pale ale which is brewed right next door. Best of all, the food tastes amazingly authentic to both Mexico and Korea. It's really tasty.

This was quite a find and worth our trek all the way from SW London! We arrived 45min early on a Sunday and just whiling away the time by walking by the restaurant to check out the menu and the surrounding area but was immediately greeted by the friendly and consummate host Patrick. When we returned shortly before opening, we were immediately seated in the pleasant outdoor area. We started with the absolutely delicious Drunken Egg salad - the eggs perfectly marinated and the yolks beautifully jammy. This was followed by the generously portioned Bulgogi Beef Tacos. But you definitely come here because of the Korean style wings, in our case the Soy Garlic Butter version which was spectacular. Going slightly out of order, we then added the Elote Ribs, which upon tasting, we deemed an excellent decision. Oh wow, that sweet firm corn paired with all kinds of umami was just 👌!  They only have one dessert choice and when the Banana Fritters are this good, they don’t really need another, do they? Is Mexican and Korean a match made in heaven? I suggest you go and find out for yourself!

First time coming here and it was so good!
From the time we arrived to when we left, we had great service from the guys there. The wings were so crispy and delicious 😋!  So much flavour! And the beef tacos were my favourite, what a great fusion paired with soju. Thank you Mexican Seoul!

venues.image_alt: Mexican Seoul — mexican restaurant in Central London

venues.description: Upbeat, party-style Cuban/Mexican-themed bar and salsa club for tequila, tacos and nachos.
venues.address: 64-65 Wilton Rd, Pimlico, London SW1V 1DE, UK

reviews.text: Loved the place. Just had the spicy beef nachos and spicy chicken nachos and both were tasty and amazing, well sized portions as well. Excellent service from staff and thoroughly enjoyed the evening. Place was super busy but waited for it to empty a bit to take photos

This restaurant has a fun atmosphere and friendly staff. We appreciated that they were willing to make a special margarita we requested, though my partner had to go up to the bar to place the order. The food was fresh and flavourful — the pulled pork was tasty but a bit too wet for our liking. Overall, a good spot for casual Mexican fare with great drink options.

This place is amazing, absolutely well worth a visit. The food was fantastic and the pitcher of margaritas was pretty good too🤣 the staff was so friendly and provided some sombreros for our entertainment! But behind all the fun the food was truly excellent.

reviews.text: Not adventurous eaters here so we let our server choose the dishes we shared. Excellent recommendations!  As for dessert, the dark chocolate tartlet was perfect. Not too rich and a hint of raspberry. The Basque style pumpkin cheesecake was exquisite. Very subtle flavor, light texture and the familiar flavor of fall without shoving pumpkin spice in your face. Michael opines The pumpkin flavor was like the perfume of a lovely lady, noticed after she has long passed as if a mere memory. Also, Sorry, but we got the fun brother.

Wow 🤩 This place was so amazing today. I had done a wee bit of touristing in the morning but my flight back to Inverness wasn’t until 1835 so I had a bit of time to kill and was (as usual) hungry for some amazing food. Well Chicome did not disappoint. The team, led by the fantastico Maxim, were so attentive and knowledgeable that I was blown away. I was made to feel most welcome at a table for one and sampled the most delicious small plates and wine in the most relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. Maxim had some special recommendations which were nailed on. Highly recommend. Thank you team Chicome ❤️

What a little gem of a restaurant. From the warm welcome of service, to the three outstanding courses, everything was delivered to a high quality standard. Superb value for money with the tableware, skilled kitchen team and well trained front of house team.

reviews.text:
Great little store and experience - thank you! Muchas gracias!
I'm English but live in Mexico with my Mexican husband. My elderly father loves Mexican food, salsas, snacks, and candies so I always bring things back to the UK with me for him, but we don't get to see him as often as we'd like so I was happy to have found this store in London to send him a Mexican care package! He was thrilled!
Friendly service and fast delivery. Thanks!

Love this little gem of a shop. If you are into cooking Mexican food then this place is your Aladins cave. Impressive range and quality. And they are incredibly nice people too. They mainly sell online but i always prefer to go and pick up.
Great selection! So pleased I found this place. But expensive but that’s to be expected with imported goods. Haven’t tasted the tortillas yet but they smell divine 🥰

venues.name: The Great Chase
venues.description: Modern venue with a warm atmosphere prepping elevated British halal fare & alcohol-free cocktails.
venues.address: 6G Esther Anne Pl, London N1 1WL, UK

reviews.text:
My wife and I came here to celebrate our anniversary and had a fantastic experience from start to finish. We were seated right next to the food preparation station, which gave the evening a lively, behind-the-scenes feel and let us watch the chefs at work.

For starters we shared the BBQ bone marrow and tahini salad — both beautifully prepared and full of flavour. For mains we chose the lamb roast and the fillet steak; each dish was perfectly cooked, tender, and seasoned just right. To finish, we had the tiramisu and sticky toffee pudding — both indulgent and the perfect sweet ending.

The staff were warm and attentive throughout, and a special shout-out to the chef who was especially friendly and made the night feel personal.

A memorable evening, amazing food, and a lovely atmosphere — highly recommend

An outstanding dining experience from start to finish.
The lamb roast was tender and flavorful, while the dry-aged beef was simply exceptional — rich, perfectly cooked, and full of depth.
Service was top-tier: professional, warm, and attentive without being overbearing. Every detail, from the food to the presentation, was impeccable.
To finish it all off we tried the sticky toffee pudding and oh my god I was blown away.!
It a must try.. ❤️❤️
Truly a top-notch spot. Highly recommended.

We went to this restaurant for our anniversary, as we had heard it was a nice place that served halal food. We had booked a table in advance. Despite this, we had to wait about 10 minutes before we were seated. Our mojito arrived with ice, but the drink itself was warm, so we had to wait for it to cool down.

For starters, we ordered bone marrow and mushroom soup. The bone marrow was so hot that I burned my mouth, but it tasted great. The soup was basically cooking cream blended with mushrooms—it looked like baby porridge. The taste was fine, but nothing special.

For the main course, we ordered harissa lamb, which had absolutely no flavor and no spices. The plating was also unattractive and messy. We also ordered a sirloin steak, which again tasted like nothing at all—I even had to ask for salt and pepper just to get some flavor.

Overall, we left very disappointed and would definitely not recommend this restaurant.

venues.name: Coco Grill & Lounge
venues.description: Haute choice with Tower Bridge & river views offering halal global provisions, mocktails & shisha.
venues.vicinity: Butlers Wharf Bldg, 34a Shad Thames, London

reviews.text: Wow! This place is located at a very lovely location. The food was 10 google stars, the duck rolls, mixed kebab, ribeye steak. All cooked perfectly. Loved the decor, the staff were excellent. Lovely and polite. The fudge cake melts your mouth. We had an amazing birthday dinner there.  I will deffo book this one again in the future.

Coco Grill and Lounge is absolutely fantastic! The food was amazing  fresh, flavorful, and beautifully served. The chicken burger was especially delicious, juicy and perfectly cooked. The drinks were just as impressive. The mango mojito was refreshing and full of flavor, and the Oreo milkshake was creamy, rich, and the perfect treat. On top of that, the service was outstanding friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Definitely a place I’ll be coming back to again and again!

Had a delicious business lunch with a beautiful view at CoCo restaurant. The food was tasty, and I especially loved how perfectly crispy yet tender my fish was. The mango mocktail was a bit on the sweet side, but very refreshing. The service was excellent—they kindly charged both my laptop and phone without hesitation, and everything was served promptly. Sitting outside with a view of the Thames made the whole experience even better. Thank you

reviews.text: The food was amazing, service was quick, great location, there is always a queue due to how popular this place is but it moves very swiftly. How have I never frequented this place before? It's so amazingly good! The price is also cheap and the portion is big!

Similar to New York 🇺🇸OG branch!
Nearly matches original expectation but great enough for London for sure.
Top food ! 5* would recommend for sure.

You can sit on the nearby stone plinth facing the store,  but don’t make a mess try keep London clean thanks.
Visited 20th August 2025

Very very good food. Got full from the regular size and one person ate from. Also ordered the large size for two people, didn’t get really full from that but two people were sharing so yeah. Be careful from the hot sauce it was really strong.

The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Taste of Lahore provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. reviews.text: The Taste of Lahore reminded of restaurants in Pakistan with the over abundance of bright track lighting and chandeliers. The food and service were fantastic, we thoroughly enjoyed every dish. We ordered the Chapli kebab, masala fish, tandoori chicken wings, and Seekh kebabs. Each dish was executed perfectly and full of flavor. Two of my friends never had Chapli kebabs before and they thoroughly enjoyed it. Highly recommend for traditional Pakistani food and great service.

I visited Test of Lahore in Edgware and while the ambiance was nice, the experience overall was disappointing. Coming from Canada, I expected authentic Pakistani food to really stand out, but honestly I’ve had better taste back home in Calgary.

The service was quite slow — our BBQ dishes arrived about 20 minutes before the naan and other mains, which meant the BBQ got cold by the time we could actually eat it. The food itself was just average, nothing memorable.

With so many good reviews, I was hoping for more. Unfortunately, the slow service and average flavors didn’t make it worth the wait.

We had a wonderful experience in this restaurant.
The food was sooo good. Specially the rice & the chicken korma.
Excellent service by the staff. Thank you Emmy for your excellent service

venues.image_alt: Taste of Lahore — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Meet Bros (by Me’nate x Jibby&co.)
venues.description: Meet Bros (by Me’nate x Jibby&co.) is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Meet Bros (by Me’nate x Jibby&co.) provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Amazing food and service. We got served by Tahleel, great guy. Made us feel welcome and was really helpful and polite. The wait is quite long but granted it was a Saturday and there’s a seating area for you to wait until your table is ready. Would recommend you book a table in advance otherwise you’ll most likely get sent away, it’s that busy and we weren’t surprised as to why as the food is great. Nonetheless, service was great, Food was cooked perfectly, great flavours, atmosphere was beautiful. We recommend getting the Sando’s and spring rolls for starters. Thank you to Tahleel and the Meet Bro’s team for making me and my partners evening delightful.

From start to finish, our experience at this restaurant was nothing short of exceptional. We arrived without a reservation and, despite how busy it was, we were warmly welcomed and seated within just 15 minutes. That alone already set a positive tone for the evening.

We began with starters of spring rolls and ribeye beef. Both were perfectly prepared — the spring rolls were crisp, golden, and packed with flavour, while the ribeye beef was tender and rich, cooked exactly how it should be. Moving on to mains, we chose the fillet mignon and the Asian-style carbonara. The fillet mignon was melt-in-your-mouth perfection, bursting with flavour in every bite, and the carbonara was a creative twist on a classic — beautifully balanced with a unique Asian flair that worked incredibly well.

For dessert, we indulged in the pineapple turnover and the baked apple filo pastry. They were both heavenly — light, sweet, and the perfect way to end the meal. You could really taste the thought and effort put into each dish from start to finish.

The décor added so much to the experience too. Modern, stylish, and atmospheric, it gave the restaurant such a warm and inviting feel.

A special mention must go to our waiter, Tahleel. His service was outstanding — attentive without ever being intrusive, knowledgeable about the menu, and genuinely friendly. He went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and made the whole evening even more enjoyable.

This restaurant truly ticks every box: fantastic food, beautiful surroundings, and first-class service. It’s rare to find a place that excels in all three, but this one does it effortlessly. We will most definitely be back and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for an unforgettable dining experience.

Spectacular food and lightning fast service, the steak sando, chicken wings and apple filo pastry dessert were unbelievably good, rest of the good also top tier. The midnight blue mocktail is beautiful.

Amazing interior in the form of a stone labyrinth, just stunning. Will be back 100% and Oasis perfectly looked after us.

venues.image_alt: Meet Bros (by Me’nate x Jibby&co.) — international restaurant in Central London

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
One of the best halal food places I’ve tried in Central London near the BT Tower! The taste is unmatched, portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable. The staff are friendly and supportive, making the whole experience even better. They also have a convenient self-checkout system for ordering food, which is quick and easy. Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for top-quality halal food in London.

⭐️⭐️⭐️ (Okay, but could be better)**

The food was decent, but the experience didn’t quite live up to expectations. The service was slow—we waited in a long queue just to get our portion, and the cramped seating made it hard to enjoy the meal comfortably. The chicken had an oddly artificial texture, which was disappointing for the price.

If you’re looking for a quick, reliable bite in the area, you might find better value elsewhere. Hopefully, they can improve on speed and quality control!

Chicken on salad was delicious, and an amazing value. White sauce tasted kinda like ranch. Green sauce is minty. Red sauce has a nice kick.

£10.5 with extra protein.

reviews.text: This restaurant is a real gem. The Persian stews were full of depth and flavour, the rice cooked to absolute perfection, and the aroma from the kitchen was simply unforgettable a true showcase of the chef’s skill. Everything we tried was fresh, tasty, and perfectly prepared. The service was spot on quick, friendly, and professional without ever feeling rushed. You can really tell they care about both the food and the customers. I’ll definitely be coming back.

We had an amazing experience at Naroon Fitzrovia. The food and atmosphere were both fantastic — everything we tried was delicious, but the chicken was truly out of this world.

A special mention goes to Nader, whose service was exceptional. He was attentive, professional, and made us feel genuinely welcomed from start to finish. Any restaurant would be lucky to have him run and represent them.

Highly recommend and can’t wait to return!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A Lamb Shank That Took Me Back in Time

This wasn’t just a lamb shank it was an experience, a journey straight back to childhood memories I didn’t even know I’d tucked away. The very first bite stopped me in my tracks. The meat was so tender it practically slipped off the bone, no effort needed, just pure melt-in-the-mouth perfection.

The flavor balance was unreal just the right hint of smokiness, kissed with a touch of sweetness, rounded off with the perfect level of spice that warmed rather than overpowered. It was comfort and elegance in the same mouthful.

Every bite felt emotional, like revisiting a place and time that only food this soulful can unlock. It wasn’t just dinner it was memory, tradition, and craftsmanship served on a plate. Hands down, the best lamb shank I have ever had in my life.

And it wasn’t just the food. The staff were incredible. We actually booked the café by mistake instead of the restaurant, but instead of turning us away, they went out of their way to look after us. They even brought the lamb shank over from the restaurant to the café  going that extra mile that you don’t see often anymore.

venues.image_alt: Naroon Fitzrovia — international restaurant in Central London

venues.description: PAR LONDON - PAK AL REYAN RESTAURANT is a international restaurant located in London. reviews.text: Very nice fries and club sandwich. Not too sure about the egg inside, would be better with real cheese instead of the plastic slices. Stayed crispy and didn't go soggy. Liked the packaging.

We tried Desi Nashta, club sandwich and cheese paratha. Taste was amazing and delicious. Good Environment and Excellent Hygiene.
strongly Recommend Every one to give it a try.

We had a lovely desi breakfast served by the sweetest staff Aksha & Ravneet.
We will definitely be returning again very soon! :)
Thank you!!

Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Babel Grill House provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
Food was good but on the platter they had one of the fish dish missing, they did replace it with something else.
Some of the fish lacked flavour so had to add some salt. The prawns were the highlight.

The service was good but a bit slow. Good customer service and mostly attentive. Might have been understaffed.

The decor was good as you can see from the pictures. The restaurant had a good atmosphere. The group I came with might have been a bit too loud (sorry).

I would recommend this place to visit and might even come again

The chicken and lamb grill were unbelievably juicy and full of flavor, and the baklava was the perfect sweet ending. The interior is beautiful with its colorful lanterns and cozy vibe, and the staff were very polite and welcoming. A must-visit spot for amazing food and great hospitality!

I'd call it a hidden gem. It's tucked away in Brick Lane, pretty easy to miss.
Atmosphere is good and food is right on spot: juicy, great mix of rice and vegetables and don't let the salad fool you. I wanted spicy and it was one of the spiciest I had in London.

venues.image_alt: Babel Grill House — international restaurant in Central London

venues.address: Grand Plaza, 42 Prince's Square, London W2 4AD, UK

reviews.text: This is a Malaysian style restaurant inside of the Grand Plaza Service Apartments.   The menu has good options of Malaysian dishes.   The dishes are tasty and well cooked.   Overall, a good experience here.

The location is slightly hidden but it has made this a hidden gem. The food was absolutely incredible, the pastry on the curry puffs was so flaky and the chicken curry with the nasi lemak was so flavourful.
We also got chicken satay and char kway teow which were also delicious. The server was so nice and service was quick. The food all came out hot and fresh and we enjoyed it so much.
As an FYI you need to go through a hotel to get to it, which is fine but can make it difficult to find!

A Malaysian food taste authentic experience. Portion is good. They have outdoor , indoor and 2nd storey seatings. Located inside the Grand Plaza apartments. Service was friendly. Price wise a bit expensive.

venues.name: The Banc
venues.description: Airy, modern restaurant for steaks, burgers & more, plus a 2-storey shisha lounge.
venues.address: 261-263 W Green Rd, London N15 3BH, UK

reviews.text: Amazing experience, went for my nieces birthday and we all loved it. The waiter Vish was so attentive with outstanding customer service. The food was on point and so flavoursome, we will most definitely be back. We chose to visit at the lunch time and am so glad as it was so peaceful atmosphere. Thank you for taking such good care of us.

We had an incredible time dining at The Banc. The drinks were incredible and the food was even better!!!! The meat was tender and perfect texure, the dynamite prawns were perfectly spicy and everything else 10/10. The ambience was very fun, the service was absolutely incredible and very speedy as well as amazing music that the DJ was playing! We will be back!

Had dinner here on a Friday night around 8pm and the atmosphere was brilliant — lively but not too loud. The staff were welcoming, attentive, and made us feel really looked after despite how busy it was. The food came out quickly and every dish was packed with flavour, beautifully presented, and really good portions for the price. The cocktails were also excellent and paired perfectly with the meal. Overall, The Banc delivered on both quality and service — definitely a spot I’d recommend for a fun evening out in London.

venues.image_alt: The Banc — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Grounded London
venues.description: Easygoing coffee house with eclectic international offerings for breakfast, lunch & dinner.

reviews.text: Was here for lunch on a weekday. Quite cozy and staff were friendly and helpful. Ordered smoked salmon with poached eggs and a side order of sweet potato fries which were great. The area is quite busy.

Delicious halal breakfast! I ordered the egg & turkey bacon breakfast, and my wife ordered the full English. Loved the fresh Acai smoothie and delicious cappucino. £45 for two is well worth it!
Take note, no reservations here so if you're coming with a party of more than 2, you'll be waiting a while.

The food here was excellent – very filling and full of flavor! Great value for money as the portions are generous for the price. The atmosphere is also really nice and makes it a great place to enjoy a meal.

The only thing I’d suggest improving is the size of the restaurant, as it feels a bit small and can get crowded during busy times. Other than that, everything was great! Definitely recommend.

venues.image_alt: Grounded London — international restaurant in Tower Hamlets
