In summary, Core by Clare is a remarkable dining destination that combines exquisite food, attentive service, and a welcoming atmosphere. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone seeking a memorable culinary adventure.

What a fantastic evening we had at Core. We were placed at the chef's table, which gave us the opportunity to see the kitchen. The kitchen was busy but orderly and very quiet. Clare was there overseeing each dish that left the kitchen.  The service was exceptional, fast, professional but unobtrusive.  The food presentation was imaginative and beautiful. We had the Classic taster menu, from which my froends substituted a couple of dishes. That was a great and flexible service.
The food was an explosion of various tastes and colour. The menu was new reflecting the seasonal changes with produce from local farms.
Although the portions looked small, I was full long before the desert came.
I would like to take family there again to enjoy this lovely place.

Core is a 3 Michelin star restaurant for a reason. Everything was amazingly delicious and beautiful. The staff were very friendly and personable. I had called ahead to inquire if they could accommodate my fish and shellfish allergy and they kindly made me a special menu.
I also want to clarify for anyone who might be skeptical about the size of the dishes in fine dining restaurants like Core; I promise you will leave VERY full and VERY satisfied!

venues.name: Club Gascon - French Michelin Starred Restaurant
venues.description: Southwest French menu with all sorts of foie gras dishes in formal, marble-and-wood setting.
venues.vicinity: St Bartholomew House, 57 W Smithfield, London

reviews.text:
My partner secretly booked this restaurant for my birthday, and it was an unforgettable experience from start to finish. The staff were so welcoming and knowledgeable, which made us feel truly taken care of.

We chose the full set menu with wine pairing, and every dish was incredible. As a French person, I can be a bit critical when it comes to food (we French take it very seriously 😉), but here everything was simply perfect. One highlight for me was an artichoke dish by Chef Pascal, with just one bite, it brought me straight back to a childhood memory. It’s truly amazing when a chef can create food that evokes such deep emotions!

We were also very grateful to the Chef and his team for taking the time to show us around the kitchen and share a moment with us. It made the evening feel even more special and memorable.

I had the most wonderful birthday celebration here, and it’s an experience I’ll always remember. Thank you so much to the whole team!

We had a wonderful evening at the Club Gascon on 7th August. The food is of an amazing standard complemented by original and unique presentations which really add to the whole culinary experience.
Everyone of the dishes was delicious.  The service was attentive, friendly and professional. The atmosphere was relaxed and sophisticated in a decor of impeccable standard.
We really enjoyed everything about the evening, will definitely return and would recommend.
We certainly feel that the price was very reasonable for the quality of this experience.
A big thank you to the team for a very lovely evening making our special occasion perfect.

Club Gascon offers a refined, inventive cuisine in a beautiful warm and cozy setting. The food is of superb quality, and although not every dish in their 6 or 8 courses menu will please everyone, the quality of the food and the creativity of the pairings makes it an enriching dining experience.

The service is very kind and attentive. I would recommend the wine pairing as it paired beautifully with the food, and was very tasty.

The restaurant more than deserves its Michelin star, and in my opinion is a must-visit for anyone looking for a calm fine dining experience in London. The setting of the restaurant is also fantastic around Smithfield Market, on the northern boundary of the City of London, a stone’s throw away from Farringdon Elizabeth Line station entrance.

venues.name: HUMO
venues.description: HUMO is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, HUMO provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 12 St George St, London W1S 2FB, UK

reviews.text:
Had an enjoyable experience for dinner. Complementary small bites were very welcome. The highlights were the grilled menu items and in particular the lamb. Their lamb was slightly gamier than expected but I liked it anyways. Great sauces and garnish. The shrimp dish was also very tasty.

I only have one issue which was the lack of carbs on the menu.

Restaurant is very pretty to look at and is meticulously designed from floor to ceiling.

Service was friendly and excellent.

Awesome experience...had booked the upstairs tasting menu but on arrival was told there was a cancellation at the chef's table and asked if I'd like to eat downstairs. Food was outstanding...high-quality ingredients, and most dishes were grounded in tradition but featured fun and creative twists. Delicious. One of the stand-outs: the salad (salad???). Hearing the stories directly from the chef was fun, and despite his obvious talents he seems like a very grounded and humble guy, easy to talk with and ready to ask questions. Also one of the stronger curated wine pairings I've had at a fine dining restaurant recently.

We had such an incredible experience here.
Firstly the food is amazing, each dish was perfect and couldn’t fault them. Such a depth of flavour and very well balanced.
The atmosphere is great, love the open kitchen so you can see the flames they are cooking on. It can get hot if you are sat next to the kitchen but I saw they give people little fans to help with the heat.
The staff have great attention to detail. We loved the careful explanations for each part of the dish, and suggestions on which order to eat them.

venues.name: Cycene
venues.description: Cycene is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Cycene provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: Cycene, 9 Chance St, London E2 7JB, UK

reviews.text: A tremendous evening of hospitality.  Keen focus on British ingredients leveraging local producers, a rooftop garden, and foraging.  All British wine pairings available, as well as a soft beverage pairing that my son absolutely loved.  Could not recommend more strongly when in Shoreditch!

We came for dinner and really enjoyed the experience from the bar to kitchen to dining area. The service was refined yet friendly. There were some interesting flavours in the 15 courses but everything worked for me. My favourites were the A5 wagyu snack, crab, wagyu and scallop (supplement) and the pigeon. This is definitely a special occasion place but I highly recommend it!

Cycene, named after the Old English word for “kitchen”. Cycene is contemporary British restaurant. The current Head Chef is Taz Sarhane Known for his innovative approach to modern British cuisine. He has developed a passion for ingredient preservation techniques like fermenting and dry-aging.
The menu format is tasting menu only of ten courses, with just 15 customers at capacity in total. They source British ingredients.
The design space is intimate with details include wooden panelling.

venues.name: Wild Honey St James
venues.description: Sophisticated restaurant & bar offering refined seasonal produce & contemporary French cooking.

reviews.text:
My wife and I had the pre-theatre dinner in Wild Honey and it was amazing food for the price.
We paid £59 each for 3 courses, which included pre-starters, canele, champagne and coffee.
The food was faultless, duck terrine, torched mackerel, chicken, sea bass and panacotta. It was all really delicious, top drawer food and the portions were really generous.
The staff were great, kind, friendly and helpful and we met chef patron Anthony Demetre, who was great and we had a lovely chat with him.
Thank you Wild Honey for a truly memorable evening.

We were having lunch in year 2023.
We had Today’s menu 3 courses. I am writing review now because I miss the dishes very much.
The dishes in the restaurant really show its values. I like the vibe of the restaurant for sure. The set winter tomatoes is truely unforgettable.

Good value with the £45 pre-theatre meal, however I was a little disappointed. Don't get me wrong, the food wasn't bad at all - much better than the average restaurant - just a little underwhelming.

Each dish was tasty and evidently cooked well, but with each one felt like it needed more. Dishes were tasty, but not quite exceptional.
For example, the beef tongue starter with peppercorn sauce had a good, very soft and tender texture, but was a little lacking in flavour. As it hit the tongue I thought it was cooked well, but I didn't feel anything special, unlike other michelin starred restaurants I've tried.

However for £45 it was definitely good value for money. I'll be back when the menus change to give it another try.

venues.name: The Ninth
venues.description: Casual restaurant with romantic first-floor space, serving French-influenced Mediterranean cuisine.

reviews.text:
Had the set lunch which was excellent value for money.

Ingredients were fresh and the food was perfectly presented. I enjoyed the crab pasta starter. But there was nothing about the food that stood out. Even the recommended potato side dish was pleasant but not something I'd dream about. It was overall a very pleasant and above average experience but forgettable.

Visited last week for the early dinner set menu. Excellent value for money: a three course michelin starred dinner for £38 per person. There were two of us eating so we tried all the meat options (vegetarian options available, but we didn't try those)

The whole meal was lovely, but there was a few dishes in particular which were amazing. The cured trout starter tasted very fresh, with a simple yet delicious flavour, topped with roe. The pork tenderloin was cooked excellently, texture was almost like a filet mignon, but with the rich flavours of pork. Pain perdu with tonka bean dessert was a lovely end to the meal, not too sweet, just how I like it. The other dishes were also excellent.

Overall a great restaurant, well deserving of its michelin star. I'll definitely have to come again to try the à la carte menu.

Lovely dinner, food was delicious.
Scallops were fresh and delicate. Both the beef cheek & tongue, and the Iberico pork pluma were exceptionally tender and flavourful.
We ordered two of their pastas - the squid ink malloreddus and truffle conchiglie. Both were lovely, even my husband who doesn’t eat much pasta loved them a lot.

Both desserts we had were nice but their signature Pain Perdu is a must, perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

Waitress was very friendly and informative, we were not in a rush but noticed the service was a tad slow though. Can’t comment on the wine pairings as we didn’t order this.

venues.image_alt: The Ninth — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: The Ritz Restaurant
venues.description: High-end British–French dining in baroque-style  gilded salon with ceiling frescoes and chandeliers.

reviews.text: Having enjoyed Afternoon Tea and the Rivoli Bar at the Ritz in the past, I now wanted to try out the restaurant. I visited for the breakfast service. The atmosphere is really fantastic. The coffee, orange juice, English breakfast and Eggs Benedict were very good. The only thing I noticed was that the hash brown was a bit hard on the edges and therefore a little difficult to cut. I would have liked a little more attention to detail with the service. I had to actively ask for a new juice. Otherwise the staff were all very kind. Overall, it was a great experience that I would like to repeat in the future.

Wahhhhh, Sunday lunch at The Ritz.
Art des table for 4 people.
Started with a warm welcome and clear instructions from the doorman. Rivoli Bar for a cocktail, very helpful member of staff to explain the extensive menu. Cocktails were very good. Then walking through the main halls to the restaurant was beautiful and greeted and brought to our table effortlessly.
Introduced to waiters and sommelier and so we began. Stunning amuse bouche, fish cookery and sauces stunning, beef Wellington good, sauces and potatoes amazing. Pre desert stunning and the crepe suzette amazing...
Sommelier was possibly the highlight. Warm, welcoming and loved talking, explaing and recommending a few wines. His manner and professionalism was exemplary.
What a fantastic experience.

Absolutely sublime experience at the Ritz! Every bit as fancy and impressive as it was expensive! Definitely worth it however for taste of food presentation quality and ambiance. We went for my mom’s birthday on 9/16/25 and dined on the 7 course meal. Of note for the course meals everyone in the table has to do the same experience. This delectable delight had the perfect amount of savory and sweet and was definitely good enough portion size to be filling as well. Each course was a culinary delight with robust well paired flavors that lended to the next dish. The service was also outstanding everyone was attentive courteous and well versed on presentation of the dishes. The ambiance was also amazing quite striking elegance in a more intimate setting. They additionally made mention of my mom’s birthday and ensured that this was recognized. I appreciated their hard work and dedication to making my moms birthday meal memorable

venues.name: Ormer Mayfair
venues.description: Carefully sourced British ingredients take centre stage in this wood-panelled hotel dining room.
venues.address: Flemings Mayfair, 7-12 Half Moon St, 7-12 Half Moon St, London W1J 7BH, UK
venues.vicinity: Flemings Mayfair, 7-12 Half Moon St, 7-12 Half Moon St, Mayfair, London

reviews.text: I really love this place! The food is super delicious. You can see the love in every dish, right down to the details. The service is amazing. If you enjoy wine pairing, the sommelier here is adorable—friendly, knowledgeable, and fun to chat with. All the staff are so cheerful and welcoming. It’s perfect from the start to the end. I’ll definitely be coming back with my family and close friends!

We dined at the  Ormer Mayfair while staying at the Flemming Mayfair, September 11-12, 2025..  The five-course tasting menu was exceptional in creativity, presentation and taste. The service throughout the meal was impeccable and our sommelier brought us some exceptional wines.  Of special note during the meal were the broth, roast Yorkshire duck and a dessert made with a blown candy shell and mascarpone filling.  A wonderful evening at an outstanding restaurant.

The service at Omer Mayfair is outstanding, innovative, cool, and contemporary. The staff are knowledgeable and clearly well-trained. They do talk a bit too much for my taste, but their energy and friendliness make the experience lively.
The space, however, is less impressive. It is located in a basement with a slightly musty, old-fashioned feel that does not match the fresh, modern service style. I loved the service pieces, with creative tableware that added personality, and wish the rest of the space had that same sense of originality.
The food was technically excellent, with precise seasoning, proper cuisson, and beautifully composed plates. But I felt like I had eaten a similar version of every dish before. There was almost no sense of surprise or creativity. If you are going to serve such small portions, each dish has to be mind-blowing, and here they simply were not. The Moroccan influence was barely noticeable, showing up only in a few small details.
The dessert was the highlight of the evening. It finally had the fusion surprise elements I wish every other dish had. I also appreciated the chocolate offered when leaving.

venues.name: HIDE
venues.description: A three floor space in a contemporary setting with elevated morning to late-night dining options.

reviews.text: We had great dinner at HIDE. The restaurant has beautiful atmosphere. All dishes were delicious and very well balanced. The highlight of our dinner was monk fish and scallops. The selection of wine is amazing. The service is top notch.

What a fantastic experience from start to finish! This place is truly a gem, the bar is elegant, classy, and the drinks are next level. I tried one with watermelon, and wow, what a taste! The ambiance is wonderful, with a lovely aroma throughout. We enjoyed a couple of drinks, and everything was absolutely delicious. Even the bathrooms are impressive!

The food was excellent — fresh flavors, beautifully balanced, and presented with a clean, refined aesthetic. Each dish reflected great attention to detail in execution.

Unfortunately, the service fell short of the same standard. While the plates spoke for themselves, the experience was let down when our waiter began walking away midway through explaining a dish. It disrupted the flow and diminished what should have been a polished, engaging moment.

Overall, the cooking deserves recognition, but service consistency needs to match the quality coming out of the kitchen for the experience to truly shine.

venues.image_alt: HIDE — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Frog by Adam Handling Restaurant Covent Garden
venues.description: Flagship restaurant of chef Adam Handling, using local ingredients on a contemporary seasonal menu.

attributions: Frog by Adam Handling Restaurant Covent Garden
Frog by Adam Handling Restaurant Covent Garden
Frog by Adam Handling Restaurant Covent Garden
Frog by Adam Handling Restaurant Covent Garden

reviews.text: I had an amazing night. I felt welcome and taken care of the moment I walked in. I sat at the counter. Because I love watching the chefs and they did an amazing job. So calm. So concentrated. The food they sent out was perfect. The tasting menu gave me so many different foods. And I loved that the Michelin Star food felt so personal and homely. When the staff tells so you to spoon the gravy with the bread you are in the right place 😊 A Michelin star restaurant where you can your fingers dirty, And the wine pairing. Perfect. The sommelier knows what he is doing. Just listening to him makes your evening. Thanks to the whole team for a perfect night.

We revisited Frog by Adam Handling after eight years, this time celebrating a friend’s 21st birthday. We’d previously enjoyed the private dining room downstairs, but for this occasion we chose the main dining space upstairs.

We opted for the lunch menu, which began with three amuse-bouches, followed by Parker House bread and butter, a fish course, a duck course, dessert, and petits fours. One of the highlights is that you can bring your own wine at lunch with no corkage fee (though there is one at dinner).

The interior is vibrant, with an open-plan kitchen, bench-style seating, and bold artwork—including modern takes on portraits of the late Queen and the current King. We sat at a circular table near the window with its striking white rubber surface.

Amuse-bouches
•	Tuna & herbs: a delicate pastry cup filled with tuna and topped with bright herbs.
•	Crab, green chilli, buckwheat: a crisp cylindrical shell filled with white and brown crab meat, subtly spiced.
•	Chicken & egg: crispy chicken skin served inside an egg—imaginative and delicious.

Bread & butter
The Parker House bread was warm and beautifully presented in a tear-apart loaf. The standout, though, was the butter: chicken skin butter with a rich chicken parfait centre, elegantly shaped like a rose.

Palate cleanser
A cucumber tea served between courses was refreshing but fairly simple compared to the other dishes.

Fish course
Cod with courgette and smoked fish elements. The presentation was stunning, with courgette prepared in several ways. However, the portion of cod itself was surprisingly small.

Meat course
Merrifield duck with apricot and cobnuts. The sauce was superb, though the duck portion was again on the small side.

Dessert
Verbena, Earl Grey, and peach—a beautifully balanced dessert that was tart, sweet, slightly sour, and visually elegant.

Petits fours
A seeded madeleine served with cream and raspberry jam. Pleasant, though not as memorable as the other courses.

Service & atmosphere
The service was warm, attentive, and interactive throughout. Adam Handling wasn’t in the kitchen during our visit but did make an appearance in the dining room, as his family was also dining there.

Afterwards, we noted that the cocktail bar Eve, located downstairs, opens at 4pm—a stylish spot to continue the afternoon with drinks.

We went here on a Thursday lunchtime for the lunch tasting menu as a birthday treat for my husband. We were shown to our table and given the wine list whilst the server showed us some options for champagne, myself had some fizz whilst the husband had a glass of red wine. The food was sensational. Each course was brought to us with a description of what the dish was and the inspiration behind the dish.
We had 5 courses and each got better and better! The lamb main courses and strawberry desert were a highlight for me. My husband went for the extra cheese course, which he said was outstanding. The truffle honey was deliecious . 100% recommend this restaurant, friendly service, and an amazing experience. I can't wait to return!

venues.image_alt: Frog by Adam Handling Restaurant Covent Garden — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Scully
venues.description: Hip, wood-hued eatery serving artfully plated seasonal flavors from Australia to India & Ireland.
venues.address: 4 St James's Market, London SW1Y 4AH, UK
venues.vicinity: Rex House, 4 St James's Market, London

reviews.text: Attended the London Restaurant Festival event on 17/09/2025. The food was superb! I can’t recommend this restaurant enough. The food was exceptional, the service was amazing and the overall vibe was phenomenal. I will definitely be back!

Scully in St. James’s delivers one of the most exciting dining experiences in London. Every dish bursts with bold, unexpected flavours—think rich spices, clever pickling, and perfect balance. The open kitchen and shelves of colourful ferments set the tone, while the service is warm and knowledgeable.

From bold welcome snacks like spiced chickpeas and tendon crackers with oyster cream to vegetable-driven stars like forbidden rice or a delicate tomato-strawberry-coconut salad, every dish feels thoughtful yet off-beat

A true gem for adventurous food lovers.

Scully, Chef Ramael Scully, born in Malaysia to a mother of Chinese and Indian heritage and an Irish-Balinese father. He grew up in Sydney. Chef Scully brings an array of international influences to his self-titled restaurant; from Malaysia to Sydney via India and China.
The dishes bursted with flavours but with the right balance. I also noticed extensive use of exotic vegetables within the dish itself.
The ambience is casual and relaxed. Service was friendly, attentive and professional.

venues.image_alt: Scully — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Kennington Lane Cafe
venues.description: Low-key venue for British classics including fish and chips and roasts, global dishes and breakfast.

reviews.text: The food was great with a wide variety of selection especially having black pudding and bubble. On top of the good food our waitress was one of the best. Lucy was fabulous, kind, cheerful, funny, and professional. An unhoused individual came in during our visit and she dealt with it perfectly, like a champ. 10/10

Really lovely little place! The owner is incredibly friendly and funny, and they pay close attention to their customers.

The atmosphere is very basic breakfast diner, but it feels genuine and authentic. Tables and seating are rough and ready, but comfortable and to me they fit the vibe of a small diner.

We got sold on the owner's pitch and tried the Kennington Breakfast. It was delicious, with tender bacon, really tasty bubble, and they did the eggs as we each instructed. It felt incredibly authentic and traditional, with bubble, black pudding and nice sausage. The portions are large, I shared mine with my wife and still left there full!

100% would recommend!

Amazing English breakfast! Randomly found this spot on our trip and we absolutely loved it. It’s a little cute homey diner and the owner was super friendly. Food was flavorful and the portion left us stuffed. Would def come back here again!

venues.name: Regency Cafe
venues.description: No frills corner cafe with tiled exterior, for full English breakfasts and traditional British menu.

reviews.text:
Visited this breakfast cafe at the end of July 2025 while visiting London. I had never had a full english before and had always wanted to try it! I found this place on social media, so I decided to stop by with some friends.

We must have got in at a decent time as a line quickly formed behind us, stretching outside the building and down the sidewalk.

Spent a little over £10, and got a decent amount of food. It was pretty good and fulfilled my expectations.

The establishment has a nice environment and the staff were also pretty friendly. Would recommend!

Very fast service and food was great. Got the full breakfast. The atmosphere, vibe is amazing, proper classic cafe. It gets busy very quick so recommend coming early to avoid disappointment. They also do takeout too

Came here because of its reputation for serving the original English breakfast. The English breakfast and the omelet were great. However, the beef was not good. Generous portion and reasonable price. The ambience was classic but slightly limited space.

venues.name: Dulce Coffee London
venues.description: A classic coffee shop drink menu alongside assorted sandwiches & baked goods with outdoor tables.
venues.address: 86 Whitechapel High St, London E1 7QX, UK

reviews.text:
Dulce Coffee Shop has quickly become one of my favourite spots in London! From the second you walk in, the vibe is warm and welcoming – you instantly feel at home. The staff are so friendly and always up for a chat, which makes the whole experience even better.

They’ve also got a great range of food, from fresh savoury dishes to amazing cakes and desserts. Everything I’ve tried has been delicious, and the portions are generous too. One of the things that really sets Dulce apart is that it’s HMC approved, so you know everything on the menu is halal and prepared to the highest standards. It’s such a relief to have that peace of mind when eating out.

The place itself is stylish but still cosy – perfect for catching up with friends, working on your laptop, or just enjoying a quiet coffee break. Prices are really reasonable for the quality you get, which makes it even better.

All in all, Dulce Coffee Shop is a real gem

Special place for breakfast brunch
So happy we found this place. Set us up for the day with really yummy food and amazing tea. We were seated downstairs and it was super busy but everything flowed like clockwork.  Good vibes. Great service too thank you

We had the full (English) breakfast on the menu consisting of Toast, mushroom, baked beans and turkey rashers.
My wife and I don’t take eggs so we requested for more portions of turkey rashers instead and they were lovely to oblige us.
We had it with orange juice - and speaking of the orange juice, the best so far I’ve had in the uk. Real Orange juice which I believe was just blended and not Tesco orange juice.

The breakfast was tasty and filling.
The service was great too.

venues.image_alt: Dulce Coffee London — international restaurant in Tower Hamlets

venues.name: EL&N London
venues.description: Playful pink venue serving all-day brunch, desserts & cakes, plus fancy coffees & mocktails.

reviews.text: Soooo pretty here. Very aesthetic and chill. Great photos and yummy dessert. Stayed there for hours with my friend and daughter. Only down side were the girls toilets were a bit boring compared to the cafe.

The cakes looked great and the menu was extensive. The place was very cute an Instagrammy. The ordering interface with the tablets on the table was fun. All in all, we found the cakes too sweet and sickly. The lattes were good though.

The drinks were good. The French toast only has syrup and fruit, so it tastes like bread with syrup. The bathroom was very dirty and there were food and napkins on the floor. The place was nice and overrated, and it gives the impression that it's dirty. This was 9:00 pm.

venues.name: Drury Covent Garden | Cafe & Brunch
venues.description: Funky hangout for craft coffee drinks, pastries, creative cafe lunches & weekend brunch.

reviews.text:
Cute brunch restaurant. Feels like it caters a bit more to an American palette. We chose this because we didn’t want British pub food for breakfast lol. It was super crowded when we went on a Wednesday morning and we waited about 20 minutes for a table for 2. Most of the crowd seemed international/tourists.

I liked my pastrami eggs Benedict - I was expecting it to be hot pastrami but it was cold cut. They have an incredible pastry selection and the donuts we had were delicious.

My only piece of feedback is that I wish there wasn’t mint in the water pitcher and that the water was cold (warm mint water is not good).
Perfect every visit. Eggs Drury  with a dirty Chai Latte are my go-to. These pics are from 3 visits spanning a few months. The staff is lovely. Warm and kind vibes for days. Love this place!!!

It’s our second time at Drury Cafe and we absolutely love this place!

Beautiful breakfast/brunch (available until 3pm!) - must go for any breakfast food lovers! Freshly baked goods also available, as well as delicious coffee and matcha!

Very friendly staff and amazing atmosphere! I really recommend visiting this place!

venues.name: De Vine
venues.description: Straightforward counter-serve cafe & deli dishing up informal nibbles for breakfast & lunch.
venues.address: 19 Vine st next, under railway bridge, to, 2 America Square, London EC3N 2PX, UK
venues.vicinity: under railway bridge, to, 19 Vine st next, 2 America Square, London

reviews.text: Located next to our hotel underneath the train tracks tucked in the alley way, what an amazing welcome by Sid, the owner! To be greeted and welcomed first thing in the morning before a long day of tour is refreshing. He was very attentive and gave us suggestions. Our breakfast was absolutely delicious and for the price, you can't beat that in London. Now I know why it has 5 star Google ratings! Family owned - highly recommend!

Haven’t been to a place more deserving of 5 stars. Complete and friendly service with lots of personality. Food is phenomenal. I had the full Monty and a cappuccino, easily the best of what we had around London all weekend, both the food and coffee. Chips were perfect, especially with the brown sauce. Finally, don’t skip on the house-made hot sauce; it was delicious, and not too spicy. I cannot recommend this place enough. Don’t go anywhere else for breakfast, you’ve found the winner.

We enjoyed our breakfast. I’m not a big fun of the full English but I’ve changed my mind after trying the food here. Good portions, non greasy, quality ingredients. Orange juice is innocent (brand) which is quite good as alternative for a fresh one.
The place feels quite homely and traditional, family business I presume. Service is excellent and quite fast. All clean, great value for money, no complaints!

venues.name: The Monocle Café
venues.description: Light, compact, hipster coffee-house serving sandwiches, global snacks/meals and elegant patisserie.

reviews.text: A very popular café every time I walked by it was crowded, so I never stopped in😅 but they actually have seating in the basement. The matcha coconut cake was amazing! (I cant remember the exact name😅😂) Coffee was okay, and the staff were lovely

I was very eager to try this café as I read all the great reviews but unfortunately the egg sando was very dry and bland which was so disappointing since this is one of their "known" menu items.

I also ordered the matcha which was extremely watery and didn't taste much of matcha which was a shame too so I couldn't really say I had a pleasant experience but the location is very nice and the café has a pleasant and comfy vibe to relax and chat/work.

1. Seats:
On ground floor, 1 table with 2 seats inside and 2 table with 4 seats outside.
On B1 floor there are 6 tables with 12+ seats.

2. No laptop.
I've read many posts which were written by foreign students who were doing their dues here, please respect the requirement of the cafe and stop the wrong information.
Even today I still saw a student using her laptop… 🤷🏻‍♀️.

3. Light on B1 floor is relatively dark, but it's good for relaxing or chatting with friends (low voice volume please).

4. The matcha tart with white chocolate is super delicious and long black is also very good!

Definitely a comfortable place for recharging or relaxing.

venues.name: L'ETO Soho
venues.description: Contemporary cafe-style restaurant serving large breakfast menu, lunch, snacks and dinner.

reviews.text:
L'ETO is offering a large variety of delicious cake such as Honey cake, rasberuy pastery etc. The cakes and pasteries are tasty food but also well decorated and presented. It definitely makes you willing to eat.

There's also a nice choice of warm and cold breakage such as Spanish late... which composted by coffe in ice cubs on which you have to add hot milk and condensed mike. I have to say is pretty nice experience.

The place is nicely decorated and it's cosy. I like this cosy atmosphere with the feeling of movement as it is still pretty popular place.

You will be well served... the staff are nice and friendly.  They are explaining also very well the menu.

I would NOT recommend the Tiramisu... its not the right place for that.

That said this is very nice place and I recommend it.

We had a wonderful experience! The cakes were absolutely delicious and the service was outstanding. Sarah took such great care of us – she was attentive, kind, and made us feel very welcome. Everyone we met was super friendly, which made our visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommended!

Really cool and beautifully decorated dessert shop! The vibe is modern and cozy — perfect for catching up with friends or just enjoying something sweet. We were seated right away as the space is spacious, and there’s an amazing variety of cakes to choose from. The ones we tried were nice! Overall a great spot for cake lovers

venues.image_alt: L'ETO Soho — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: The English Rose Café & Tea Shop
venues.description: Charming, vintage-style independent cafe serving afternoon tea, plus breakfast & lunch.
venues.address: 4 Lower Grosvenor Pl, London SW1W 0EJ, UK

reviews.text: Such a cute place right opposite Buckingham Palace tour exit. If you order a pot of tea you get completely different pieces which is like being at grannies house. Servers are incredibly nice and attentive. English Rose wallpaper, teapots and even a piano and lamps in the corners complete the picture. English Breakfast was excellent. Eggs were so so fluffy! Get here on time because Breakfast quickly turns to lunch. Lots of people just come here for the Scones which I didn’t have time for during my trip but NEXT TIME!!!

I‘m glad I‘ve found this beautiful little Café during our stay in London. I first came here with my mother to enjoy an traditional afternoon tea. We‘ve asked for an vegetarian menu and there was no problem. The vegetarian sandwich fingers as well as the - warm and fresh - scones were very delicious. The brownie was very good too. The only thing we would suggest is that the topping of the red velvet and carrot cake could be with less sugar. To us, the cream topping was too sweet.
The scones were so good that we came to another cream tea some days later. We would recommend this café to everyone.

The scones were absolutely outstanding:warm, with a perfect texture: slightly crumbly, not too sweet, and full of flavor. Easily among the best I have ever tasted. The service was also excellent; the staff member was very friendly and welcoming. The tearoom itself has a lovely, cozy atmosphere and a charming, typically British interior. A perfect spot for a relaxing afternoon break.

venues.name: 49 Cafe
venues.description: Narrow counter-serve outpost for coffee, breakfast sandwiches, baked goods & light lunch options.

reviews.text: Woke up very early in London - looked for a hearty breakfast and 49 Cafe was marvelous. Food was fresh clean and tasty. Portions were good. Coffee to die for!!! Hospitality was fabulous. Will make this my go to place whenever I return back to London.
They provide a good variety of breakfast ranging from bagel sandwiches, yogurt to full British breakfast. Also the focaccia is of a decent size with fresh ingredients. Good for daily lunch.

Very tasty food, very quick service and very nice place. Had such a great piece of lasagne with shrooms and onions crispy on top but soft inside, tons of flavour, yummy. Comfort food as it’s best.

Past was great too, maybe on the more oily end of the range but I liked it a lot. Everything felt fresh and prepared same day. I used TGTG.

Place is small but has nice atmosphere inside, it was quite busy even an hour before closing.

venues.name: St James's Café
venues.description: All-day British cuisine in a contemporary wooden pavilion with terrace and views of St James's Park.
venues.address: Horse Guards Rd, London SW1A 2BJ, UK

reviews.text:
I wouldn't bother with the hot food on offer here.

Not sure how the AI would come up with this place offering nice fish & chips because it absolutely isn't. See the picture attached of half the fish that shouldn't have been taken from the sea (if it isn't farmed) as it was practically all batter which was hard to get through. Chips were warm-ish and the tartare was splashed on the plate like a child wanting ketchup with their fish fingers.

For a £50 bill with a meal for 2 and 2 drinks - this needs to be better. Benugo - DO BETTER.

Great experience, highly recommended.
Staff was super nice, i had an eggs royale and it was amazing. I also tried their new maple spice cappuccino and it was top tier, definitely coming back.

A lovely café nestled in the park with plenty of seating both indoors and outdoors. Breakfast is served until 11:30 AM, and the lunch menu starts at 12 PM. The food is delicious, with a great selection of cakes, pastries, and a variety of vegan and vegetarian dishes. Service is quick and friendly. A perfect spot to relax and enjoy good food in a beautiful, peaceful setting.

venues.name: Nora Cafe
venues.description: Nora Cafe is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Nora Cafe provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Lovely little spot tucked away behind the main street. Delicious food, lovely service, and the music/vibes were so calm. I had the Mediterranean meal and it was perfect. The price is also amazing for the amount of food (and being London).

Woke up hungry at 6am on a Saturday, and not in the mood for hotel breakfast again. Found Nora Cafe just 2 mins walk, only place open. Pleasant surprise! Had the Haloumi and sucuk (beef sausage). So good. Staff were super friendly too.
Great portions, very tasty, very fast service. Honey atmosphere and very reasonable price! Loved it! Freshly squeezed orange juice. Oh- toast is thick and buttery, not thin overdried! Lovely!

venues.name: Café in the Crypt
venues.description: Self-service cafe in underground, brick-vaulted  church crypt with gravestones and Wednesday jazz.
venues.vicinity: Charing Cross Underground Shopping Concourse, Trafalgar Sq, London

reviews.text: Loved eating here! Fantastic atmosphere and food was just right for a light meal before an evening theatre performance. Chicken was very tasty and my companion had a lovely steak and ale pie - none of the food was expensive. There is a sweet gift shop as well, clean toilets and they host lots of concerts etc. A ‘hidden’ gem!

Not cheap, ... for it is London, after all, but the food is tasty enough.
Portions are adequate, though would have liked more.
Generally sufficient seating space, though a bit noisy atmophere.

One of the best hot chocolates I’ve had in awhile!! Popular location but less known cafe in the crypt, would add to the bucket list! I know they host events here also! Many chairs and tables and surprisingly natural lighting ☺️ would recommend for a drink and a cool place to relax from the buzz of the above world!

venues.name: Cafe Maya
venues.description: Cafe Maya is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Cafe Maya provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Googled this cafe on the morning we went to the close by Postal museum instead of eating at our hotel. We are so glad we did. Sat down straight away and served quickly, efficiently and with genuine enthusiasm. Smashed avocado,poached eggs on toast for Wife, No5 breakfast for me ( I think ). Served quickly, hot and plenty of it for both of us. I mentioned to the owners I’ve had less breakfast for more money in the midlands. Highly recommend this gem of a cafe. Thanks guys.👍🏻

Found this delightful cafe around the corner from our hotel. We had breakfast every day during our short trip to London. The staff were friendly and polite, and the food was simply scrumptious. Lots of variety on the menu, and lots of healthy options if you don't fancy a classic fry up. Everything was also decently priced. I can't wait to come back again the next time I'm in London!

Just great. Fair choices for the hungry omnivore, veggie, vegan and the ultra restricted nibbler! Staff happy to mix things up and go off menu to be creative with what they have. Great coffee and the good ol’ English Breakfast with no corners cut. Great Mediterranean choices too. 10/10

venues.name: Farm Girl
venues.description: Bright, casual cafe with tiled walls, for health-conscious brunches, smoothies and sandwiches.

reviews.text:
Loved our brunch experience here! The atmosphere was super cute and cozy, we loved the tucked away garden feel.
They had a pretty good variety of drinks and brunch options that were really yummy.

£16 for some scrambled egg and little bit of toppings and £13 for 2 small pancakes with barely any sirup and 2 sad looking pieces of bacon presented with barely any effort!! Sorry, but for the food offered AND the presentation the price needs to be much much lower!!
Drinks were fine, matcha was very milky and not enough matcha and the cappuccino cup was quite small for the price as well.
Ambience is nice and service was fine. But definitely not visiting again if I am hungry and want to feel satisfied after eating.

Definitely pass !!! Not worth the hype or price ! Honestly food was overpriced, not good and dry and pancakes were burnt and dry with no syrup. Drinks were mediocre.

Wait was long. Restaurant was drafty.

Staff was also not attentive and weren't very polite.

Overall do not go here, so many other options

venues.name: EL&N London
venues.description: EL&N London is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, EL&N London provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Promu and Karima were excellent hosts at EL &N. The food was incredible. Very tasty, reasonably priced and quick service. Promu and Karima went out of their way to answer our questions and made us feel very welcome. I recommend EL&N !

The service was very slow. I had to ask the waitress to take my order, and she only came twice: once to accept the order and once to bring the tea. I asked for a cheesecake from their dessert stand, but it never arrived until I reminded her again. My plates were left on the table until I asked for dessert as well. The food itself is good, but the service really needs improvement.

What a lovely space, we had such an amazing waiter Sheik -

The food is absolutely amazing aswell. I don’t regret going there

venues.name: Sheila's Cafe
venues.description: Snug, unassuming option with sidewalk tables offering breakfast, sandwiches & coffee.

reviews.text: Excellent place in the Paddington area to get breakfast, particularly a Full English Breakfast. Everything was well cooked, delicious and served promptly even though they were pretty busy. Staff very friendly. It's so good, people would wait outside for a table. We'll fmdone Sheila's Café!! Will definitely come back for breakfast.

The atmosphere is amazing! The staff welcome us as if we were at their home, very cozy and the food was very good as well. We got a mocha and a hot chocolate and it was delicious! A great spot for a breakfast or brunch with friends or even for a casual date.

Good service, good food, good coffee, what else can you wish for?! I recommend this place.

The price seems lower than other places in London.

venues.name: Cafe Parisienne
venues.description: Cafe Parisienne is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Cafe Parisienne provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Hands down the best coffee and breakfast I’ve ever had, and I’ve had a lot! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and the service is absolutely impeccable. Everyone is so welcoming, it instantly feels like a place you want to come back to. Highly recommended!

Landed in London for the first time and stopped here on my way to the hotel. It was absolutely delicious, best omelette I’ve had  and everything I tried was so good (sausage, Turkish coffee, Baklava)!

Also- Kazim was so hospitable and friendly and the service was incredible! He treated me like family and the food came out so fast!

Would highly recommend this spot!

From the moment I stepped into the cafe, I knew this stay was going to be special. The  staff greeted me with genuine warmth and an impeccable level of professionalism, instantly making me feel not just welcome, but truly cared for. It was the little things—the seamless check-in, the thoughtful recommendations, and their attentiveness to every small request—that truly set the tone.

The room itself was a sanctuary of comfort and style. The design was both elegant and functional, but it was the small luxuries that truly made a difference. Sinking into the impossibly soft, cloud-like bedding each night was an absolute dream, guaranteeing a deep and restorative sleep. The housekeeping team deserves a special mention; the room was always left in a state of pristine perfection, a testament to their dedication and a joy to return to each day.

This isn't just a cafe; it’s an experience in refined hospitality. I will undoubtedly be returning.

venues.name: Double J's Cafe
venues.description: Double J's Cafe is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.9-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Double J's Cafe provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Everything was really good we had to go twice before we left. The burger was 10/10 and the pancakes were amazing. The chicken kebabs were delicious. Everyone working was very nice and attentive. We will definitely be going back.

This place is amazing. After intensive searches, we decided to go to this place for an English traditional breakfast for our last stay in London. It turns out to be a very wise choice. The food is really good, especially for the sausage, very well and evenly cooked, crispy outside and tender inside. We ordered the English traditional, the Veggie and the American, and we all love them. The drink is also good, as well as the coffee. Very nice and welcoming service, making a big plus. We will definitely come back for next visit to London.

Visited Double J’s Cafe today and had such a lovely experience. The coffee was smooth with perfect latte art, and the French toast was beautifully presented with fresh fruit and chocolate drizzle. The menu has a great balance of sweet and savoury, and everything felt fresh and well-prepared.

The staff were friendly, the vibe was relaxed, and the location is super convenient right by Euston. Definitely a spot worth visiting if you’re looking for a quality brunch in London.

venues.name: Wild Thyme London
venues.description: Globally inspired brunch & lunch fare, as well as coffee & wine, in a warm space with outdoor seats.

reviews.text:
Cool cafe with a range of decent breakfast choices including vegetarian

We stopped here to meet friends.
I had the full breakfast with no complaints. Great food although beans were slightly cold.

Coffee was nice
Food took a while to come but they were quite busy.
We'd return here again and use the outside tables if the weather was better.

We had a short break to London and were looking somewhere to eat breakfast. Wild Thyme was a short distance from our accommodation and I am so glad we checked it out. The service was really warm and friendly, and the food and coffee were excellent. We loved it so much we went back on our second day. Can recommend the Wild Thyme Full English  Breakfast and the Turkish Shakshuka, but also simple eggs on toast were also perfectly prepared.

Absolutely lovely place! The vibe is relaxed and cozy, and the staff were really friendly. There’s both indoor and outdoor seating, and the garden area has a great atmosphere. The coffee was smooth and creamy, and the food was delicious with good portion sizes. Also, shout out to the waiter who served us, I didn’t catch his name, but he was absolutely amazing and made the experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back!

venues.name: % ARABICA London Covent Garden
venues.description: % ARABICA London Covent Garden is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.4-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, % ARABICA London Covent Garden provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: This is good coffee!!! % wise 100%. Love the place, the staff and the coffee. As a coffee enthusiast I appreciate the quality, consistency and staff professionalism! Love it, my go to place daily on my week stay in London! Highly recommended!

Arabica Coffee is my not-so-secret London vice. The coffee is Tokyo-level precision — smooth, complex, with that clean finish that makes you involuntarily close your eyes for a second. Every cup feels like it’s been brewed with borderline obsessive care… in the best possible way.

I’ve started “accidentally” navigating my day past here. Quick meeting nearby? Oh no, guess I have to pop in. Oops, wrong tube stop — might as well get a Kyoto coffee.

It’s the kind of place that quietly ruins other coffee for you. Once you’ve had Arabica, everything else feels like a compromise.

Note that this location doesn’t really have seating and gets heavily lined up so takeaway only.
outstanding coffee with diligent staff. Absolutely delightful. They should have more stars than this.

venues.name: Prufrock Coffee
venues.description: Expertly trained baristas serve bespoke brews in a buzzy open-plan cafe with minimal furnishings.

reviews.text:
#toast 521
— I would’ve never quite thought that coffee would go well with hollandaise but it’s such a complementary flavor- it’s a nice sweet, bitter floral note that adds to the overall dish. hollandaise wasn’t too heavy especially paired with grilled courgettes (seasonal greens)🥒🍳

I would definitely love to come back here on a weekday and people watch a bit— it’s a little crowded even on the weekdays all day but they have nice counter seats for single diners. Cozy for sure!

Follow @nomkakaii on Instagram for more toast travels!

This coffee shop is located in nice area where you can buy good coffee alongside excellent street food.
They use Red Brick Coffee Roasters beans and flat white is served in 6oz cup.
The taste is full of flavour and well balanced.
Barrista has done great work as you can see on picture.
I’ll no doubt keep coming back as there is something unique about this place,
On a scale 1 to 10 I would give it 7.5 points.

Have been here before and this place never disappoints! I vividly remember how good it was the first time we were here.And being back here is such pleasure. My partner is very particular with coffee, he follows James Hoffman and probably the reason why we went here before in the first place. He definitely knows this is a great place to get that good coffee especially if you are meticulous about the pouring technique and the coffee beans. Plus I love the simple but elevated dishes they serve! The staff are nice too. I think this place is really popular, so it can get quite busy…

venues.name: Monmouth Coffee Company
venues.description: Fair-trade coffee & gourmet treats in the cafe & whole or freshly ground beans bagged to take home.
venues.vicinity: The Riverside Bldg, 27 Monmouth St, London

reviews.text: Loved the coffee. I tried it iced and hot and loved it in both ways. It wouldn’t be my go to place though as they don’t offer disposable cups. Also make sure to go in a good weather as most of their seats are outdoor.
Their flat white looks good and smooth, coffee aroma isn't strong enough for me. The pain au chocolat looks tasty but not crispy enough.

Flagship of the coffee place. Almost a must have for me each time when I am in London. No complaints, seats are scarce but they are very fast available if you are sharp!

Ask the Barista for the coffee recommendations. Iced or hot. I have tried them all. I am usually at the Borough Market branch.

venues.image_alt: Monmouth Coffee Company — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Omotesando Koffee
venues.description: Boutique coffee chain across SouthEast Asia, light wood interior details, & Japanese-style design.

reviews.text: Better to study the menu online before, because you can only see the menu until you reach the till. Quiet, in favour of the wood interior, although the barista crazy busy on making coffee and super speedy. Coffee normal, and sit in experience is recommended. May need to wait for the seats.

Lovely little coffee shop with a sleek, minimalistic vibe. Great location and ideal for grabbing a quality drink on the go. I met there with friends before heading to an event and we enjoyed our drinks inside. The drinks are definitely the highlight – my hot chocolate was rich and full of flavour (though I do wish it came in a larger mug!), and my partner’s mocha was excellent.

The staff were friendly and attentive, which really added to the experience. That said, seating is a bit limited and not the most comfortable, and it can feel quite cramped when it gets busy. Also worth noting there’s no customer toilet. Still, for the quality of the drinks and the overall vibe, it’s definitely worth a visit.

I usually pick up a matcha to go and the taste is always strong and it’s clearly made well. Very cool spot but often can get incredibly busy and is a bit cramped. Service varies but it’s also a morning coffee pick up, so hard to expect much when churning out coffees. The square Japanese style little treats are really good.

venues.name: Kiss the Hippo Coffee
venues.description: Easygoing coffee shop with an understated interior, serving artisanal brews, cookies & pastries.

reviews.text:
Excellent coffee, they know how to steaming the milk for Flat White.. Many choices of coffee beans.. The Staff are friendly.. Also I try Almond Croissant.. It's tasty
One of the best cafe serving specialist coffee..

I went to collect a to good to go bag and I fed up getting a cappuccino, I got their George street blend it was delicious!! The staff was so friendly and added to the experience.  Tried their banana bread, mozzarella focaccia and the aubergine focaccia. Their sweet bakes were definitely worth trying but I wasn’t the biggest fan of the savoury. A solid 8.5/10

It was a nice cafe and we enjoyed the matcha lattes.

There were just a few times that the noise really escalated to the point we couldn't hear each other.. but most of the time it was average cafe noise.

venues.image_alt: Kiss the Hippo Coffee — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Kaffeine
venues.description: Independent Aussie/Kiwi-owned coffee shop with deli-style breakfasts, sandwiches and salads.
venues.address: 66 Great Titchfield St., London W1W 7QJ, UK

reviews.text:
Great find in the famous Great Titchfield street of London , a stone’s throw from Oxford Circus.
The food was excellent, ditto for the coffees. This café/ restaurant is really small and seems to be over staffed. There are two wooden benches outside that can probably take no more than four people. There is not ample seating inside either.
My biggest disappointment was brunch not being served after 12 noon from Mon- Fri, why?
The atmosphere is somewhat non existent and their clientele consists of people from the neighbourhood, BBC employees having their coffee or the passing tourists that somehow feel unwelcome.
Payment is made upon ordering at the till but how cheeky of them to display on the till screen  prior to making payment if one would like to add 10%/15% or 20% gratuity or nothing ? Are we now in U.S mode in the UK? And what service are we talking about ? Serving you what you ordered at the till? Perhaps if this restaurant was bigger and offered table service than we could possibly talk about service charges?
I would highly recommend going there and I hope that management is thinking of having more spacious premises with perhaps more kitchen staff.

Cosy little coffee shop. Amazing staff! It can get a bit crowded in the morning, but the atmosphere is relaxed.
Good quality coffee. The pancake is on point and looks cute! Just maybe maple would be a better syrup for it (instead of chocolate).

Kaffeine, Great Titchfield Street, London W1

Kaffeine had been on my Fitzrovia hit list for ages, and I finally made it there one morning—and loved it so much I returned within days. This much-loved Aussie-style café is known for top-tier coffee (from Square Mile) and a refined brunch menu. Think espresso-drizzled pancakes, wild mushrooms on sourdough, and one of the best breakfast baps in London. Cosy interiors, great people-watching benches outside, and friendly vibes make it a standout for coffee lovers and brunch seekers alike in London W1.

venues.image_alt: Kaffeine — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Rosslyn Coffee Queen Victoria Street
venues.description: Small, industrial-style coffee shop with window seating for espresso drinks, tea and baked goods.
venues.address: 78 Queen Victoria St, London EC4N 4SJ, UK
venues.vicinity: York House, 78 Queen Victoria St, London

reviews.text: Such a cute little coffee shop right in the heart of London, and it’s got such a great vibe. The staff are super friendly and make you feel welcome every time you visit. I keep coming back for their seasonal drinks; they’re always amazing, especially the winter and summer specials. It’s one of those spots that’s usually filled with locals, which I love because the energy is always so relaxed and positive, with everyone just enjoying their coffee and chatting. The location is perfect and easy to find, so it’s a great spot to pop into whether you’re in the area or just looking for somewhere to chill. Definitely one of my favorites in the city!

Locating at a corner of the street, the cafe can be spotted far away from the street. The design of the cafe was simply and comfortable. Plenty of benches were provided outside the cafe. There were a variety of coffee, tea and chocolate provided. We ordered an iced oat latte, a hot latte and a hot motcha. All were great. Service was efficient considering there were quite a lot of customers (we visited at 4:30pm on Wednesday). Would definitely come here again next time.

Quite simply the best coffee in London City.
Primarily takeaway, with half a dozen stools inside and a bench outside. Positioned to get a lot of sunshine: beautiful spot to enjoy a good flat white on a sunny day

venues.name: Ozone Coffee - Shoreditch
venues.description: Artisan roastery's coffee shop, with onsite bakery for breakfast, cakes, eggs and lunchtime snacks.

reviews.text: my go-to place for breakfast when in london. the scrambled eggs are so good that i specifically chose my hotel for this trip by the walking distance to ozone. could (and honestly did) eat here every day. the whole place looks really cool, the staff are lovely and the teas and coffees are always great too. totally recommend!

Poached eggs were lovely. I ordered spicy mushroom as a side dish which it was nice.
Anyway, lovely staff and atmosphere…good coffee. Just a little bit pricey but they are still the good place for breakfast.

I’ve been to Ozone Café in Shoreditch a few times now, and it always hits the mark. The coffee is reliably good, but the hot chocolate is easily the best I’ve had — rich, smooth, and comforting. I’ve tried a few dishes here; the minced lamb with mint yogurt was a favourite, though it’s not on the menu anymore. That said, I don’t mind the seasonal changes — keeps things fresh. I had the burger this time and it was really tasty and satisfying.

The atmosphere is relaxed and not too busy, making it a great spot for a proper catch-up with a friend. It’s also perfect for an early morning pick-me-up. Whether you’re after a hearty breakfast or a filling lunch, Ozone has you covered. Definitely one of my go-to cafés in the area.

venues.name: Rosslyn Coffee London Wall
venues.description: Pastries & custom-brewed gourmet coffee offered in a trendy, compact environment.

reviews.text:
One of the busiest coffee shops I’ve ever seen and even with all the chaos and having over 5 people working, they manage to give the best costumer experience.

Congrats to the team for having a really good coffee with nice tones and as well having a smile at all times.

They seemed like they were having the best time even though we know how busy it is and how things can be tricky.

Coffee was really good with strong flavour and I had a vegan protein ball which was tasty.

Once again congrats to the team and recommended to pass by and enjoy

A sign post of espresso soft serve beckoned outside the shop. Willingly I heeded its command and ordered one. The place had people going in and out and it was not hard to see why. The baristas are all female with happy energy working together. I guess if your house is a happy one, you don’t need social media for advertisement; people are drawn to it like moths to a flame. I added my order too so you can admire its beauty.

Whenever I am in London this is my go to place for coffee.
Both the drinks and the sold bean are solid quality.
Use the stamps to get one coffee free every 10 purchased.

venues.image_alt: Rosslyn Coffee London Wall — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Hideaway Coffee House
venues.description: Hideaway Coffee House is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Hideaway Coffee House provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
Come backing again (2 Oct 2025), my last day in London. This time I came here via Smith's Court.  I tried their cortado, beautifully made with latte art stayed intact. This is definitely a testament to skill -  the dense of the coffee, the right temperature to steam the milk, of course the coffee beans, all play a critical role.  Their croissant was good, though it would be even better offer a heatup service.  I also saw their cold brew is readily available in the fridge when I lined up the queue,  which I appreciates as I always enjoy cold brew without ice.

2nd time visit on 1 Oct 2025 for quick lunch. I ordered a cold crew and almond apricot pastry. Both are lovely. This is the best spot in the area.

1st time visit, 14 Sept 2025. I ordered the long black and it was excellent. The cafe had a very chill vibe, especially with Westerman's music playing during my visit.

This is the good place to have a snack before going to watch the musical.

The staff here are all friendly and considerate. I came twice for my holiday in London this time. I seem couldn't find anywhere else better than this cafe❤️the coffee is nice and the cake and apricot pastry are both delicious. No. 1 recommendation in central london.  Thank you🥰

I absolutely love this coffeeshop, especially the beautiful courtyard. It’s such a peaceful little oasis right in the middle of the city. I’ve had Flat Whites, Iced Coffee and most recently a Pumpkin Spice Latte made with real pumpkin purée. Honestly the best one I’ve ever had. I love sitting outside with a book or my headphones on, just enjoying the moment next to my coffee

venues.name: Chill House Coffee Shop
venues.description: Chill House Coffee Shop is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Chill House Coffee Shop provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Beautiful cafe with soya milk available as alternative option. Very peaceful, quiet and nice area. We had flat white and it’s amazing the temperature of the coffee was just right. Music wasn’t too loud and the staff were friendly.

The coffee was absolutely outstanding! I walked in on the first day of my trip and ended up coming back every single morning. The owner was incredibly kind, and the whole experience of choosing your coffee felt so personal and customizable. They’re extremely accommodating and happy to make suggestions based on your preferences. One highlight was trying the owner’s homemade peanut butter flavor—phenomenal! I sampled everything from iced lattes to hot lattes, and each one was perfect. This spot quickly became a daily must-visit for me and my mom :)

If you want coffee in London, you need to check this place out. I was just looking for a place to have a coffee in Mayfair and I’m sooo glad I went there.

The pastry I had was amazing too and I’d definitely go back there every time I visit London.

venues.image_alt: Chill House Coffee Shop — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Lever & Bloom Coffee
venues.description: Lever & Bloom Coffee is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.9-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Lever & Bloom Coffee provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
This small coffee shop in Central London started as a small food truck which eventually expanded to a shop because of the amazing quality and demand for their coffees and baked goods, so I had to put them to the test!

I tried their iced Chocoalate, Hazelnut croissants and their coffees and I can’t lie, they tasted amazing! The 4.9 rating on Google is valid so definitely check them out🙌

I’ve been trying cinnamon buns everywhere and this is one of the best! It was a delicately baked cinnamon bun that you can tell from the taste, appearance and texture.

The way they balanced the level of sweetness was absolutely outstanding. The sweetness comes from the combination of the cinnamon paste, sugary crunch and a fine layer of glaze on top. Surprisingly, you would not find it too sweet at all because of the hint of savoury coming from the dough and cinnamon paste. The chewiness of the bread paired with the crunchy sprinkle on top made the texture 10/10 for me. Not to mention the fragrance of cinnamon that lingers in your mouth, making you want to take another bite right away.

This would be my motivation to go to the uni lol I’m going to try the cardamon bun next time!

PS: Super friendly staff too! - thanks for the treat btw ;)

One of the best cardamom buns in town and plenty of choice of other delicious pastries. Cappuccino was also very good.
Lovely area to sit and read on a bench, I’ll be back

venues.name: Batch Baby
venues.description: Batch Baby is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Batch Baby provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: Rose Lipman Building, 43 De Beauvoir Rd, London N1 5SF, UK
venues.vicinity: Rose Lipman Building, 43 De Beauvoir Rd, London

reviews.text:
There is always a que at Batch Baby and for weeks I would cycle past and wonder why. Today I stopped by and found out why.

Great coffee, good pastries, a friendly service and good crowd of customers.

An Americano and fig Danish pastry cost me £8 and I had to que for 10mins on a busy Sunday morning, but it was worth it.

The coffee was very good and the pastry was light, crumbly and moist. In short I would suggest joining the que, I will be.

Cool. Hip place. I've been going there for 3 years consistently and saw it expand which is amazing. It's always busy so it's good to get there early to grab a table if you want to work or even get a coffee. The weight full of coffee is quite long usually, but it's definitely worth it and the people working there are always super kind. The pastries are also amazing as well as the sandwiches that they serve. It feels very homey in a way and a snapshot from the past.

The first time I came here I ordered a 1:1 which wasn’t great and I left thinking that I could’ve ordered better. Came back a second time and got the house batch and a flat white. Batch was served too cold and I couldn’t drink it all. Flat white was good however. I really want to like this place because the staff seem knowledgeable and the vibe is good but I’ve been underwhelmed each time. I was expecting better from a place I’d heard good things about. Maybe I’ve come on an off day??

venues.image_alt: Batch Baby — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Saint Nine Coffee
venues.description: Artisanal, barista-made coffee drinks served in a trendy counter-serve with splashy art.

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing looking specialty coffee spot. Loved the vibes and interior design. Most importantly, Saint Nine impressed me with very friendly service and the most welcoming host. Definitely a recommendation when in the area and also worth a detour when looking for great coffee in London.

The gentleman inside provided outstanding service and hospitality — truly first-class. I was amazed to find such a warm and welcoming coffee shop right in the heart of London. The coffee was excellent, and I even bought some drip bag coffee to take home. Truly recommended!
Top coffee, top service. A little bitter on the betty but the milk work is nice and smooth and it’s a perfect first cup of the day to get you going!

venues.name: Coffee London
venues.description: Coffee London is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Coffee London provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: I wasn't sure whether to give it a go as it looks quite new, but I am glad I gave it a shot. I'll be back definitely.

no Ac, disgusting decor with sticky tables and dirty chairs. nobody comes to serve you. and most importantly less than half the menu was available on my visit.
no ice-cream, barely any of the sides, just pizza
Amazing place to go and great customer service. Breakfast was amazing.

venues.name: Attendant Coffee Roasters | Fitzrovia
venues.description: Tiny, quirky coffee bar in restored Victorian public convenience, serving breakfast and light lunch.

reviews.text:
Very unique dining environment.
The entrance like the train station, the interior design like a man washroom BUT very clean of course.
The food is amazing. I love their sauces, all ingredients are well matched. The bread is soft and in good texture.
The coffee is great as well. I would said the best I had tried in London, even not many I had tried.

Such a great find!
It was small yet cozy and cute. The “train toilet” theme was executed perfectly and i found it quirky than weird. The match was so delicious and amazing priced considering its in central london

I highly recommend the avocado toast with a sunny-side-up egg — it’s honestly one of the best and most worth-it dishes I’ve had in London! They were super generous with the avocado, which made it even better.

The iced oat milk latte was also excellent, with a perfectly balanced coffee flavor.

The service was outstanding, and it was such a great way to start my morning as a tourist. A truly satisfying breakfast experience!

venues.image_alt: Attendant Coffee Roasters | Fitzrovia — international restaurant in Central London

venues.vicinity: Orion House, 4b Upper St Martin's Ln, London

reviews.text: Coffee Island has the best coffee in Greece and London. What most people don't know is that they also offer excellent customer support.Since I live outside London, I placed an order with the London store so I could still enjoy proper Greek coffee at home. The order was unfortunately delivered incorrectly, but Ms. Dimitra was incredibly responsive and personally took care of everything. Thanks to her kindness and professionalism, the package was re-sent and arrived safely. A big thank you to Ms. Dimitra – excellent service and highly recommended!

A nice greek cafe on the heart of London. It was around 12 minutes walking distance from my hotel. The place is nice, the staff are friendly and fast. The freddo cappuccino was delicious. The price was good.

They have two cup sizes.
I've ordered Coffe Latte in bigger 12 oz cup.
I think is too big to taste real flavour of goodness. My suggestion is take 8 oz.
I've chosen single Brazil Alta Mogiana.
Thumbs up for barista for excellent skills.
On scale 1 to 10 points I'd give 7.5

reviews.text:
September 2025

Good coffee
Good Croissant
No non-sense minimalist interior
Average seating...could be better. May be they can have setup outside.
This was my first visit so liked it.
Amazing coffees from champion roasters and baristas. Friendly service, good location, accessible entrance. Coffee equipment and beans are also available for sale. Coffees are really exceptional!
Really excellent coffee at Formative! Service is good and friendly. The coffee is worth raving about, bean choice and milk work are on point. In my London Top 10 for sure! Highly recommend!
