The charred greens with feta, pomegranate, and nuts were a great fresh counterpoint to the meat platter, and the fries with aioli disappeared instantly. Drinks were excellent too — the house lemonade with chili and lime was surprisingly refreshing and unique.

Service was friendly and efficient, the vibe industrial rustic and warm, and the food came out perfectly timed for sharing.

If you’re visiting with a small group and want to taste a bit of everything, go for the shared meat platter — it’s spot-on in both portion and variety.

📍 SMOKESTAK, Shoreditch
🔥 Perfect for: small groups, casual dinners, meat lovers, and anyone craving authentic slow-smoked BBQ in London.

Fantastic meal. The meat was outstanding, and the starters and sides were just as good. Service was great, with spot-on recommendations. Portions are generous and the prices match the quality. It’s a busy place, so booking ahead is wise if you don’t want to gamble on a last-minute table. We ended up outside since that’s all that was left, but with perfect weather it turned into a highlight rather than a drawback.

We absolutely knew the food was going to be top tier, but it was the service that really smashed it out of the park here. From the moment we were greeted on the door by Kitty and Cristian, the rapport and bonhomie was already a dead cert: Charming, cheerful and a little cheeky in all the right quantities, we were promised VIP treatment from the get go, and boy did we get it. The equally charming Alexandra took our order, but sat opposite the pass, even the chefs engaged us in a deeply convivial manner, only ever enabled by an open kitchen like this.

Attentive, affable, and amusing, the team put on the perfect display of service with a smile, with a dash of well placed humour to really make us feel like part of the furniture or family….. not sure which.

Go here, eat well, and enjoy the experience created by an exceedingly well-matched team who love their jobs (I hope)!

venues.image_alt: SMOKESTAK — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Lahpet Shoreditch
venues.description: An array of small & shared plates in a contemporary setting with lively hanging plants, & full bar.
venues.address: 58 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6JW, UK

reviews.text: Absolutely delicious food with friendly stuff. Super nice place to have a lovely evening. The superstar dish for me is the coconut noodles. Cocktails are great as well

BEAUTIFUL SPACE
The interiors are bang on the money, this location has a homely and welcoming and communal feel. The paper menu placemats and beautifully curved reusable branded coolers and bamboo straws, felt intentional, purposeful and reflective of the brand. It's clear I'm in love with the space (the bar stools with backrests sealed the deal for me).

The food, is done well. We ordered a number of dishes so we got a good sample of the menu. It was delish!
The menu is selective without being limiting.

This is a really nice spot. Highly recommended.

Excellent Burmese food in a modern restaurant with good service and ambience! Shared tea leaf salad, papaya salad, hake curry, chicken coconut noodle soup, coconut rice and crème brûlée between three people. All dishes were consistently reasonable in portion, flavoursome and delicious. The crunchy salads and the perfectly cooked fish were my favourites. The chicken noodles were lovely but I wouldn’t have again (personal preference). Highly recommend this place - ticks all the boxes ie enjoyment, quality and value.

venues.name: The Blues Kitchen | Shoreditch
venues.description: Eclectic, industrial space offers areas for live blues music, dancing and Cajun-BBQ dining.

reviews.text:
Hands down, my new, absolute, favorite spot in London!
Far away from all the touristy spots, this hidden, not-so-hidden, spot is a gem amongst the other establishments close by!!! From the door security, Justina, to one of the most fantastic waiters we have ever had (Daryl), and bar server (Michelle), the place radiates with a charming atmosphere screaming, "come and stay awhile."
I was pleasantly surprised by the delectable aroma and essence of flavors that burst in my mouth from the smoked port rib (fell off the bone!!!!), and the earthy and nutty tastes of cheese from the macaroni and cheese. Daryl recommended the mac n cheese which I was hesitant about but glad I tried it! Daryl and Michelle managed to turn a routine work task of serving customers into a joyful, memorable evening simply by being attentive to our needs and having good conversation. Kudos to the restaurant manager for stopping by the table several times to check in on services. Well done! The staff worked well together and did so gracefully and happily.
The drinks were well made! The live band was playing good soul music that encourage you to bop and sway while indulging in the atmosphere and your company. Timeless scenery and decorating... England has a sophistication with that that America can't match! A+..... I could stay there forever if I wasn't full from the delicious meal! Easily accessible place I'd visit all the time if I were a local. Thanks for a wonderful evening, all because of an outside conversation with a door staff. You're a wonderful person Justina! A+!

We waited for our cocktails for about 40 minutes. The waitresses were pushy, constantly trying to get us to order more food. I even went to the bar to cancel my order because waiting 40 minutes for cocktails, despite reminding them several times, is simply unacceptable. As soon as I complained and cancelled, the waitress came and asked us to pay for the food we hadn’t even finished yet. Awful! I was very disappointed. One of the cocktails we did receive tasted so bad that my partner couldn’t even drink it.

Before the musicians started playing, we had about an hour and a half to enjoy our food and drinks — but we didn’t enjoy it at all. Once the music began, it was so loud that I couldn’t hear the waitress, my partner, or even myself. It felt more like a nightclub than a blues venue. I was expecting a real blues atmosphere.

I had wanted to visit this place for a long time, but it turned out to be more about showing off than about quality. And it was so expensive!

I would not recommend this place to anyone.

Excellent first time visit! All of the staff were very friendly, welcoming, checked in on us multiple times and said thank you as we left. Service was spot on. Appreciated being given a jug of tap water straight away without even having to ask too. Food was so tasty, we had the pork belly rib, and bacon cheeseburger, both dishes were great but particularly the pork belly rib - I would come back just for that! 😋
Decor was cool and overall nice relaxed atmosphere (we dined around 5:30pm so before it gets busy). Highly recommend and looking forward to our next visit!

venues.name: BRAT Restaurant
venues.description: There’s strong Basque influences on the menu of this rustic Spanish spot with open wood fire grill.

reviews.text:
The restaurant had been on my list for years but I did not know they got a Michelin star in 2025.

Food was amazing from start to finish. With some Tartare, Mussels toast and Pigeon skewer to begin with.
And then some Dover Sole, Mallard, vegetables and potatoes. All that with a side of bread and butter. And a cheesecake finish.

Service was great and they explained everything. Wine list was also great with lots of options (including Sherry and Dessert wine)

I highly recommend the place

Beautiful restaurant with highly imaginative cooking. The only areas where it comes up a little bit short are, first, value for money - the portions are small considering their prices, and the pricing on the grilled fish and meat is particularly dear. Second, the dining room is packed in a little bit tight and there is very little room to manoeuvre, once you arrive and are sat you pretty much have to stay put as the dining room is very dense and very busy. The vegetable dishes were the star of the show and if I were to do it all over again I would order only vegetarian dishes and a bottle of wine. Standout items were the red peppers cooked for 24 hours in sherry and olive oil, the skewer of squid and sobrassada, the squash with seasonal greens and yogurt, and the chocolate sorbet with plum. I’d booked the restaurant for a special occasion, and besides acknowledging that from their notes nothing was done about it including not providing the table by the kitchen as I had requested and they’d promised to do. Overall glad we went and we did enjoy the vibe and the overall experience.

Excellent and attentive service. Super friendly and engaging staff who take the time to explain the menu and story behind it : thank you for all the dishes and wines recommandations!

Lunch was delicious from start to finish: a special mention for the Dover sole & grilled veggies and sparkling white wine👌🏾

Loved watching the big open kitchen work while enjoying my lunch, as well as seeing the other options ordered by fellow guests. A must try when in London. I will definitely come back, MERCI !

venues.name: Lina Stores Shoreditch - Italian Restaurant & Bar
venues.description: Lina Stores Shoreditch - Italian Restaurant & Bar is a italian restaurant located in London. With a 4.8-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Lina Stores Shoreditch - Italian Restaurant & Bar provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine italian flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 180 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6HY, UK

reviews.text: I stopped here impromptu on my way elsewhere and was so pleasantly surprised by the level of authenticity in the food and outstanding service.  I haven't had Italian food this wonderful since Italy. Smaller (right-size) portions, a wonderful wine selection, really kind attentive service. This place should not be missed.

Lina Stores is a really good Italian option at reasonable prices. The food is simple but with fresh ingredients and the ambience in the Shoreditch branch is slightly quirky and quaint with its monochromatic pale green interiors. The desserts were super moist and delicious too! Overall, this is a fantastic option for great tasting Italian food at good prices.

There are a few Lina Stores in London with each always guaranteeing a great Italian meal, but the one in Shoreditch boasts a very cool basement bar with excellent cocktail choices. The atmosphere is quite intimate and moody, perfect for a romantic date or a friendly conversation. The food as always was excellent.

venues.name: The Clove Club
venues.description: Cutting-edge restaurant and bar for innovative British menu using often-overlooked ingredients.
venues.address: Shoreditch Town Hall, 380 Old St, London EC1V 9LT, UK
venues.vicinity: Shoreditch Town Hall, 380 Old St, London

reviews.text: A lovely tasting menu with a few surprises along the way. The extra course of Scottish blue shell lobster was the most memorable, especially the curly noodles in lobster bisque in the 2nd serving. The portion size with the extra course was good.  In fact, most dishes were quite small and light, although understandable for a summer menu, the overall portion could be more generous throughout. The restaurant was situated inside the Shoreditch Town Hall but the interior design was not able to capture the classic elegance of the original architecture. It was more or less a typical London restaurant establishment. Service was prompt and friendly, with a minor error on the bill in the end that the more experienced server admitted the mistake right away and took it to rectify.
My daughter and I had a wonderful meal. The wine and NA pairings were a great compliment to each dish. Stellar dining experience and top notch hospitality. Very much looking forward to returning.

Had the best birthday dinner here.
I have been to many fine dining places before as a former New Yorker and The Clove Club topped a lot of the previous experiences I had.

All dish were experimental and creative but very well balanced in every aspect. There are some dishes with flavors and textures I've never tasted. Overall exquisite!
The service and hospitality was also exceptional. I would definitely recommend The Clove Club to my friends and would love to come back!!! Thank you for completing my perfect birthday celebration.

venues.name: Rochelle Canteen
venues.description: Cafe/restaurant in bike shed of school turned arts and media complex serving short, modern menu.

reviews.text:
This is a lovely restaurant tucked away behind a wall. You need to be buzzed in to eat here. What this means, of course, is that you have to be intentional to eat here, and make a reservation. It is worth it.

It was a lovely day, so we ate outside under the pergola filled with ripening grapes. For starters, we had the cod roe dip with fresh baby radishes and absolutely delicious tomato salad topped with feta. The tomatoes were fresh and juicy, and it was just a lovely summer dish. For an entrees, one of us had the tuna with white beans. The fish was perfectly cooked, and the portion was substantial. The rest of us had two of the specials of the day. I had the crispy lamb ribs, which were quite an unusual preparation, but they were very tender and tasty. The wagyu beef entree was sensational. Perfectly cooked beef served with horseradish and some spicy greens. It was truly a lovely meal.

They have several cocktails plus a nice list of wines by the glass.

The staff is great, and the ambience very calm and beautiful. Beautiful. I highly recommend this lovely restaurant.

The food was great with good ingredients. The service was excellent and very quick. The restaurant was in a covered area which was nice but would have been nicer in the outside garden area in the summertime. Overall was a bit pricey but the quality of the food was good. Portion sizes were normal

Been wanting to come here for a while now.
Food was mostly good. Cod was cooked perfectly, short rib was a beautiful cut in a delicious gravy. The lamb croquettes were a highlight!

Sides were a bit undercooked for my liking. Tough cabbage and potatoes. Wine was excellent and service mostly good.
One waiter would just dump our plates on the table without talking us through the dishes. Maybe that's not their policy but it's a nice touch to be reminded of the elements.
Otherwise, our main waitress was excellent.

venues.name: The Light Bar & Dining
venues.description: Converted warehouse with beer garden and roof terrace, Modern European dining and weekend DJs.
venues.address: 233 Shoreditch High St, London E1 6PJ, UK

reviews.text:
We booked the Loft at The Light Bar this weekend to host our wedding drinks and couldn’t be happier with the top tier service we received!
Great communications and explanation throughout. Excellent food & bar service and very grateful for the little extra mile they went on countless details of hosting a wedding party night for 90 approx people.
They provided ample amount of the amenities needed, kept me updated throughout a smooth running night. Fantastic staff and service. Thanks team!

I was there once and I liked the experience! We were 3 girls, ended up at The Light Bar on a Friday evening. We ordered cocktails and I loved mine! The service was good, the staff is nice and the space is spacious. I do think that it might be also a good venue for celebrations or events. There was a live DJ playing and he really nailed it. Although it is a bit loudy, I really liked the place and you can still find a place to chill and hear each other somewhere upstairs. Recommended!

The Light Bar hosted my VIP Dinner for women in my professional network in London. From the moment of booking, the staff were so helpful and communication and planning was spot on. We did a group set menu and the food was spectacular, so delicious and very generous servings with wonderful fresh, rich flavours. They kindly catered to dietary requirements and the service was impeccable - they really took care of us and we were all super impressed. They accommodated us moving to an outdoor table given it was such a beautiful balmy June evening and it was truly magical to relax and connect. Would absolutely recommend it for any corporate or personal event - it was an amazing venue.

Along with cocktails, the group set menu was absolutely spectacular starting with burrata and peppers, salmon fennel citrus salad, trout and crème fraiche, flatbreads both plain and topped with olive and tomato, and crispy chickpea hummus. Next came shared mains - delicious hispy cabbage on ratatouille, basil pesto baked orzo with rocket and Parmesan, and a baby chicken with gravy and greens. And of course we squeezed in the mountain of crispy churros with chocolate pots because dessert obviously goes into another tube.

I was truly blown away by the fresh flavour-packed dishes, perfect location, and wonderful service. I’m still dreaming of that heavenly trout dip…

venues.name: Camino Shoreditch
venues.description: Colourful, eclectic venue with a relaxed ambiance for inventive Spanish tapas and interesting wines.

reviews.text: The food was generally very good, but the mushroom coca was truly unique and special — the best mushrooms I’ve ever tasted. The succulent pig was a little on the dry side, but everything else was excellent. The service was outstanding, and the atmosphere was beautiful, with wonderfully tasteful décor.
Firstly, the service was top notch. Lovely, friendly staff. The food was as good as I’ve had in Barcelona. They even got it out to me in a couple of minutes as I was in a rush. 10/10 will be back.

Ended up going twice on two consecutive nights! Really nice tapas, selection wasn't huge but everything I had was really well done. Ended up trying both the tomato bread, tortilla, ox cheek, flattened pork, croquettes, bravas, padron peppers and the cheesecake. Everything was really tasty. Cheesecake in particular was incredible - creamy but not too sweet. Prices were about what I expect for the area. Service from Sergio and the other guy (sorry didnt catch his name!) was really friendly and attentive. Will 100% be back when I'm in the area again.

venues.image_alt: Camino Shoreditch — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Tonkotsu Shoreditch
venues.description: Tonkotsu Shoreditch is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Tonkotsu Shoreditch provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.vicinity: Shoreditch Service Station, 1 Anning St, London

reviews.text:
Had a great meal here with colleagues on a Thursday night.

We had chicken wings and prawn katsu for starters and then most people had ramen and I had more starters with bang bang style cauliflower.

Service was excellent. We were served by Maryan who was friendly and helpful throughout and served with a smile which was nice.

The food came out relatively quick (but it was passed the evening rush) and the food was both tasty and hot. I’d say pretty standard in terms of its flavouring which is why I gave it an overall four stars. It just wasn’t fine dining but it was very good.

Portions were hearty but everyone finished theirs. Shows they are thinking about things like that.

The place has great decor. We were in a booth. Was comfy.

I would definitely go again. Service was strong and the food was decent.

We made an impromptu decision to go to Tonkotsu in Shoreditch and what an unexpected delight! Mary-Ann was our waitress and reminded just what excellent service looks like. Great personality, great recommendations and made the whole experience one to remember. I came in feeling neutral and I’m definitely leaving with a smile due to the food but most importantly the exceptional service. Definitely worth a visit!

I come here quite often for lunch because it’s worth the money and honestly really, really good food every single time. The quality never disappoints, and it feels like you’re getting way more than what you pay for.

I tried the Chicken Katsu Curry for the first time and it was AMAZING. Perfectly crispy chicken, rich curry sauce, and just overall so satisfying – definitely something I’ll be ordering again. And just to clear up something I’d seen floating around, it’s not free – I checked with the staff myself.

One thing I really appreciate here is how helpful and fabulous the staff are. They’re always friendly, attentive, and happy to answer any questions – especially when it comes to allergies. Most of the menu doesn’t contain nuts, but there are a few items that do, so I’d definitely recommend asking the staff just to be safe. They make the whole experience easy and reassuring.

Overall, this place is a gem. Delicious food, great value, and consistent with both meals and service. I 100% recommend it to anyone (just make sure to double-check if you have allergies). You won’t regret it!

venues.name: Babel Grill House Shoreditch Lebanese restaurant London
venues.description: Babel Grill House Shoreditch Lebanese restaurant London is a mediterranean restaurant located in London. With a 4.9-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Babel Grill House Shoreditch Lebanese restaurant London provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine mediterranean flavors in a comfortable setting.

attributions: Babel Grill House Shoreditch Lebanese restaurant London
Babel Grill House Shoreditch Lebanese restaurant London

reviews.text:
TL;DR: Everything was great!

1. The food was really good: we tried the platter for 2 and a few charcoal-grilled dishes, everything was great
2. They allowed us to adjust a few things in the dishes (e.g. one of my friends had some dietary restrictions), even though they weren't able to remove garlic and herbs from the chicken (they are pre-seasoned)
3. They allowed us to bring a small dog inside (I think every restaurant in London should do it)
4. The service was really good and we didn't even pay any service charge for it!

I struggled with this review because I so wanted the restaurant to be better. Overall, nothing bad. Just nothing great either.

The service was bland. Not friendly, not unfriendly, just functional. When we had finished our meals, he scraped each plate onto another at the table, making one large plate of leftovers and then squished all the plates together, so he could carry them away.

The food was tasty, just very very dry. Too dry. Plus, he did not have enough lamb.

Inside, the restaurant was nicely decorated, inviting and indicated great food to come. Unfortunately it did not.

I’d like to say better things. I can’t. Could easily have been great. It wasn’t.

The food, the location, the staff, and the service were all amazing! Prices good
Recommended for a nice dinner. We will surely be back :) thank you again

venues.name: Mount St. Restaurant
venues.description: Mount St. Restaurant is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Mount St. Restaurant provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: First Floor, 41-43 Mount St, London W1K 2RX, UK

reviews.text:
I dine here frequently, usually for breakfast most weeks and the consistency and quality of the food has always been exceptional. Today, however, I had the pleasure of dining here for lunch for the very first time – and it was truly incredible!!

We started with three dishes,  the beef tartare, scallops and tuna. Each one was full of flavour, beautifully presented, and cooked to absolute perfection. I couldn’t fault a single thing.

For the main course, we had the famous lobster pie, which I can honestly say is worth every penny. It was rich, perfectly balanced, and the lobster itself was tender and succulent. Not something you come across or get to enjoy every day, I would highly recommend it to anyone dining here.

We finished with two desserts , the pear tart and the caramel creation (I forget the exact name of it) both of which were delicate yet packed full of flavour. They looked like works of art on the plate and tasted every bit as good as they appeared.

Beyond the food, the staff deserve special mention. In all of my visits, they have consistently been accommodating, helpful, and very knowledgeable about everything on the menu. They’re always smiling and genuinely make you feel welcome – a real credit to the restaurant!

Without doubt, this is easily one of the best places to eat in Mayfair! I

Really nice atmosphere. Service is top-notch. Food portions are reasonable. Taste - despite the simplicity of our choices - was exquisite. Prices go with the level of elegance.  Definitely worth trying while in London.  Too many options to try to get back again but definitely no regrets.

Simply amazing in everyway possible. From the moment we walked into the restaurant we noticed it has carefully been curated. From the art pieces displayed nicely (no cluttering) to the bathroom design.. all has been thought of carefully.
Now the most important part... the food.
Every dish consumed was outstanding. Carefully prepared, the blend of the flavors was simply mmmmm
Must point out  the beef wellington. A dish must have at Mount St.
I wish I had the stomach of an elephant to be able to finish every dish we ordered but I enjoyed it to the max.
Highly recommend Mount St. Amazing staff.

venues.name: 34 Mayfair
venues.description: British game and world meats cooked on an imported Argentinian grill in art deco-inspired brasserie.
venues.address: 34 Grosvenor Sq, S Audley St, London W1K 2HD, UK
venues.vicinity: 34 Grosvenor Sq, S Audley St, London

reviews.text:
Went here on day 1 of our London trip for anniversary dinner.

Fancy interior and utensils.
Food was delicious, particularly hummus and broccoli.

Staff were friendly and kind and they also have live music.

Definitely recommend for dates/friends gathering/family dinner.

This place is amazing. We had outdoor seating which I highly recommend if the weather is nice. My wife had the lemon sole, which was the special of the day and I had the ribeye. Both were very good, but the real winner here were the desserts. We had the chocolate fondant tart and the homemade donuts. I'm not sure how both of them can rank in our top 10 desserts ever, but they do. We're in town for a week and are already planning to go back for dessert again. Highly recommended!
And a word about our server, Remus - he was fantastic. Very attentive, helpful with suggestions and quick to clear dirty plates. While we were there a lady at the table next to us (seating is very close) complained to him about a menu item that was not available. He responded apologetically but she wouldn't take no for an answer she continued on and on and made mention of how betrayed she felt and that she felt like she was lied to by the receptionist she spoke with earlier in the day. Remus maintained his composure and continued to respond kindly to her. The situation was clearly beyond Remus' control. Much respect to him for handling the situation with grace.

Today, we had lunch at the 34 Mayfair in London. The food was not that great but not bad either. However, the portion sizes were very, very small. The octopus was minuscule. Avoiding gluten was impossible no matter how carefully one orders. The matcha-based non-alcoholic drink was quite disappointing – it was overpowered with lemon and didn’t taste like it had any matcha. Additionally, the salad looked limp and the leaves didn’t seem very fresh. Also, all bread was sweet. Riffle with chicken tasted good but the coating on the chicken didn’t stick well and the croffle was too sweet to be in that dish. The sole was good. Overall, it was just an okay meal, not really a great experience.

venues.image_alt: 34 Mayfair — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Goodman
venues.description: Steakhouse with leather-seated booths, low-hanging pendant lamps and dark wood panelling.

reviews.text: What a great choice for a special meal on a day out to watch a show. Starting with a nice greeting at the door & shown to our table. The server gave us our menus and talked us through the Steaks on offer, from size to taste & so on. My wife had a stunning ribeye Steak & I had a New York Strip that tasted amazing & was a perfect medium rare. The chips had a great crunch & full of fluffy potato. The stunning garlic mushroom rounded of a great plate of flavour 😋

Great place! Food was so delicious, service was on point throughout and the team were kind enough to treat us for deserts and wine for our Wedding Anniversary, which was such a lovely surprise!! THANK YOU!!! Hope to come back soon!

Had the best beef tartare I’ve ever tasted incredibly fresh, perfectly seasoned, and packed with flavor.

The steak was just as impressive: juicy, tender, and beautifully charred on the outside. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients and know how to prepare them right.

The restaurant was very clean and had a refined, welcoming atmosphere. It is on the expensive side, so not an everyday spot, but definitely worth it for a special occasion or when you want to treat yourself. Highly recommended for steak and tartare lovers.

venues.name: COYA Mayfair
venues.description: Upmarket venue with 3 open kitchens, serving Peruvian sharing plates, char-grill dishes and ceviche.

reviews.text:
Beautiful restaurant if you are looking for something special.  The service and attention was refined and not overwhelming. The sommelier was knowledgeable and eager to help find that right wine.
The food was cleverly presented and eye pleasing.
That had several dining option which was very much appreciated. Set menu pair with drinks or order a la cart
The thing you need to be aware is if you want a leisurely meal the set menu is at the kitchens pace. Felt a bit rushed and even the lunch menu states it’s designed to be an hour. Meaning looking to turn tables.
The waiter never made us feel rushed but the pace nonetheless felt it. Waiter tried to accommodate.
It is a bit pricey and value of food was almost there but was stretched. Again beautifully presented. We asked for our beef fillet medium rare but was medium well. But the value was made up by ambience and the staffs attention.
So more of a destination dining experience than a culinary destination.
That honestly stated , we had a most enjoyable dining experience.

Tried during June for 2, we weren’t super hungry so we got this and was more than enough:

Tacos de Shiitake con Chalaquita (6/10), tasted soulless tbh, but others could enjoy it as a vegetarian option.

Classic Sea Bass Ceviche (10/10) absolutely divine.

Pollo a la Parrilla (10/10) so soft and full flavor, amazing.

Would love to come here again to try other dishes 👍🏻

Nothing special! Definitely not worth the fortune we paid. The waiter forgot one of our starters and generally, we were advised that we had ordered loads of food whereas we left the place hungry. The portions are extremely small for what you pay.
Will not go back.

venues.name: Corrigan's Mayfair
venues.description: Modern gourmet cuisine in a high-end destination highlighting thoughtfully sourced ingredients.
venues.address: 28 Upper Grosvenor St, London W1K 7EH, UK

reviews.text:
Had a lovely lunch at Corrigan’s. The ambience is elegant but welcoming, with a classic interior that makes the experience feel special without being overly formal. Service was smooth and attentive, creating a relaxed pace to enjoy the meal.

The food was fresh, simple, and well executed. Each dish was cleanly presented with good ingredients allowed to shine — from the light starters to the perfectly cooked fish and thoughtful desserts. A refined lunch that balances comfort and finesse.

Just stunning! Service was exemplary, perfectly attentive but not at all intrusive. Everyone was charming and extremely knowledgeable, from the barman who served our drinks beforehand and chatted to us, through to all the waiting staff. Our food was sublime (shellfish cocktail, asparagus; whole rabbit for two; souffle and ice-creams), each dish was technically excellent, tasted amazing but also generously portioned. The sommelier's suggested wine pairings were lovely and didn't take advantage in terms of price per glass. We can't fault the evening.

I think this was the most delicious meal that I have ever eaten!! Every mouthful was sumptuous. This restaurant is a real treat of a place, not only wonderful food, but lovely, kind and attentive staff. I could have stayed all day. Thank you for such a fabulous experience. I felt truly spoilt. If ever you get a chance to go here - take it!

venues.image_alt: Corrigan's Mayfair — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: The Ivy Asia Mayfair
venues.description: Elegant destination with dramatic decor serving high-end meals, plus cocktails, afternoon tea & DJs.
venues.address: 8-10 N Audley St, London W1K 6ZD, UK

reviews.text:
Gorgeous restaurant and incredible food.  We had a table of four, did some appetizers and tried the experience menu and it was amazing.  The tempura prawns were great and I don’t even like tempura.  I might be a tempura fan now!!  Also, the beef fillet was very good!!

We had drinks after dinner and had a blast.  The dirty martinis were on point and the bartender was friendly and attentive.  We would definitely go back!!

Absolutely underrated. Stunning menu and service was excellent. Went for my best friend's birthday meal and we was no disappointed. Their set menus were good but unfortunately we missed the time slot so chose from the A La Carte Menu and we were not disappointed. The quality and taste of the food went beyond our expectations and we all thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and would love to come again! Our waitress was very kind and lovely.

The food and atmosphere were amazing. Shame about the service, our waiter, Romanos, didn't pay much attention to us and everytime he served us he had a look on his face that he didn't want to be there. I kept having to waive my hand in the air to get him to serve us and one time even had to get up, for such a nice establishment, it should happen. We didn't bother staying for dessert because of this but I would definitely want to return as the food was top class and we had pleasant interactions with other staff. We ordered the Gochuchang Chicken, black cod, yellow tail sashimi and the prawn rendang and all those dishes were amazing. Would definitely recommend!! The statue in the washroom is hilarious BTW 🤣

venues.name: Bacchanalia Mayfair
venues.description: Bacchanalia Mayfair is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Bacchanalia Mayfair provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.author_name: Samira Hotel, Food, Travel& Beauty Expert
reviews.text:
Breathtaking atmosphere — a true visual spectacle.
The interior at Bacchanalia is absolutely stunning. The ceiling installations with the winged horses and the opulent garlands are nothing short of mesmerizing — it feels like dining inside a living artwork. The decor alone makes the visit unforgettable.

The only downside was the wait. Even with a reservation, we had to wait quite a while for our table, which was a bit frustrating considering how busy it was. However, the staff handled it well and offered us an aperitif, which was a classy touch and made the delay more bearable.

Once seated, everything turned around — the food was outstanding. The flavors, presentation, and quality were exactly what you’d expect from a place of this level. Service throughout the meal was warm and well-coordinated.

Bacchanalia really does feel more like an experience than just dinner. The space is dramatic — Roman statues, rich colors, and a kind of grandeur that makes you pause when you walk in. It’s bold and theatrical, but somehow still inviting.

The food was excellent across the board. Fresh seafood, perfectly made pasta, and a wine list that clearly had thought put into it. Service was attentive without being too much, which I appreciated.

The star for me, though, was dessert — the Medusa pavlova (pictured). It’s almost too beautiful to touch, a sculpted meringue surrounded by cream, berries, and coulis. But once you dig in, the flavors are as good as the presentation — light, crisp, tangy, and sweet in just the right balance.

The food here is decent but not outstanding — I’d give it about 6.5 out of 10. Service is around 6 out of 10 as well. The atmosphere, however, is excellent — a solid 10 out of 10. Overall, if you’re coming mainly for the ambiance, it’s worth visiting. But if you’re looking for really great food, this might not be the place for you.

venues.name: Kitty Fisher's Mayfair
venues.description: Modern British fare with a Spanish twist served in a polished, dimly lit space with a bar.

reviews.text: As a meat lover, I have to say the Belted Galloway Wing Rib was amazing! The Crispy Potatoes were super crunchy, and the dessert was perfectly balanced. The whole dining experience was really enjoyable, and the staff were friendly. Perfect spot for a nice meal for two - I’ll definitely be back!

Went to Kitty Fisher’s after a friend hyped it up for the steak, but left pretty disappointed. We ordered the steak to share, asked for medium rare, it came undercooked, sent it back, and even then it was still very rare inside. On top of that, it was a really fatty cut and just lacked flavour. For the price, it felt more like a cheap piece of meat than a premium one.

That said, the potato crisps were actually amazing, super crispy and packed with flavour. The salad was fine, and the bottle of red wine from the Loire Valley was easily the best part of the meal.

Service was friendly and the staff were nice, but overall the food didn’t live up to the hype. We spent around £60 each, and I wouldn’t go back based on this experience.

Atmosphere and service was fantastic.

Food is fantastic- wasn’t a big fan of the texture / how eggs were cooked in the asparagus starter but the flavour profile was lovely.

The whipped cod roe toast was great and they were kind enough to give me a GF portion.

The risotto was deceptively filling. We split it between the two of us and were genuinely stuffed.

Price was much more reasonable than expected considering we ordered a whole carafe of wine.

venues.name: Gordon Ramsay Bar & Grill
venues.description: Gordon Ramsay's swish hotel restaurant for steak, sushi and modern grill fare with Asian influences.

reviews.text:
The best and most iconic Beef Wellington experience in London! I give Gordon Ramsay Bar & Grill Mayfair two hands up.

We ordered the Beef Wellington along with side dishes like creamy spinach and a nice glass of wine. The Wellington was made with a rich mushroom duxelles and foie gras, wrapped in golden, flaky puff pastry. The beef itself was tender yet slightly crusty on the outside — such a perfect combination of textures and flavors.

Since it’s a bar and we visited at lunchtime, I didn’t expect such a high-level experience, but I ended up with complete satisfaction. It was truly beyond my expectations, and I had a wonderful time here.

Overall this place was overpriced, bad food, and weird ambience. Honestly I’m not sure what I expected (I feel like this is going to Olive Garden in Times Square and expecting it to be good) but I wanted to try a Gordon Ramsey restaurant.

The menu is super expensive. This was probably the most expensive meal we had in London while also being by far the worst. The sushi roll was terrible and was £20. I get better sushi from the hole in the wall places next to my apartment in NYC for 1/3 the price. The fish and chips (the main thing I wanted to try) was also not good - while the fish was flaky and clean tasting, it had no flavor. It was just bland and the tartar sauce wasn’t good. Not to mention the fries and peas which did not impress either. The bread and tomato salad were good.

The ambience is weird - there’s no sign/host stand and in order to enter the restaurant, you need to enter the other Gordon Ramsey restaurant next door and then enter this one through an unmarked side door. Very confusing and odd. Service was also very slow.

Had a lovely evening at Gordon Ramsay Bar & Grill in Mayfair. The service was attentive and professional throughout — staff were friendly and made us feel welcome.

We ordered the signature Beef Wellington with wine pairing. The food itself was excellent — perfectly cooked and beautifully presented. However, the wine pairing experience was a bit underwhelming. The wines were served late and didn’t arrive in time with the courses, which took away from the overall experience slightly.

That said, the atmosphere was great, and the quality of the meal was definitely a highlight. Would still recommend, especially for a special occasion — just hoping they fine-tune the wine service to match the standard of the food.

venues.name: Scott's
venues.description: Huge selection of market-fresh fish, seafood and caviar plus an elegant oyster and champagne bar.

reviews.text: Excellent service. I had no reservations however I was welcomed and accomodated directly all smiles and friendly. The food was top knotch. The seabass was delicious and the haddock. Would recommend.

My friend and I visited Scott’s for a quick lunch after a meeting, and it was a great choice. She was in the mood for fish without the overpowering fishy taste, so she went for the cod, and I chose the sea bass; both were fabulous. After our mains, we were lucky to get an outdoor table for dessert. Sitting outside, people-watching and enjoying the view, made it a beautiful and memorable lunch break.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ - 5 stars across the board! Scotts has fantastic service, delicious food, and wonderful ambiance to enjoy a meal in busy London. With a rich history we all loved their menu and food. They also accommodated a larger than expected party size. We will be back!

venues.name: Isabel Mayfair
venues.description: Upmarket restaurant plating local & global fare, plus weekend brunch & a robust wine list.

reviews.text: The food at Isabel Mayfair is exquisite – beautifully presented with rich, layered flavours that make every dish feel special. Their cocktails are just as impressive, perfectly balanced and creative, each one tasting as good as it looks. Together, the food and drinks create a dining experience that feels indulgent yet effortless.

I absolutely loved my experience at Isabel! 🥂✨
The food was incredible – every dish bursting with flavour. The atmosphere is sophisticated, warm, and full of vibrant energy, perfect for a special dinner or a more lively night out.
The champagne was perfectly chilled and absolutely delicious! 🍾
I had such a great time and will definitely be coming back. A true gem in Mayfair!
We had such a wonderful evening at Isabel. The atmosphere is intoxicating, food is delicious and staff took care of us very well. Isabel is one of my favourite places in Mayfair.

venues.name: Rabbit British Bistro
venues.description: Sustainable ingredients and wines from the family farm in Sussex are served in a bucolic space.

reviews.text:
We happened across Rabbit when walking in the neighborhood. What we found was amazing!

The food and service were fantastic. Our server Harsh, was so attentive and made excellent recommendations.

We started with oysters and their home made beards and butter.  Our main was roasted chicken with roasted veggies and an amazing potato and leek terrine.

The family has their own vineyard and all the food is farm to table.

Highly recommend. We’re going back for more!

We live within 5 minutes to Rabbit Bistro but haven't tried it yet. I am glad we found a little gem in Chelsea.Last week my daughter and I had fab 2, 3-course lunch there. We also tried their signature  mushroom marmite eclair. Service was polite and swift. Very reasonable price in the heart of Chelsea. Unpretentious and comfy place. We enjoyed it so much I already made another reservation to introduce it to my goody friend. Definitely recommend.

The food was fantastic, especially the Gressingham Duck Breast and the Beef with Chimichurri. Both were perfectly tender and very flavourful. The lamb skewers were fine, but were not as interesting as the other options. The Rabbit Spritz was also delicious, and is one of my new favourite cocktails.

The service could have been a bit more attentive. I understand it wasn’t a busy night and we were the only people sat in our area, but we didn’t have anyone come past us for ages and couldn’t order another drink.

venues.name: The Ivy Chelsea Garden
venues.description: Modern British menus served in a refined, art-filled space with a garden terrace and an orangery.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful dinner! This place was recommended by a local client of mine and it was amazing! They first guided us to a table all the way in the back of the garden next to the bar, which wasn’t great so we asked to be moved and we got a way better spot! Great atmosphere, super friendly staff! The food was on point! Highly recommend!

The food is nice and the place is well decorated, however the lady served our table gave us 2 vege breakfasts instead of one vege and one full fat.

A bit careless as she could have double checked with us for the order before it is placed.

There were only us ordering at the time and she only took orders and not serving. It is another person served food to us.

Dear Ivy Chelsea Garden event team,

I just wanted to extend my warmest thanks to you and your team for making my sister’s bridal shower last weekend so special. Everything was beautifully arranged — from the delicious food to the beautiful atmosphere at the Glasshouse and attentive service — it all came together perfectly.

Your staff support and attention to detail truly made the day stress-free and enjoyable for all of us. I couldn’t have imagined it going any better, and I’m so grateful for the care you put into making it such a memorable event.

I absolutely loved the experience at The Ivy Chelsea Garden, and I know this will be the first of many events we’ll celebrate with you in the future.

With gratitude,

Saeeda

venues.name: Bluebird Chelsea
venues.description: European food and cocktails in smart spot with monochrome floor tiles, feature lighting and terrace.

reviews.text:
Coming to Bluebird was a great experience from start to finish. The ambiance was vibrant yet relaxed, making it a perfect spot for both casual outings and special occasions. One of the first things we noticed was how warm and welcoming the staff were—friendly, attentive, and professional. The service was truly top-notch, easily a 10/10.

We appreciated the flexibility of having both indoor and outdoor seating options, which is always a plus depending on the weather. We chose to sit outdoor this time as the weather was lovely plus they had the heaters on .

For our meal, we ordered a beautifully cooked salmon dish and a plate of gnocchi. Both dishes were excellent—flavorful, well-presented, and satisfying. The portion sizes were just right, leaving us room to try dessert. We couldn’t resist ordering one to share, and it turned out to be a great decision—the dessert was absolutely delicious and provided the perfect end to our meal.

Given the central location and the high quality of food and service, we found the prices to be quite reasonable. We paid roughly £90 in total, which included a beer and a cider.

We’d definitely come back again and would recommend Bluebird to others!

Took my mum here for a birthday lunch and it was such a lovely experience. The food was absolutely delicious (Caesar salad was perfect) and the team were so friendly and welcoming. They really spoiled my mum and made it feel special, and we never felt rushed.

The salmon here is absolutely outstanding – truly the best I’ve ever had. Perfectly cooked, tender, and full of flavor, it really shows the chef’s skill and attention to detail. If you love salmon, this place sets a new standard!

venues.image_alt: Bluebird Chelsea — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: The Cadogan Arms
venues.description: Modern British gastropub with darkwood interior and mounted stag antlers, plus upstairs pool room.

reviews.text:
The Cadogan Arms – Sunday Roast

This was easily one of the top two restaurants we visited on our trip.

Reservations: Highly recommended—this place gets busy, especially for Sunday roast.

Service: Friendly, fast, and attentive. No complaints at all.

Food: My wife and I shared the Native Rump of Beef Roast, which was excellent—flavorful, tender, and well presented. Our friends went for the Sunday Sharer Board, and it was a hit. Even though it was a large portion, they enjoyed it so much they said they could’ve eaten more.

Drinks: Well-prepared and paired nicely with the meal.

Overall: A must-visit if you’re looking to enjoy a traditional Sunday roast in London. Great food, warm service, and an atmosphere that makes the experience special.

This pub is the real thing. From the moment you arrive, you realise it’s the place to be on the King’s Road. Whether you want a drink at the bar, eat at the restaurant or watch a game downstairs, this spot has everything to offer.

I came for the food. Actually food was so good, I came back the following week again. One thing to note is that the Cadogan Arms is part of the JKS Group which owns some of the best restaurants in London including Gymkhana, Brigadiers, Sabor, Bao, etc.

Food review:
-onion bhajis for starters 10/10 super flavours
-fried chicken for starters 10/10, coating is just superb
-tried the mushroom pie 9/10, some extra gravy would have hit the spot but the tarragon gave it so much flavour
-ham steak with egg 8/10, their specialty it seems, very good but wasn’t my fav

I also tried some dishes from others and everything was delicious so I really think you can’t go wrong.

Service is super professional, staff are on point and you’d hope so for the 13.5% discretionary service charge they add.

Overall I love the vibe, love the food and it’s really a top gastro pub. Can’t wait to come back. Book in advance!

Lovely birthday lunch.
Food is fab, cauliflower onion bhaji, fish and chips and world class sticky toffee pudding. Pub classics done to perfection.
Great choice of wine and cider.
Great friendly young staff, all doing a great job. All kind and helpful.
The Cadogan Arms is a great pub and we had a brilliant afternoon there and we recommend 100% and look forward to our next visit.

venues.image_alt: The Cadogan Arms — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Medlar
venues.description: High-end, Modern French food with global influences, served in an understated dining room.

reviews.text: Four of us had a wonderful meal here from their lunch set menu. I would have been happy with any of the choices from starters, mains and desserts. The service was fantastic, the wine list was excellent and the food was just magnificent. Huge tastes going on and we were all full to the brim upon leaving. I would thoroughly recommend Medlar to anyone who is thinking of going.

Went to celebrate my birthday. Dinner was excellent - ambience is perfect (quiet, clean and tidy); service is top notch; food is exceptional with nice pairing of sides and great combination of taste. I really enjoy the dinner! P.S. a special treat of strawberry sorbet from Medlar 🙏🏼

Simply stunning dining experience!
Our second visit and now firmly our treat restaurant when in London.

Everything from the friendly, on-point service to the beautiful food and ambience.  Unusual for a place to get everything right.

Beautiful bread, wonderfully fresh and tasty.  Crab ravioli is a fabulous starter. Rump beef and halibut were both amazing dishes. And ordered the triple cooked chips, simply the best chips I've ever tasted.

We shared a cheese board, it was huge and some of the cheeses were sublime.  Washed down with a few sherries and a bottle of wine, we can't recommend it highly enough.

Wonderful dining experience and they overheard me saying to my husband that he could choose the wine as it was his birthday.  With the cheese came a creme brule,  candle and the team singing happy birthday to my husband.  Exceptionally observant service and executed with style and friendliness.

We can't wait until we can visit again.

venues.name: Three Darlings
venues.description: Three Darlings is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Three Darlings provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
Three Darlings, a neighbourhood bistro on Chelsea's Pavilion Road is a celebration of @_jasonatherton and @irhaatherton three daughters.
It is an all day operation serving everything from breakfast to late night cocktails.
Casual yet elegant ambience. The design carves the restaurant into distinctive areas.
The menu is divided into breads, starters and mains over a separate menu for dessert.
The food was good but the desserts didn't live up to the expectations. The Caviar Soft serve was basically an ice cream with caviar! Not every culinary idea works.

Really cute spot, but the timing wasn’t great—we arrived at 10:45 on a Sunday and didn’t realise the kitchen shuts at 11 for 30 minutes (they switch from the breakfast to the brunch menu). Feels like a bit of an odd time to stop service, especially on a weekend. The later menu just has a few more things, but a lot is the same.

They were clearly understaffed—staff were lovely and doing their best, but there just weren’t enough of them. We had to chase for pretty much everything (getting menus, ordering, paying).

On the plus side, the courtyard is such a nice place to sit on a warm day, and the food was genuinely tasty. I had the French toast and really liked it—soft and delicious.

I’d definitely go back, but I hope they get a bit more help on busy mornings!

Best place for brunch , cafe is lovely especially in a sunny day . Staff were super friendly & classy

Nice outdoor seating , lovely indoor seating for big group . Toilets are downstairs so u need to use the stairs . Super clean toilets

Ordered avocado with eggs ( choose scrambled instead of poached ) £15 and add £6 for any time of eggs

french toast with caramelised banana with maple syrup £14 , ice cream  £4.50 extra ,

salad with vegetables £14

potion of broccoli  £8

Food was super delicious , salad portion was small but the dressing ( minty lemon ) and vegs were sooo lovely

I just need to add that we went on the special time of the year we’re all shops display all sorts of flowers so kings road was so busy but amazingly   great

venues.name: Beaufort House Chelsea
venues.description: Sophisticated venue offering all-day European dining & afternoon tea, plus a champagne bar.

reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at kora. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure everything was perfect throughout the meal.

All the plates we ordered were absolutely delicious and full of flavour, especially the octopus and lamb which were both beautifully presented, and clearly made with fresh ingredients.

The ambiance was perfect for a relaxing meal—whether you're out with friends, family, or on a date. I also really appreciated how clean and well-kept the space was.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality food and great service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

We went there to meet my wifes school friends.
And our table was like 8 people.
We ordered food, cafe  coctails.
There were also other tables too like 5 or 6.
Waiteress was like a little face and  mooddown.
Than we realised .
All restaurant has only one waitress  serving too all tables and also making coctails and brewing coffe and serving.
That  day she was alone.
:))
When i was paying the bill we left extra tip for her because when we were young we worked like her.
Food was good.
Coctails was good.
All fine..
Nice place to meet and chat with friends.

Had a great time here with a excellent Christmas dinner party. Really enjoyed the positive energy of the place and especially the staff. Great food, nice wines and cocktails. Have been here serveral times before and will definetly come back again and again.

venues.name: BÓHA LONDON
venues.description: BÓHA LONDON is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.3-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, BÓHA LONDON provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.vicinity: The Chelsea Lodge, 562 King's Rd, London

reviews.text:
One of the worst roast dinners I have ever eaten. My friend and I ordered the three cut sharing roast, almost all of it was inedible.

The chicken was cold and had a weird sickly sweet taste.  The lamb was grey in colour and chewy.  The broccoli tasted sour.  The parsnips were undercooked and hard.  I could only eat the beef, which was nice, the potatoes and carrots and the Yorkshire.

My drink was also supposed to be made with caramelised apple but they “didn’t have any” so they just served it with fresh apple but still charged me the same price.  Aren’t you supposed to caramelise the apple upon order? 🙄 I would not ever come back here and I’m just grateful I didn’t end up with food poisoning.

Beautiful setting with a stylish, nature-inspired interior — the atmosphere at BOHA is warm, vibrant, and perfect for a night out.

We had a really good experience overall. The steak was cooked perfectly, and the service was professional and attentive throughout.

A great spot for both food and vibe, would definitely come back

My recent visit to BÓHA London was truly exceptional. The food was outstanding! Each dish was crafted with precision and bursting with flavor. The calamari and the cabbage in particular were absolutely sensational.The cocktails were equally impressive, absolutely delicious.
A special mention goes to Daniela, who assisted me over the phone with my reservation. She was incredibly friendly and accommodating, setting a positive tone for the evening. The entire staff demonstrated professionalism and warmth, making the dining experience even more enjoyable.
A lovely surprise during my meal was when the head chef personally came to my table to check if everything met my expectations—such a thoughtful and genuine gesture that made the experience feel even more special.
From start to finish, everything exceeded my expectations. I recommend BÓHA London to anyone seeking a top-tier dining experience in the city

venues.name: Daphne's
venues.description: Italian mainstay for a well-heeled clientele, known for people-watching and classic cuisine.

reviews.text:
The linguine with scallops was excellent, and the seabass was cooked perfectly, though the sauce wasn’t to my taste so I couldn’t finish it.

Decor is stylish and the staff are extremely attentive—at times a little too present, but always very polite and helpful. Overall, I’d recommend this restaurant.

Went to Daphne’s for a birthday dinner and it was absolutely perfect! Definitely make a reservation, the inside is so charming, it really feels like you’ve been transported to Italy. Cozy, cute, and full of great vibes, with service that was top-notch. We started with a few cocktails, and they even surprised us with a little happy birthday treat, which was such a sweet touch. For dinner, we tried the Ravioli di Mozzarella and the Risotto, both were incredible. If you’re in Chelsea and looking for a cozy, authentic Italian spot for a special night out, I highly recommend Daphne’s.

Daphne’s is such a charming and welcoming restaurant. The atmosphere feels warm and inviting, and the team is super friendly. The Italian food is absolutely outstanding – authentic, full of flavor, and beautifully prepared. Located in a very trendy area, it’s the perfect spot for a relaxed lunch or a special dinner. An absolute recommendation!

venues.name: Stanley's Chelsea
venues.description: Upscale destination serving sophisticated British cuisine in a romantic setting featuring a garden.

reviews.text:
We recently held our wedding reception at Stanley’s and cannot recommend it highly enough!

The food and drinks were out of this world – every course was beautifully prepared, full of flavour, and an absolute joy to eat. The wine and cocktail selection was excellent too, with something for everyone and perfectly paired with the meal.

The service was second to none. Every single member of staff was attentive, knowledgeable, and welcoming, which made the whole day run seamlessly.

The courtyard looked stunning, and the team went above and beyond both in the set-up and in the lead-up to the big day. Their care and attention to detail truly exceeded our expectations and the planning process was so relaxed and enjoyable.

Stanley’s helped make our wedding day so special, and we’ll treasure the memories forever. We’re already looking forward to coming back with friends and family – a glass of wine on the terrace will be the perfect way to relive those happy moments!

Thank you to Peter, Hugh and the whole team – you really made our day unforgettable.

We held our wedding reception at Stanley’s on Friday 12th, and I cannot recommend it highly enough. From start to finish, Peter and Hugh were absolutely amazing—their professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail made the whole experience seamless. The entire team of staff was impeccable, ensuring everything ran smoothly and that our guests were well looked after.
The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and delivered piping hot to every guest—a detail that made such a difference. Many of our guests commented on how much they enjoyed their meals, which added even more to the celebration.
The courtyard restaurant decoration was just so beautiful, creating the perfect setting and atmosphere for our special day.
The combination of outstanding service, incredible food, and a stunning venue made our wedding day truly unforgettable. We are so grateful to Stanley’s for making our celebration so special ❤️

I had my wedding meal here on Saturday for 32 people and I have to say the food, atmosphere and staff were all fabulous! The staff made sure the drinks were flowing (remembering individually what wine people were drinking!) and the food came out with no faults and no mix ups! The lead up to the day was stress free and very well organised, ensuring they had enough wine for the day, drinks on arrival and even had our own personalised menu! Thank you for making our day so special, everyone had the most amazing time and we will definitely be back 🥰

venues.name: Granger & Co. Chelsea
venues.description: Eclectic fare with an Australian flair served in a simple setting with a sophisticated vibe.

reviews.text: The atmosphere and service are excellent, and it’s truly enjoyable to sit here. I’ve been here many times and come frequently, as the breakfast options are amazing with plenty to choose from. The main courses are decent, though not as impressive as the breakfast, but overall it’s a place I would definitely recommend.

No matter how many years pass, this branch maintains the same great quality and service. I always have at least one breakfast there whenever I visit London. The ricotta pancakes, scrambled eggs, and coffee are excellent. My all-time favorite side is the roasted miso mushrooms, though they seemed less seasoned during my last visit.

Good brunch spot in London. Granger & Co served some delicious food if not overpriced in my opinion for what it is and portion size. I definitely recommend reserving a table as the wait for it is around 30 minutes for late breakfast/lunch times and then we waited quite a long time for the food itself. I really enjoyed my corn fritters however I had to order extra bacon with it. Good thing I did as without it I would find a dish a bit lacking, hence paid more than £20. However, I would say once in a year or so I could treat myself. Thank you, delicious 😊

venues.image_alt: Granger & Co. Chelsea — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: The Ivy Asia Chelsea
venues.description: The Ivy Asia Chelsea is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.4-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, The Ivy Asia Chelsea provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
I had a pleasant experience at The Ivy Asia, Chelsea restaurant, where I was seated promptly despite arriving early. The reception staff was friendly and welcoming, and Agnes delivered great customer service, particularly when checking on me to ensure the meal was satisfactory. The food was well presented and flavorful, and the doughnut dessert was outstanding. I went for the Samurai Dinner set Menu. The ambience and decor were impressive, and the toilets were impeccably clean with a pleasant scent.

However, the stall seating I was assigned near the kitchen felt cramped, and as a solo diner, I was told tables were mostly reserved for two, which would have been best not mentioning for a first time visitor. Table clearing and dish changes were slow at times, and I noticed inconsistent hygiene among the chefs where one wore gloves, but the other didn’t. Despite these slight drawbacks, I’d return and highly recommend The Ivy Asia for its vibrant atmosphere, tasty offerings and good service overall.

I visited The Ivy Asia Chelsea during my trip to London, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish. The moment you step inside, you’re captivated by the stunning and vibrant Asian-inspired décor — from the glowing floors to the elegant lighting and artistic details throughout the space.

Although the restaurant was quite busy when we arrived, we managed to get a table without a long wait, which reflects great organization and efficient hosting. The atmosphere inside was energetic and lively — perfect for a memorable dinner with friends or family.

The food was absolutely delicious. Every dish we tried was well-prepared, flavorful, and made with fresh ingredients. The service was outstanding, and the staff were incredibly friendly, offering suggestions and checking in with genuine warmth.

The prices were very reasonable considering the quality of the food, ambiance, and location. It felt like a complete experience where every detail was thoughtfully executed.

I’ll definitely come back again on my next visit to London. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a refined and vibrant Asian dining experience in the heart of Chelsea.

Ivy Asia offers a great selection of varied Asian cuisines, cocktails and wine! I celebrated my birthday there for reservation for 2, we waited 15 minutes to be seated but we were able to enjoy drinks at the bar. The restaurant offers two types of food menus: Set menu - appetiser, starter, main and dessert at an extra cost of £5. As well as single food item orders with a wide selection of appetisers, small plates, large plates and sharing plates etc. The food, drinks and atmosphere was fantastic! However, our waitress Andrea could improve on her customer service mannerisms to ensure all guests have an equal welcoming experience!

venues.name: No. Fifty Cheyne
venues.description: Bright modern Provençal brasserie with sky blue banquettes and upstairs salon with river views.
venues.vicinity: Our Most Holy Redeemer, 50 Cheyne Walk, London

reviews.text:
So, we went for Sunday lunch the other day at No 50 Cheyne. The food was seriously yummy, the place itself was gorgeous, and the people working there were mostly nice.

But, and it's a big but, the wait times were just awful. We got there maybe five or ten minutes early, but still had to hang around for like twenty minutes before our table was even ready.

After we finally seated by staff, it took another 20minutes for our drinks to show up.

I get that Sundays can be crazy busy, you know? But, we waited, get this, 50 to 60minutes for our food to come after we ordered! That meant we didn't eat until about an 1hrs and a half after we were supposed to.

It was especially tough with a 5year old child with us. The only reason they gave us was that the steak needed to be cooked, which is the most hilarious excuse I’ve had for a long wait for a meal, and I didn't really buy that, to be honest.

Basically, we liked the food and the vibe, it’s a bit pricey for a Sunday roast, but the long waits made us feel a little… unappreciated, I guess.

It's a real pity, because it could have been a fantastic experience.

Having seen a review by eatingwithtod, we were looking forward to Sunday Lunch. As nice as it was, it unfortunately didn’t quite live up to expectations.

Nice welcome and lovely server. Order was taken quick enough and the trio of meats was served fairly quickly too. However, the chicken was dry and the lamb and beef were tough. Shining light was the roast potatoes and chocolate mousse for dessert. But for the price, I’d expected better and we kept having to ask for our Prosecco to be topped up! The waitress who initially served us seemed to be rushed off her feet.

Staff were really pleasant and very professional they made us feel welcomed. The beef wellington was great. As well as the lobster. The deserts were delicious to. The decor was beautiful and the washing facilities were very clean of a very good standard. The only thing we didn't really like was the prawns but they weren't too bad but probably won't get them again. But I really would go back again even just for the wellington.

venues.image_alt: No. Fifty Cheyne — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Flat Iron Covent Garden
venues.description: Flat Iron Covent Garden is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Flat Iron Covent Garden provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
My husband and I came to celebrate our birthdays on a late night dinner reservation. We were immediately met with smiles and kindness from the host and they were able to sit us about 10 minutes early. We were quickly brought drinks and popcorn which was so sweet and unexpected. Our server Alex was so fun, attentive, and full of energy even though it was late at night (we had a 10:15pm reservation)! He helped make our time such a joy. Alex was absolutely great and it was a pleasure to have him as our server. Even though it wasn’t the exact date of our birthdays, he kindly brought us prosecco to cheers with without us asking. We ordered steak, the chili pepper burger, and macaroni & cheese which were all delicious. The steak was perfectly cooked and the burger was juicy as ever. The macaroni was so good we ordered a second! The food came out quick and the prices were very affordable especially for a steakhouse—great for being on a budget!
I would highly recommend this place and I wish we could come again during our stay!
You will be blessed if you happen to have Alex as your server!
Thank you Alex and Flat Iron!
We hope to be back!

Hands down this was the friendliest restaurant we went to during our entire trip in London. We were checked on by multiple staff. Who were all welcoming and kind. The drinks were surprisingly not expensive for the quality they were.The rose lemonade was straight up fantastic. The steak was perfectly cooked. The house dressing on the green salad was to die for. The photos do not do this place justice. You even get free ice cream on your way out. Without question this was our favorite restaurant and would highly recommend.

This was our favorite restaurant that we tried in London!

The staff was very friendly and efficient ! We reserved for lunch and had no wait. Without reservations the wait was 30 minutes I heard the host telling a couple right in front of us.

The steak was delicious!!!! We had the Mac and cheese and the fries and they were both amazing.

The ice cream of this location is just superb ! What a great experience!

If you want to try the flat iron, try this location. We loved it so much that we went to another location, but the experience was not the same.

The only thing is, the tables are really close to each other and the table we were placed in the basement was in the middle of the passageway which bothered me a little that people kept passing by us all the time. Besides that, from the host to the server and the ice cream server all staff is friendly and polite !

venues.name: Caravan Covent Garden Restaurant
venues.description: Caravan Covent Garden Restaurant is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Caravan Covent Garden Restaurant provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Absolutely yum! We came here last week and had a great experience, from start to finish. All of the staff and servers were attentive, friendly and offered great recommendations. The food was absolutely delicious, packed full of flavour and they had lots of options for dietary needs (gluten free, vegan, etc), and we loved the cocktails and all of the yummy flavours. They even had a pre theatre menu which was very reasonable. I would recommend a visit if you're in Covent Garden!

Amazing cocktails and incredible staff, Kamani looked after us and served beautiful drinks!! Had some rosemary seasoned fries as a snack and sat at the bar. Now going to the theatre, perfect start to our evening out!!

I recently visited The Caravan Restaurant, and it turned out to be such a pleasant experience. I ordered a coffee and pudding, and both were absolutely spot-on — the coffee was rich and smooth, and the pudding was the perfect balance of sweet and comforting.

What truly stood out during my visit, though, was the service. I was served by an employee named Leighton, who was genuinely warm, attentive, and professional. It’s rare to come across someone who brings such positive energy to their role, and it made the experience feel personal and welcoming.

Leighton’s friendly demeanor and care in service really elevated the moment, turning what could have been an ordinary visit into something memorable.

Highly recommend Caravan — whether you’re in for a full meal or just something small, you’re in good hands.

venues.name: Gaucho Covent Garden
venues.description: Gaucho Covent Garden is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Gaucho Covent Garden provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.vicinity: Royal Opera House, 8-9 James St, London

reviews.text: The steaks were amazing! Never had a steak that perfect before. Cheese croquettes were beautiful too. The chimichurri was stunning, I was claiming that I don’t like chimichurri but Gaucho changed my mind😂 Waiters did their job perfectly too! Thank you very much

We ordered the sharing steak fillet with fries and started with the croquettes. The croquettes were visually beautiful and tasted amazing perfectly crispy on the outside and soft and flavourful inside.

The steak itself was incredible. It was cooked to absolute perfection and just melted in your mouth instantly. You could really taste the quality and care that went into preparing it.

The service was also excellent our waiter was so friendly and genuinely helpful with recommendations, which made the whole experience even better.

The only small suggestion I’d make is that the sharing steak plate could have been presented a bit more nicely in the pan along with the fries a little more visual finesse would have made it perfect.

Overall, it was a fantastic meal with great food and service. I’d definitely come back!

We came here for lunch yesterday for my daughters birthday before going to the theatre  and wow what a fantastic choice we made. All the staff we encountered were fantastic and the service we received was amazing. They couldn't of done more for us to make sure we enjoyed our visit and they made my daughters birthday extra special. The food was incredible we had the set lunch menu 3 courses and it was fantastic value. We also ordered a few sides off the menu as well. The food was presented so lovely and the cocktail i had was incredible. We had the best lunch out here and highly recommend this fantastic restaurant.
