To all the wonderful staff who made our visit so lovely to the incredible food we enjoyed, we will definitely be back when we next visit London. Thankyou Gaucho Covent Garden

venues.name: Blacklock Covent Garden
venues.description: Blacklock Covent Garden is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Blacklock Covent Garden provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
Just brilliant! Tasty steaks and Sunday roast served quickly and with sauces that truly add to the flavour rather than only add fat to the dish. Definitely the best mint sauce I have ever had.
The service was amazing.
I would recommend the All In Sunday roast with a Beefy Mary.
I love it when a restaurant does what it should right (serve great food) without pretentiousness.
The apple crumble and white chocolate cheesecake were excellent conclusions to a lovely roast.
The atmosphere could be a bit less noisy, but to be fair, that is just my preference and some people might consider that good vibes of a busy restaurant.

Visited Blacklock for the first time. Girlfriend booked it for a group of us based on reviews and location. You go in and down into the main area where it is all happening. This was busy and the atmosphere was buzzing. Service was excellent. I went for the 300g fillet and it was good ... very good! Had the crayfish salad for starter and was surprised at how good that was ... the avocado in the base salad is sublime. I did see the beef ribs starters coming out though and admit to some food envy but cannot complain as the crayfish salad was good and quite light before tucking into the steak main. I had the low alcohol beer served in an iced beer glass - nice!. Next time I'm going for the porterhouse! Will definitely be going back to this place and cannot recommend it enough. Superb.

Went around 5pm on a Thursday. They were able to seat us from walking in.

The steak was super lovely. Would recommend the prime rib. The Denver was nice but a tad chewy, however the chips and the bone marrow was lovely and would highly recommend.

We ordered dessert and got the cheesecake and crumble. Would recommend as well.

Had a very good experience at the restaurant but we were made unaware that the restaurant needed the table back at a certain time and it was towards the end of the meal that the host told us that they needed the table back asap which surprised us as we were not told at the beginning and were still waiting on our dessert.

venues.image_alt: Blacklock Covent Garden — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Browns
venues.description: All-day British chain brasserie & bar with lobster nights & afternoon tea in a grand cafe setting.
venues.address: 82-84 St Martin's Ln, Greater, London WC2N 4AG, UK

reviews.text: Nikos our waiter is hands down the best waiter ever! So attentive, we have had fantastic service. He made my mums birthday very special. We will definitely be back. Thank you Nikos. Also food and cocktails were delicious! Try the cherry margarita, you wont regret it

My experience here is amazing! The food is leaning more on the expensive side but it’s worth it - from the portion size to the quality. Everything’s cooked to perfection!

Added to my exquisite experience is the service! Ada was so accommodating and engaged! Definitely a quality service!

5/5 indeed, and highly recommended!

Browns Covent Garden is a delightful spot for a quintessentially English high tea with friends. The art-deco interior feels like stepping back into a glamorous 1920s London lounge, with gleaming brass accents and plush seating. Tiered trays arrive piled high with delicate sandwiches, warm scones, and decadent pastries, and the team is certified gluten-free and caters to allergies like true professionals. The lively yet relaxed atmosphere keeps conversation flowing as easily as the tea and bubbly, though the gluten-free tray could use a little more variety and a few extra fruits in the pot of cream to really shine. It’s popular for good reason, so be sure to book ahead for this stylish afternoon treat.

venues.name: Steak and Company - Covent Garden
venues.description: Contemporary venue specialising in chargrilled beef, ribs and comfort food with a pre-theatre menu.

reviews.text:
We had prawns, pork belly, and something like burger spring rolls as starters. For the main, we got the ribeye steak served on a hot stone with chips. We added mushroom sauce, peppercorn sauce, and another one with wine that I can’t remember the name.

The seasoning on the steaks was nice, and the meat was good quality, but nothing that really wowed me. Overall, the whole experience was cute and different, and it was my first time trying this kind of place, but I probably wouldn’t go back.

It was a bit expensive to be honest, and the steak doesn’t come with anything – you have to add the sauce, chips or mash separately. Also, the stone gets cold halfway through, and I wasn’t really in the mood to ask for a new one since it’s a bit awkward to handle.

The staff were nice and friendly, and even when we arrived late, the lady in charge of bookings was really kind and accommodating.

Overall, I think it’s a bit overhyped considering how it’s always fully booked. Actually you can even ask for your steak to be done by the chef in the kitchen but Personally, I’d rather go to another steakhouse next time and honestly, why am I cooking it myself when I’m paying that much.

Easy 5 stars. Easy. One of the best steaks I had in my life if not the best. The price 100% worth the value, and I hope it will stay this way! The atmosphere is absolutely amazing and the service was friendly and kind. Recommended

We were welcomed by a very friendly man who seated us at the table.
We came for a birthday lunch.
The place wasn’t busy.
The inside area is cozy and nice.
To start with we ordered the fried goat cheese and it was excellent!
I loved every bite of it, perfect combination of flavours.
My partner ordered the steak with the option to fry it on the stone by the table as we thought it might be a nice experience.
I went for a veggie burger and fries on the side that had to be ordered separately.
The frying process was easy and interesting.
We were explained the steps of frying the meat what was very helpful.
My burger was just ok.
The service was nice and friendly what made a great atmosphere at the restaurant.
We had a chat with a man who I believe was a manager.
We were given a nice dessert on the house as we were celebrating birthday.
This was very nice of them.
We also enjoyed our 2 drinks for the price of one.
The place isn’t the cheapest but the experience was kind of worth it also it was a special occasion.

venues.image_alt: Steak and Company - Covent Garden — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Bill's Covent Garden Restaurant
venues.description: Contemporary European chain dishing up separate breakfast, afternoon tea, lunch and dinner menus.
venues.address: St Martin's Courtyard, Slingsby Pl, London WC2H 9EF, UK
venues.vicinity: St Martin's Courtyard, Slingsby Pl, London

reviews.text: I had never been to a Bill’s before but I am so happy I stumbled across this place. There are so many delicious options on the menu that I had trouble deciding but I ended up picking the Big Breakfast plate on their weekend brunch menu. We were served by Beata who was so kind and informative-we would come back just for her service again! To top it all off the atmosphere here is to die for. It’s very homey and cute-fairy lights and umbrella type vibe. This was definitely one of the better restaurants I’ve been to in recent months.

Food was absolutely amazing, quick to the table and presented beautifully. Coffee was one of the best tasting I've had in a long time and and the tea came in a pot. Our server Dana was sweet and caring. Would go again in a heartbeat.

Absolutely delicious breakfast. I was initially drawn to Bill's because of the pancakes, but ended up trying a savory dish instead - squash, spinach, and feta on sourdough with two poached eggs. So different and really tasty. Service was a delight, Dana was warm and accommodating. Would love to return for lunch or dinner.

venues.name: Balthazar
venues.description: Artisan breads and patisseries all made in-house, with sandwiches and coffee for eat-in or takeaway.

reviews.text:
My new favourite restaurant in London, absolutely stunning food and amazing staff.
It was recommended to us by someone that lives in London, and what a find.
You walk into a vibrant ( but not too noisy) atmosphere, the service from every member of staff is impeccable- Rita our waitress was particularly helpful and friendly.
My pork chop was the best I’ve ever had, my wife’s salmon so so tasty and our desserts were simply amazing.
For the price you pay it’s simply amazing value for money.
Can’t wait to go back.

Love, love, love Balthazar's. Menu is great and atmosphere is always great as it is always so crowded. But not too noisy that you cant chat. Service is always excellent and staff are knowledgeable and helpful.

We came for a quick bite and order three things, king prawns, escargot and a cheese burger
The king prawns were probably 1.5-2 cms and when I mentioned it the manager came and insisted these were king prawns. There was no point arguing as he was adamant. The escargot were swimming in some oil and green paste without the shell and the burger was the worse we have ever had at a ‘nice’ restaurant. The patty was compressed and tasted equally flat.
Overall the service was great and quick, the managers know it all attitude when he clearly was wrong and the food quality was very disappointing.

venues.name: Da Mario Covent Garden
venues.description: Italian classics in a simple dining room with framed art, black-and white photos and exposed bricks.

reviews.text: Yummy yummy yummy! Had the seafood pasta and bread with olive oil and balsamic and was absolutely delicious. Definitely on the pricier and upscale vibe but such a lovely place for a nice dinner, date, or professional meeting. My limoncello spritz was also good. The service was amazing too!

A brilliant experience start to finish. The staff were extremely attentive and went above and beyond. The food was 10/10, a very traditional Italian restaurant. Couldn’t recommend enough to anyone visiting the area. Thankyou!

Great food, good service! Apart from when we had to pay and the amount of money shown on the paying device was £143 instead of £56. It's a good thing my husband checked the sum on the device. Otherwise, it would have been a very expensive meal. We want to believe it was an honest mistake.  The staff were friendly and polite. The music on the speaker hanging from the tree was a nice touch.

venues.image_alt: Da Mario Covent Garden — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: The Ivy Market Grill
venues.description: Sibling of the classic Modern European eatery offering walk-in seats in a polished, elegant space.

reviews.text:
Great place for breakfast with a real British atmosphere! We loved the décor — it’s cozy and charming. Very pleasant experience overall.

We ordered the Royal Eggs with smoked salmon (similar to Eggs Benedict) and an English Breakfast. Everything was delicious, and the egg quality was excellent. I also had a lychee matcha — the matcha itself was great quality, just a bit too sweet for my taste (I’d ask for less sweetness next time). My husband ordered a coffee pot with milk, which was a very cool experience and great coffee quality too.

Our server, a young woman named Tasha, was wonderful — super friendly and attentive. Highly recommend this spot if you’re looking for a great breakfast in the heart of London, not far from Big Ben!

I went to Ivy Market Grill on Thursday evening with my brother. Our waiter was Carlos, and I honestly can’t praise him enough. He was full of positive energy, very friendly, and incredibly polite. He really looked after us.

For food, we ordered the Fish & Chips and the Moroccan-style Chicken. The fish and chips were excellent, but the chicken wasn’t really to my taste as it had quite a strong curry flavour.

For dessert, we chose the Chocolate Bombe, which was delicious, and Carlos very kindly surprised us with an extra dessert on the house. That was such a thoughtful gesture and very much appreciated.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience — many thanks to Carlos and the whole team for making our evening so enjoyable.

I had the pleasure of dining at The Ivy Market Grill, Covent Garden for my best friend’s birthday, and the entire experience was exceptional. From the moment we arrived, the hospitality was of the highest standard. The team, including both the waiters and managers, were attentive, professional, and genuinely warm, creating a welcoming atmosphere throughout our visit.

What stood out most was the way they went above and beyond to ensure my girlfriend felt celebrated and special on her birthday. This thoughtful attention to detail made the occasion truly memorable. Even as we departed, the service remained impeccable, demonstrating consistency and care from start to finish.

The food itself was of outstanding quality beautifully prepared, flavourful, and presented with finesse. Combined with the excellent service, it made for a dining experience that exceeded expectations.

I would highly recommend The Ivy Market Grill to anyone seeking not only delicious cuisine but also exemplary service and a refined yet welcoming atmosphere.

venues.name: Violas - Restaurant in Covent Garden
venues.description: Violas - Restaurant in Covent Garden is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.3-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Violas - Restaurant in Covent Garden provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text:
Super cute place!!  I brought a group of 7 here and we loved the food!  Prices were reasonable.
I did the 3 food items for 29£ along with a blue matcha.  It was all delicious.  The Covent Gardens is a cute area to walk around before or after the meal.

Food is lovely - but it's hugely let down by the service and the atmosphere.
1 in 1 out feeling... squeezed in like sardines... waited for what felt like a lifetime and ended up having to ask the waitress to take our order...
Despite prebooking and explaining we were there to celebrate a 3 generational birthday, there was zero extra attention.
When we asked for the bill we weren't really asked if we had a good time... yet the table next to us had a conversation...
The tables were packed in, would absolutely not be considered accessible. If you're plus size, expect to feel very awkward trying to get in/out of your table or in the restaurant at all!!
Flowers were pretty..... 🤷‍♀️
Food was pretty and tasty... so credit to the chefs/cooks. But unfortunately, let down by everything else...

Absolutely amazing food and cocktails here. The staff were amazing and helped recommend dishes. Especially Julia, she went above and beyond to make our experience amazing. The decoration of the restaurant is beautiful it's perfect for pic's with your loved ones, friends and family ❤️ thank you for a wonderful experience. We are heading back now for breakfast 😋

venues.name: Granger and Co. Notting Hill
venues.description: International dining with an Aussie accent in airy, no-reservations dining room with large windows.

reviews.text:
Queue moved quickly and great service.

Nice cocktails and lattes. Unfortunately we'd just missed the brunch menu. Ordered the avocado with poached egg on toast which was really well made but simple.

Starting the day at Granger & Co. was such a treat. The ricotta hotcakes were the fluffiest things ever.. . absolutely delicious. I dined alone and found the atmosphere so welcoming and enjoyable. A perfect spot for a solo breakfast!

I had a wonderful breakfast experience at this lovely restaurant. The service was so warm and welcoming ♥️ it truly made my morning. The poached egg was absolutely the most delicious I’ve ever had, perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The pancakes were something special too, so unique and unlike any I’ve tried before. A perfect spot to start the day with a smile ♥️

venues.image_alt: Granger and Co. Notting Hill — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Osteria Napoletana
venues.description: Area-sourced Neapolitan-style eats & an ample wine list in a cool eatery featuring outdoor seating.
venues.address: 186 Kensington Park Rd, ES W11 2ES, UK
venues.vicinity: 186 Kensington Park Rd, Notting Hill, ES

reviews.text:
Lovely restaurant with delicious food! Make sure you book online, it requires a credit card to secure the booking on OpenTable.

Mattia was our waiter and absolutely lovely. He was very efficient and humorous too! I appreciated his help with the menu and it was a pleasure watching him masterfully mixing drinks!

The food was all lovely. The seafood was all done beautifully and not at all overcooked. All of the pasta was fresh and very tasty. Highly recommend the calzone, I loved the contrasting textures and how the tastes blended together beautifully in each bite! I thought that perhaps the salad could have done with a touch more salt, however it was a nice contrast to the other dishes. Note the other dishes were all seasoned wonderfully.

We particularly enjoyed the complimentary basket of bread. Really delicious selection and it had the perfect amount of sea salt. The tomatoes there were absolutely great, far beyond the normal ones you can get. Adds to the authentic feeling of this Italian restaurant!

The toilets are located downstairs. They are very clean and pleasant. It’s in keeping with the rest of the restaurant, which is well decorated both inside and out.

If you require one, there is a baby seat, it is located downstairs. I don’t believe there is a kids menu. The ragu is very good though and a good size for two young children to share (YMMV).

Prices are a little high here, however you definitely get what you pay for! Highly recommend for anyone looking to treat themselves!

Absolutely delicious! The pomodoro was authentic and full of flavor, but what really made the experience stand out was the special touch of having fresh basil cut right into the olive oil for dipping bread—simple, but unforgettable. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and every bite felt like a little trip to Naples. A truly lovely experience and a meal I’ll be thinking about long after London.

A lovely family gathering at this cozy Italian restaurant. All the dishes were perfectly prepared and well cooked. I recommend the Paccheri alla Scorfano and La Parmigiana di Melanzane. My daughter loved the Pasta Ammiscata Patate e Provola. The service was excellent as well.

venues.image_alt: Osteria Napoletana — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Gold
venues.description: Seasonal, thoughtfully sourced plates are served in this cool eatery that has a bar & a terrace.

reviews.text: Discovered this restaurant randomly while walking along Portobello road with my husband and can’t say I was disappointed. We walked in on a weekday afternoon and the place was relatively packed. Staff were very warm and friendly. Lots of vegetarian options, food was delicious and you could really taste the freshness of the ingredients. Excellent for a date or a business lunch!

Each dish showcased impressive detail, variety and complexity, though a couple felt like they were missing something but overall very tasty. Service was great, wonderful decor inside with decent music in the background which we didn’t expect. The vibe was great.

Gold Notting Hill delivers a memorable meal in a beautiful setting. The ricotta toast was light and flavorful, the sweet potatoes packed with depth, and the pastas—the veal tortelloni and ricotta ravioli—were both refined and delicious. The space itself is stylish yet welcoming, making it a spot I’d happily return to

venues.image_alt: Gold — international restaurant in Central London

venues.address: 101 Notting Hill Gate, London W11 3JZ, UK

reviews.text: We had such a lovely experience today. The food was of excellent quality. The staff were also very warm and welcoming, which made the meal even more enjoyable. We’ll definitely be coming back again！☺️

Complete perfection.

Our waiter Chris was super welcoming, warm and knowledgeable.

The food was genuinely immaculate. The waygu was so good we immediately ordered a 2nd plate.

Highly, highly recommend.

The team advised us on food and were incredibly kind.

Thank you
I highly recommend Lush and Hush, incredible menu with super tasty food and very authentic dining experience. The staff are very attentive and polite. I can’t wait to visit again.

venues.image_alt: LUSH & HUSH — international restaurant in Kensington and Chelsea

The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Caractère provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 209 Westbourne Park Rd, London W11 1EA, UK

reviews.text: A truly special place. The food was phenomenal and consistent with every course impressing us with both flavour and presentation. The setting and ambience is pitched just right without being stuffy. The service was a cut above, with everyone being friendly and super attentive. We went for the tasting menu at dinner time and would recommend a thousand times over for a special occasion.

I have visited the restaurant to celebrate my husband’s birthday and I was blown away by the service and the taste of the food. Every single dishes that we have had was spectacular. I love every bite. I would definitely come back again and highly recommend this place to anyone who is considering. You won’t regret it.
Magnificent experience, incredible food and so much inspiration! Every dish was a piece of art! Looking forward to be back for the tasting menu with the wine pairing!

venues.name: Ottolenghi Notting Hill
venues.description: Serene destination with a chic vibe offering a creative menu of Mediterranean dishes.

reviews.text: Amazing, amazing food-some of the best I had in London! Went in because of their beautiful baked goods but went for 3 take away boxes of their savory items and I was so happy with them! Everything tasted fresh and was so filling. Staff is very kind as well and a nice assortment of snacks and spices to try!

Have always loved the food and staff here over the years, but this weekend was above and beyond. Thank you so much to the team for Catering my 30th, the food and service was exceptional. Special thanks to Charlotte for all the help and advice with planning, she really went out of her way to make the day run smoothly too, will certainly be using them again for future events.
favourite place in London for cakes. That banana tahini cake is sublime. Got served by Luana and Charlotte who recommended it to me. Will be heading there next time I’m in London

venues.name: Wild Restaurant
venues.description: Wild Restaurant is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Wild Restaurant provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: Exceptional food and service.  The sea bass ceviche was incredible, as was the broccoli and the steak. Not pictured but the best ever were the peppers.  Great service at the bar. Wonderful open kitchen gives a great atmosphere. Got a great little London rainstorm that drove everyone inside. Classic.
Every single time - perfect! it’s a joy to come here! Fab food, amazing wine list, great service! Well done! (our little doggy is welcome too which makes us love this place even more).

Yesterday’s experience at the restaurant was unfortunately disappointing. I had been looking forward to visiting after hearing so many positive things about both the food and service. We were a group of five, with friends visiting from Belgium, and while the food itself did not disappoint in particular, the prawn tartare and ox cheek pasta were absolutely delicious. The service fell far short of expectations and ultimately spoiled the evening.
To highlight a few issues: water was never topped up unless we waved and asked, empty glasses were left on the table all night (on one occasion the waiter removed only a single glass and walked away without a word), and our mains were left sitting on the pass because we hadn’t been given cutlery. The manager had to step in to resolve this. There were no checkbacks on starters, and throughout the evening the waiter seemed disengaged and uninterested. At one point I even saw him throw something near the bar till and have what appeared to be a heated discussion with a manager. His lack of presence and professionalism really detracted from what should have been a memorable evening.
To add to the disappointment, when we left, the host didn’t even say goodbye. Small touches like this make a big difference, and their absence was noticeable.
Overall, while the food was excellent, the service was nowhere near the standard I had been led to expect.

reviews.text: Had a nice experience - the tapas were well-executed with a nice variety of flavours - everything felt thoughtfully prepared. Service was friendly and attentive. A relaxed space that’s ideal for a casual catch-up or low-key date night. Would happily return!

This tapas spot in Notting Hill is a true gem! We followed their recommendation of 4-6 plates per couple, which was perfect for a satisfying and varied meal. The menu genuinely has something for everyone, from classic Spanish staples to more adventurous options. What really stands out is how the eclectic decor of this traditional Spanish restaurant is beautifully mirrored in the passionate presentation of the food. Every dish looked as good as it tasted. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful experience here. The service was excellent — the staff were friendly, attentive, and very helpful, which made the visit even more enjoyable. The day’s special octopus was juicy and delicious, and the oxtail was cooked to perfection — I honestly can’t pick which one I enjoyed more. The food overall was fantastic, though the cheesecake was just average compared to the rest of the dishes. Still, a great place to dine and would happily come back again.

venues.name: Dove Restaurant
venues.description: Elegant spot with wood & brick decor, with a focus on fish & seafood inspired by the Western Isles.
venues.address: 31 Kensington Park Rd, London W11 2EU, UK

reviews.text:
I was keen to try the famous 10-per-day burger. Made the reservation for midday, when they open, but arrived at 11:45 and sat outside. A queue formed around me, and it definitely consisted of more than 10 people.

All staff members I encountered were so friendly and helpful. Really impressed me, from front of house to wait staff.

Beautiful environment, I liked the calming colour scheme and decor very much. Comfortable seating, and nice bathrooms also.

I did manage to get the burger (which I overheard had sold out, and when I checked my watch it was 12:08pm!) and it was really good. Simple, quality, wholesome. It was juicy, and so messy to eat. So flavoursome. Had no idea how to eat it so I made a right mess of it, but no shame here. I can’t bring myself to call it the best burger I’ve ever eaten; something is holding me back from that, but I can’t tell you what. Because I ate quite slowly, maybe it was that the lightly toasted bun dried out a little by the time I ate the second half.

I ordered a side of fries, this was a step too far for me. I would have been satisfied without these, I’m not sure if my appetite is small or normal though so I speak for myself. The fries were really good, but quite expensive compared to the burger.

Bill came to £36, this included - burger, fries, still water, a fresh lemon iced tea and service charge.

On a Sunday the street parking is free. I found a space a few minutes / short walk away. I imagine on all other days it’s either expensive or tricky to find a space.

I am a big foodie and bar seeker when on holiday.  Saw Doves burger that they only make 10 of per day online and made a reservation for when they open at 5:30. Let me say it did NOT disappoint.  My boyfriend and i agree that was the best burger we have ever had.  We also had an appetizer that was like a mini pizza that was delicious.  Staff completely friendly and fast service.  Def a must when you visit London.
Fantastic birthday dinner for my wife in the private dining room! Food was delicious and certainly best burger in London! Excellent wines and very reasonably priced. Can't wait to book again!

venues.name: The Barbary Notting Hill
venues.description: The Barbary Notting Hill is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.4-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, The Barbary Notting Hill provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.

reviews.text: We had the best experience at The Barbary Notting Hill! We tried everything and every single dish was full of flavor and beautifully prepared. The atmosphere is vibrant and stylish, and you can really feel the energy from the open kitchen. The service was absolutely amazing, friendly, attentive, and made the evening feel special from start to finish. Highly recommend for anyone looking for delicious food, great vibes, and outstanding hospitality. We’ll definitely be coming back!

Absolutely scrumptious meal. The service was excellent from the start. I particularly enjoyed the 7 Spice Lamb Rib, the Coffee Rub Chicken & the Orange wine to wash it down. I also loved the extra effort by the whole team when they signed a birthday card for me. Will definitely be back.

We recently stopped in for a martini and a light lunch at The Barbary Notting Hill, and the experience did not disappoint. We were greeted by the friendly head chef, who works behind the open fire grill, creating the most delightful smells of rich Mediterranean flavors. The light from the large windows lets in the busy city outside without the noise, and the architecture is modern and beautiful. The cherry and sumac sorbet was a great way to finish the meal. We will return and add The Barbary to our "favorites" list.

venues.image_alt: The Barbary Notting Hill — international restaurant in Central London

venues.name: Cocotte Notting Hill
venues.description: Welcoming, rustic corner spot serving French, spit-roasted chicken, sides & more, to stay or go.

reviews.text: I had a lovely dining experience at Cocotte! The delicious chicken and side orders were great. Our waitress was not only lovely but also super helpful, making our visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this place for a delightful chicken meal!

The atmosphere is cozy and stylish, and the food was flavorful and beautifully presented. The Full Cocotte brunch was delicious with a generous portion, and the beans and egg combo was perfect. Also had great dessert options! A special shoutout to Yara, who was incredibly helpful and made the experience even better. Can’t wait to come back!

Oh yeah. Decent and tasty food place in a lovely area. We found it spontaneously. And pretty happy with the service. The setup you can see in the photo - is enough for two people ;) while you might want to order more

venues.name: Portobello Garden Arcade Italian Restaurant
venues.description: Hideaway, market eatery serving pasta & other traditional Italian dishes, in a bright, cozy setting.

reviews.text: The food was great and the service was super friendly. My family and I were in London on vacation and we had a great meal here. I ordered the pasta in truffle cream sauce and it was delicious. My wife got the sea bass and my oldest daughter got the bollenesse and they were both great. This place has a really neat vibe. It's kinda tucked away off the road. We loved it!

Absolutely fantastic.

This is one of the best Italian restaurant in London. Please do not hesitate to try it when you are there as all the dishes as really and truly amazing

Visited Portobello Garden Arcade Italian Restaurant on a Saturday evening around 7pm. It was busy, and the only available table was outside. Unfortunately, the spot we were seated at turned out to be directly in front of their food store entrance, so we were asked to move our chairs three times during our meal. It was quite distracting and definitely took away from the dining experience.

On a positive note, the food was freshly made and cooked al dente, which may not be to everyone’s taste depending on the dish. I’d personally recommend going for one of the baked dishes over the regular pasta options — they seemed to work better texture-wise.

Overall, while the setting has potential and the food was decent, the experience felt a little disorganised. Would consider giving it another try, but hopefully with a better table next time.

venues.name: LUMI Camden
venues.description: LUMI Camden is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.7-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, LUMI Camden provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.address: 82 Camden High St, London NW1 0LT, UK

reviews.text:
Impeccable service - they went above and beyond to ensure we had the booth so we were comfortable with a toddler. Staff were hospitable and happy which is a rarity these days.
Had the Chicken and waffles (majority of the menu is all halal too), pancakes and french toast - all came hot, quickly and tasted great. Chicken and waffles were crispy, not overly sweet or sickly.
Pancakes were very soft and fluffy.

Makel was friendly and ensured we had a great visit.

Would definitely be visiting again!

Excellent little restaurant! The food was beautiful and delicious (we had the granola and the eggs Benedict) and the vibe was great. Everyone was friendly and we were seated quickly even though there was a queue. I’ll come back next time I’m in town.

Absolutely loved this brunch spot. The pancakes were soft and fluffy with strawberries, bananas and rich pistachio sauce. The chicken and waffles were crispy on the outside and tender inside, perfectly paired with egg and sauce. The juices were beautiful and refreshing. The place has a cozy vibe with greenery and rustic brick walls, perfect for a relaxing and photo-friendly morning.

venues.name: The Blues Kitchen Camden
venues.description: Dedicated blues bar serving hickory-smoked comfort food, plus regular live music & DJs.
venues.address: 111-113 Camden High St, London NW1 7JN, UK

reviews.text:
I was welcomed by the lovely girl named Helen who searched for a table for me and seated me while I was still waiting for my partner.
The atmosphere was amazing, great vibe and music.
The decor is very cool and unique even inside the rest rooms.
The food was good.
We had two burgers- vegan and beef with extra bacon.
My vegan one was good but could have had more vegetables inside. It was just like piece of salad and pickle. Could be something more.
In general very good experience.
The staff was great, we were looked after.
Thanks .

Food was delicious 😋 enjoyed the tuna starter & squid. Unfortunately the chicken wings were dry for me. We had burgers as mains, nice portion took some home. The dessert was a  dark chocolate ganache with honeycomb. Strangely served in a drinking glass - nice, rich but small portion.
Venue was gorgeous inside, unfortunately not enough staff, despite going up to pay I was told I had to await a server - that took age's!!.
As part of First table.

First time coming here, but definitely won’t be my last. The food was absolutely DELICIOUS and affordable prices, and had a live band. I got the chicken burger with mac and cheese and it was definitely a hit! 😍😍I went on Tuesday and was able to get the £6 Tuesday tequila and tried margarita for the first time😍. I want to also thank my lovely waitress Sadie, I believe she said she was new, but she was  the BEST host all night and made sure we were taken care of every time. She made us try the lovely Oreo doughnuts which is DIE for. She has also made me a tequila fan from her recommendations. I will definitely be visiting again and hope to see Sadie’s lovely smile. Thank you for making my anniversary more enjoyable🤩

venues.image_alt: The Blues Kitchen Camden — international restaurant in Camden

venues.name: Frida Camden
venues.description: Mexican & Spanish cuisine in a rustic, cantina-style space with colorful chairs & patterned tiles.
venues.address: 40 Camden High St, London NW1 0JH, UK

reviews.text:
Frida Camden is an absolute gem for anyone craving authentic Mexican cuisine. The flavors are bold yet balanced, with every dish feeling like it’s made with care and tradition. The menu celebrates the richness of Mexican food while keeping everything fresh and vibrant, making each bite a real treat. Whether you’re indulging in tacos, enchiladas, or one of their specialties, the food feels both comforting and exciting—easily some of the best Mexican fare around.

What truly sets Frida Camden apart is their salsa. It’s not just a side—it’s an experience on its own. The traditional recipe bursts with freshness, the right amount of spice, and that homemade touch that’s hard to find elsewhere. Paired with warm, crisp tortilla chips, it’s the perfect way to start a meal and sets the tone for the flavorful journey ahead. For those who love genuine Mexican flavors, this spot is a must-visit.

I passed by Frida one month ago. I was attracted by its decoration. Today my friend asked me do you have any new restaurant want to explore? I said I have one! So we are here! We ordered spicy beef nachos and Chicken Fajitas , passion fruit and mango Margaritas! Absolutely delicious!!!! I highly recommend!

Table for 5 booked for 5pm on a Saturday evening. It wasn't too busy when we arrived and they were expecting our arrival which was nice.
Service was great and food arrived promptly. Good vegan and veggie options too. We really enjoyed the experienceand we left full. We're looking forward to coming back here. It might be our new favourite place in Camden

venues.image_alt: Frida Camden — international restaurant in Camden

venues.name: Mildreds Camden
venues.description: Mildreds Camden is a international restaurant located in London. With a 4.6-star rating, this establishment offers an authentic dining experience in the heart of London. The venue combines quality ingredients with traditional cooking methods to deliver memorable meals. Whether you're seeking a casual dinner or special celebration, Mildreds Camden provides a welcoming atmosphere for all occasions. Perfect for those looking to explore genuine international flavors in a comfortable setting.
venues.vicinity: The Glass Bldg, 9 Jamestown Rd, London

reviews.text:
Mildreds Camden is an absolute must-visit for any foodie, vegan or not. The menu is a vibrant and imaginative celebration of plant-based cuisine, proving that vegan food can be full of depth and excitement. It’s no wonder we found ourselves returning for a second day in a row.

Each dish was a journey, and together they made for a dining experience that is, without a doubt, among the top vegan restaurants globally.

Camden branch—first time there and was…
Camden branch—first time there and was really looking forward to the whole experience of a vegan restaurant. My partner wanted to treat me to a meal.

The starter was disappointing: corn ribs that were basically just slices of corn on the cob dumped in a bland sauce. Quite poor. My partner had the dumplings, which were nice—I wish I’d ordered those instead.

The main was better: a Korean chick+n burger that tasted surprisingly like real chicken. The fries were nothing special. My partner had the curry, which was okay but not earth-shattering.

For dessert, my partner had the cheesecake, which was nothing to shout about. At that point, I didn’t want anything else.

But what really ruined the experience was the service—it was awful, to the point of being non-existent.

Most customers had to get up to ask for the bill or order extra drinks during their meal. It took ages for plates to be cleared between courses or for drinks to arrive.

They weren’t short-staffed, but the team—including the manager—seemed completely oblivious to the fact they had customers. They stood around chatting and walked past people clearly trying to get their attention to order, get drinks, or pay.

If this is how the chain is run, then this particular branch is definitely the weak link.

I even them leave a take on the counter getting for 10minutes before the courier turned to take it. So you know that gonna cold.

I cannot see me and my partner returning.

And it was overpriced.
Date of experience: 10 August 2025

Absolutely delicious food, one of the best roasts I've had in a while. The cocktail menu is creative and the chamomile peach old fashioned was delicious, refreshing and not too sweet. Staff were really friendly and attentive and the atmosphere was very chilled (aside from one screaming child but that's not the restaurants fault). The restaurant itself is clean and open and very easy to locate. Id definitely recommend and can't wait to visit again!

venues.name: La Patagonia
venues.description: Exposed-brick, barrio-style setting featuring hearty homestyle Argentinian cuisine.
venues.address: 31 Camden High St, London NW1 7JE, UK

reviews.text: This is such a hidden gem in Camden. The restaurant is very intimate which makes it perfect for date night. We had a party of 6 and all of our food came out just the way we ordered. All the Steak was cooked to perfection. The waiter was extremely attentive. Highly recommend.

Went here on a Saturday. My friend chose the place and I generally like Argentinian.

First, service was exemplary. Especially with my friend’s daughter. Lovely chap.

Onto the food.

Chicken Empanadas - not bad. OK portion size.

Ribeye steak - not bad. Reasonably well cooked. Flavour a bit lacking.

Lomo - the fillet steak that just tasted average. The peppercorn sauce was decent.

Fries - good, can’t mess these up really.

Creamed spinach - bland. Didn’t really enjoy it. Need more flavour, herbs.

Overall it was…not bad. That is to say, not good either. Rather pricey given the quality.

Would I return? No.

What a great place to eat, we were a party of 4 and one of out party was from Argentina so I wanted an authentic experience which we got! The owner has their own range of Malbec which goes superbly with the various cuts of meat cooked to perfection!  If you love steak, you definitely have to visit this place!

venues.image_alt: La Patagonia — international restaurant in Camden

venues.name: Laz @Camden
venues.description: Brick-lined walls & mid-century lighting in a relaxed setting with Turkish small & shared plates.

reviews.text:
We visited Laz in Camden and, at first, everything seemed lovely. The restaurant itself is small, warm, and very welcoming. The environment feels cosy and inviting, the mezes and sides were delicious, the drinks were great, and the live music was okay — it added a nice atmosphere to the evening.
However, our experience was unfortunately spoiled by the service. The older waiter kept coming back and forth to our table, repeatedly trying to push us to order more food even though we already had plenty of mezes and sides. He told us that if we didn’t order mains, we would be charged £50 per person — something that wasn’t mentioned anywhere on the menu or by anyone else.
In the end, they didn’t actually charge us that amount, so it was clearly false information used to pressure us into ordering more. This made us feel uncomfortable and unwelcome, and we decided to leave.
It’s a shame, because the food and atmosphere were both really nice, but the service left a very negative impression.

I love this place! It’s the first time I come here and I have to say it’s a bit different compared to other Turkish restaurants and also a bit expensive however worth every penny! The food was so delicious, the staff, the ambience there also was live music! We had such a beautiful evening I would highly recommend to anyone wanting to try authentic Turkish experience in London and I am sure I will go back again!!!

Incredible food! Accompanied by excellent service.

Ayse, was our waitress who could not do enough for us. My family and I were spoiled for choice on cuisine.

We attended on a busy Saturday afternoon, but service was quick. I cannot recommend highly enough.

venues.name: Alexander The Great Restaurant
venues.description: Classical statues and indoor vines line this lively taverna-style restaurant for classic Greek food.

reviews.text:
I’ve had a good amount of Greek food in the UK, but this one will have a special place on my palette!!
The Kleftiko, oh the Kleftiko!!!
Flavour. Tender. Perfection.
Trust me, you have to have this.
I also had Taramasalata, Dolmades, Halloumi and king Prawn.
Shout out to Vasili; really great guy. Such wonderful customer service.

You will have no regret trying this restaurant..you can come back and tell me otherwise.

There’s a reason this is our Deliveroo go-to.

Great quality and reasonably priced Cantonese roast meats in a box. No nonsense and always excellent quality.

If you visit their hole-in-the wall you’ll see the sheer volume of deliveries they are constantly churning out. The turnover is astonishing - that’s not by chance.

I ordered hainanese chicken rice and that is so good. Chicken meat is tender and nice, cook to the perfection. Rice is full with fragrance, and the ginger sauce is just superb. Will definitely give it a try again when I visit London next time

I tried their crispy pork belly and rice, the star of the show was the crispy outside of the pork and the soft inside of the pork belly it’s sensational!!! Highly recommended for those who loveee their pork! Additionally their beef brisket mooli lo mein was out of the world as well, with the beef just melting in your mouth! Both the dishes are a solid 10/10! Coming from Singapore where I was raised eating these food, I have to say that it’s as close to authentic as possible for bomb ass Cantonese food! Please come down to try and support them! Can’t wait to come and try some more food in their menu!

reviews.text:
Lively Greek restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating. Authentic and varied menu, good options for vegetarians.

The food was all delicious - you can taste the olive oil and lemon, and it was freshly prepared.

The service was very good, and they don’t rush you. They were helpful and friendly.

I would return to try other things on the menu!

They have set menus as well which seem good.

We went here for a cross-generational family lunch on a Sunday and we had a great time. The food was delicious and everyone in our party was very happy. The staff were friendly and helpful and the prices were very reasonable for the area. Definitely recommended! Reserve a table.

wonderful restaurant! a popular spot in the neighborhood but not touristy. been here a few times in the last year and it’s great every time. service is wonderful and the employees are very nice. they give you a shot of amaretto at the end too. seafood is delicious.

reviews.text:
Yesterday my friend, her one-year-old daughter and I decided to try this restaurant after reading the very positive reviews. Unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing.
First of all, it is presented as an Italian restaurant, but run by non-Italians. That already felt a bit unusual, but we decided to give it a chance anyway.
When we entered, there was no greeting at all – just “Are you the one who asked for the high chair?” while pointing at a bar stool, not even a proper high chair. The restaurant itself is extremely small; we didn’t even know where to place the stroller.
After sitting for more than 10–15 minutes, I had to get up myself to order because no one came to take it. The waiter, while setting our table, simply handed us things as if we were supposed to do it ourselves.
We ordered two gnocchi with seafood, focaccia and garlic bread as starters, and a simple pasta with tomato sauce for the baby. Instead of starters, the main dishes arrived first. To make things worse, the baby’s “simple pasta” came with pancetta and pepper – basically an amatriciana, which is completely inappropriate for a one-year-old.
The gnocchi had no flavour at all. My friend sent hers back, while I ate mine just to avoid wasting more time waiting for food. The seafood tasted of poor quality, and I ended up with stomach pain all evening.
We cancelled the focaccia and garlic bread, since starters should be served before the main course – not after. After the disappointing dishes, it didn’t feel worth spending more money there.
Honestly, there was nothing authentically Italian about this place. The waiter mentioned the owner is Italian, but that doesn’t mean much if the staff in the kitchen and on the floor don’t know what they’re doing. The service was unfriendly, the food tasteless, and overall it was a terrible experience.
We will definitely not be returning.

Pasta was delicious. Portions maybe a bit small. We can recommend the Cabonara.
Wine selection is also very good.

In sum a good dining experience.

We had a very bad experience at this restaurant. We went at 21:30 and my pasta was reheated and it was not good at all, I was not even able to eat it. My partner pasta was better but it was definitely not worth 25£ a pasta with peas and mushroom.

The focaccia we had was nice indeed and the olives as well.

The reviews did look good that is why we went but I would definitely do not recommend and would not go back.

I left yesterday feeling a little disappointed with my experience here. I had brought my friends here thinking it was going to be a good dinner however I was a bit let down by some of the meals brought to us. One of my friends food choice was cold when brought to her, my friends ordered lemonade and all our drinks came but theirs so they had to go up to realise their drinks were left on the side and when they had it, of course it was flat. Smashed burger was a little dry and the wings were more bones than actual meat. The restaurant itself was quite pretty inside and location wise ideal but sadly food was not.

Came here for a bottomless brunch twice now and had a great time both times. The variety of food is good and portions are filling. Lots of drinks choices and all prepared in a timely manner. Staff are always nice.

You can find vegan and vegetarian options. It’s a bit costly. Breakfast for two can cost you £30 pounds easily.

Ordered Cilbur (Turkish Eggs) and it was absolutely divine! Also had the full English breakfast, and it was fairly decent as well. But oh my goodness, the Turkish eggs were to die for and I wish we would have ordered those exclusively. Very friendly staff members

Four days in London and we've been in Elephant's five times! Four delicious breakfasts and one coffee to go🧋 The menu is very wide – from sandwiches, omelets and toasts through English and international breakfast to the set you can combine yourself. And even the variety is so big, everything was super fresh, tasty and well-prepared😋 Staff was super nice and I recommend to check the garden in the back. Highly recommended!🌟

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant. First week of opening but you wouldn’t have known as everything was so slick. Food was some of the best I’ve ever had. Highly recommend

Such a great spot! The pizza crust was crispy and light, the pasta was packed with flavor, and everything tasted so fresh. The staff were friendly and made great recommendations. You can tell they really care about quality here. Five stars all the way!

A different Italian!
My husband booked this place for my birthday dinner. He kept it as a surprise. The restaurant is within few metres of Canary Wharf tube station.
Upon arrival we received a warm welcome. I received a birthday card signed by the squad of the restaurant. That was quite unique. I liked it!
The interior is impressive, nice decor and the lights - all give it a posh look.
For starter we ordered normal bread and garlic bread. With the first bite of each, I felt like it's completely different than any of them I have ever tasted. It was so good!
For the mains, my first choice was not available, hence I went with the sea bass option "Branzino in Guazzetto". I was sceptical with the thought of tomato sauce being too tangy. When it arrived and I took the first taste, I felt like I have never tasted a sauce like that before. It was tastebud-awakening! So delicious!
My husband had the pizza "Some Like It Hot", that was quite different tasting as well. It was slightly on hot side as it says.
They don't have a kids menu but we went with the recommended one "Spaghettoni al Ragù di Agnellowhich". It was perfect for the little one.
For the dessert we went for Creme Brulee, that came with a candle on top 😊
The service was superb throughout.
Altogether it was an amazing dining experience and a perfect birthday meal! Thank you!

reviews.text:
The restaurant is beautifully decorated with a stylish and elegant atmosphere, perfect for both gatherings and special occasions. The food was quite good overall. The ice cream with mixed berries was refreshing, though the berries themselves were quite sour. The shepherd’s pie was flavorful and satisfying, definitely a highlight of the meal. The pumpkin soup had a rich and creamy taste, very enjoyable.

A lovely dining experience with great ambiance and good food.

We (my wife and I) visited this restaurant at about 9.30 on a Saturday morning and it was very quiet so difficult to gauge atmosphere.  The decor of the restaurant was lovely although some of the furniture was starting to show signs of wear and tear. The staff were all lovely and the food was good and less expensive than one might think for such a location.  I felt the sausage and the black pudding lacked some seasoning although I appreciate that's personal taste and others would find them ok. All in all a good breakfast experience although I probably wouldn't rush back for breakfast.

I had such an amazing time at Ivy Restaurant last night! From start to finish, everything was just perfect. The Tempura Prawns were super crispy and full of flavour, and the Moroccan Chicken was honestly one of the best dishes I’ve had in a long time — so juicy and well seasoned!

The ambience was lovely too — I really liked the cosy yet elegant décor, which made the whole place feel welcoming and special. It’s the kind of spot where you can relax, enjoy your meal, and just have a good time.

A big shoutout to Osman for his excellent service! He was so attentive, had great timing, and really made us laugh throughout the evening. It’s rare to find staff who make the experience feel so personal and fun.

Overall, I’d definitely recommend Ivy to anyone looking for great food, a lovely atmosphere, and friendly service. Can’t wait to go back!

A restaurant that truly delivers on both food and service.

I really liked Brother Marcus!
The staff were really lovely. We asked for Marcus's Choice, and the experience was great. Food kept coming, so we were both so full, and they kept asking if we wanted more or anything specific.
The food was all delicious, I'd especially recommend the aubergine because I've never had them cooked like that before.
I'd definitely recommend!

This place is great for dinner. The atmosphere is lovely. Soheil was very friendly and gave us recommendations. The food was really good, good portion, very delicious - I would recommend the rips & dips and the crispy aubergine skewer. Definitely will come back

I had an amazing experience at COCO in Canary Wharf. From the moment we walked in, everything felt spotless and welcoming ! the place was absolutely clean and beautifully maintained. The service was truly five-star: attentive, friendly, and professional. We never felt like anything was missing, because everything we could possibly need was already taken care of.

It’s rare to find a restaurant where cleanliness, atmosphere, and service all come together so perfectly, but this one really exceeded my expectations. I left genuinely impressed and very happy with the whole experience. Definitely a place I would recommend to anyone visiting Canary Wharf!

Had such a great night at Coco Shisha in Canary Wharf! 🔥

The staff were super friendly, especially Naz and Tutul – they were amazing at helping us choose dishes and made the whole experience smooth and fun

We had the lamb chops, and honestly… wow.
So juicy, tender and packed with flavour – highly recommend!

Tried the *Sunrise Glow* drink too – it's a refreshing, alcohol-free twist on a spritz 🍹✨ Perfect if you're skipping booze but still want something fun.

And the shisha? Absolutely on point 💨 — smooth, flavourful, and beautifully presented. Definitely one of the best in London.

Great vibes, great people, great food — can’t wait to go back!

Had such a cute and relaxing evening at Coco in Canary Wharf! The place has a really nice atmosphere — chilled but still stylish, perfect for an evening out with friends 💫

A huge thank you to Naz and Tutul who were so lovely and helpful! They guided us through the menu and made some great suggestions 💕

I tried the *chicken bao* and it was so delicious — soft, flavourful and just the right amount of spice. And don’t even get me started on the cheesecake… light, creamy and honestly the perfect dessert 🍰✨

For drinks, I went with the Sunrise Glow — it’s a non-alcoholic spritz and it was so refreshing and pretty! Loved that there’s a fun alcohol-free option that still feels special 🍹

We also had shisha and it was amazing — smooth, full of flavour, and beautifully presented 💨

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)
Dinner at Blacklock Canary Wharf – Tuesday Evening

I went for dinner at Blacklock Canary Wharf with a friend on Tuesday evening, and we had a lovely time. I ordered a well-done steak (that’s how we eat it where I come from), with gravy, sweet potatoes, kale with parmesan, and ice cream for dessert, along with a glass of red wine.

The food was excellent. The steak was a bit chewy, as you’d expect from well-done, but still full of flavour. Everything else, especially the sides and dessert, was absolutely delicious. The staff were amazing throughout; very friendly and attentive, though I didn’t catch the name of the person who served us.

The only slightly disappointing moment was when we were asked to give up our table after two hours, not rudely, but simply because of their policy. To be honest, it’s a sign of how much we were enjoying ourselves that we didn’t want to leave! We would have happily stayed for another round of drinks.

Overall, a great evening with excellent food, warm service, and a vibrant atmosphere. I’d definitely go back — maybe I’ll just book a longer slot next time!

Absolutely delicious Sunday roast—the meats were full of flavor, and the gravy was simply outstanding. The only reason it’s not five stars is the portion size: despite looking large, about 80% of the plate was vegetables, leaving the actual amount of meat underwhelming. For two people, the portion for three is ideal.

For dessert, we had the white chocolate cheesecake, and it was pure heaven. Unlike the roast, a single portion of dessert was more than enough for two people.

12 out of 10.
10 for the food — from starters and steaks to desserts, they consistently surprised us. Highly recommend the pork’s head on toast, triple-cooked chips, broccoli and walnut salad, prime rib, white chocolate cheesecake, and mango sorbet (alright — that’s nearly everything we ordered!).

An extra 2 points for the friendly and attentive service. Thank you to the lovely Jess and Ryan — their recommendations were spot on.

We really enjoyed it! Definitely recommend!

venues.description: Industrial chic decor, an upbeat vibe & eclectic global cooking served all day in a hip hub.

reviews.text: Our server was attentive and helpful. The restaurant has an everyday elegance type of vibe. Uptempo music playing at the right volume. The beans were just not right. Plain baked beans would have been just fine.

We visited Caravan in Canary Wharf and had a lovely experience! The pizza was fresh and flavourful with a perfectly crispy base – simple but delicious. The real star for us, though, was the spiced cauliflower – beautifully seasoned, warm, and comforting with just the right kick of spice.

The atmosphere was vibrant yet relaxed, with a stylish interior and friendly staff. It’s a great spot whether you’re catching up with friends or looking for a cosy dinner in the city.

Would definitely come back to try more of the menu. 🌿🍕✨

Absolutely phenomenal! From the moment we stepped into the restaurant, we were greeted with warm smiles and a genuinely welcoming atmosphere that immediately set the tone for an unforgettable dining experience.

Let’s talk food — the pizza was nothing short of brilliant. Perfectly blistered crust, rich tomato sauce, and toppings that tasted like they were handpicked in an Italian countryside that morning. Every bite was a little celebration. You can tell the chefs take serious pride in their craft.

And the tiramisu? Divine. Creamy, delicate, with just the right balance of espresso and sweetness — it was the kind of dessert that makes you close your eyes for a second and just savor. Easily one of the best I’ve had anywhere.

But what truly elevated the whole experience was the staff. Attentive without being intrusive, genuinely passionate about the menu, and full of great recommendations. They made us feel like regulars, even though it was our first visit.

This is one of those rare places where everything just clicks. We left already planning our next visit. Highly, highly recommended!

venues.image_alt: Caravan Canary Wharf Restaurant — international restaurant in Central London

venues.description: Prime cuts of matured beef, seafood & other British classics served in striking environs.

reviews.text: I’ve been to Hawksmoor in Dublin and London a couple of times and always love the food and customer service. Our visit to Hawksmoor Wood Wharf yesterday was no different. The bone marrow with onion was a fantastic starter, and the steaks were good even without the sauces. The creamed spinach and garlic mushrooms were great sides. We enjoyed the meal with red wine and finished it with ice cream and sorbet. Good food, great customer service, and reasonable prices.

Came here for my birthday with my husband. We tried Sunday roast and it did not disappoint. For starters, we had the bone marrow and it was good especially with cracked salt on sourdough bread. We had the rump roast beef (Sunday roast), I ordered mine pink and my husband well done. Mine was so tender, melts in your mouth experience. It had a nice portion of fat which I really liked. They also granted our request for extra gravy. Delicious food.

The staff are all very friendly and accommodating.  The atmosphere great. Location impeccable. Their toilet facilities well maintained, clean which is really important.

They gave me a complimentary sorbet with candle as it was my birthday, really thoughtful touch. Thank you Hawksmoor for the amazing experience.

Rib eye cooked to perfection - medium rare spot on. Sirloin was also delicious.
Starters were great too: Bone Marrow & Caesar salad.
Peanut butter shortbread dessert was the icing on the cake. Yummy!

The Market Halls was also a peaceful place to sit and relax 💯

We had the sausage, egg & cheese sandwich and bacon, egg & cheese sandwich. Both were delicious. The truffle hash browns were hot and crispy. Prices are a bit on the high side but quality is good. Plenty of seating inside with a coffee bar and bagel bar nearby. Service was friendly and speedy.

Stopped by Eggslut in Canary Wharf this morning after seeing the name and some pics online – and wow, it was amazing. Hands down the best breakfast sandwich we’ve had in ages. Super flavorful and just hit the spot.

The hashbrowns (got mine without truffle) were crispy and perfectly fried. Staff were friendly and on it. Honestly, everything just worked. Already thinking about when we can go back.

reviews.text: I had an exceptional evening here! The food and drinks were spot on, and the service was simply outstanding—our server greeted us warmly and knew the menu inside out, which made choosing our meals a breeze. The vibes in the place were perfect, and everything was spotless. I really appreciated how the team checked in on us and even recommended dessert—it was such a nice touch. I can’t wait to come back!

I usually challenge such expensive restaurants as I believe it is difficult to justify such amount of money for one meal... yet Gaucho deserves a 5 star.

They have it all. The location at Canary Wharf might not be ideal, yet it is right in front of the river with amazing view over centtal London skyline, so a plus already for terrace sitting if weathwr allows.
Next is service. Perfect. Polite, attentive, not intrusive yet always there whenever you need something.
Finally the food. We went for Gaucho's classic: Argentinian meet. We took different cuts and ALL of the were cooked according to each one request, from filete to ribeye steaks, different sizes and some marinated. All amazing.

We went for Argentinian malvec... quite overpriced yet very good.

All together in a cosy place.

Just excellent experience end-to-end.

Illustration: 400 ribeye steak for 52£

Labels: 2eat, $$$$, #Argentinian, #romantic, #privees, #terrace, #views, #must Go

I visited recently and had an exceptional experience, thanks to the team's top-notch service and their excellent menu knowledge. The food and drinks were absolutely delightful, and the atmosphere made it even better. While I felt the prices were a bit on the high side, the quality of what I had definitely justified it. Overall, I walked away with a full stomach and a big smile, thanks to the warm greetings and thoughtful recommendations throughout my visit. I'll definitely be returning!

reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised. Probably the best pasta aribratta dish I've ever had. Good cocktail and service. Friends equally enjoyed their pasta dishes. Highly recommended.

I’ve been here twice and  it was over a year apart. The food quality remains so high. From starter to dessert everything I’ve ever ordered has been so insanely tasty. Just need the option of a boat load of Parmesan for those who want it😂 staff was friendly and attentive

Decent Italian Spot with Room for Improvement

We had dinner here on a Wednesday night, and while the experience was overall okay, it felt like something was missing.

The service was fine—servers were friendly and happy to recommend dishes, but we weren’t given water, which is a basic expectation. We ordered three starters (see pictures) and two pasta mains. The pasta was delicious, well-priced, and definitely the highlight of the meal, though the menu had fewer options than expected. Sometimes, less is more, but a bit more variety would have been nice.

The drinks menu was somewhat limited—there was a good wine selection, but only a few beer choices. The restaurant wasn’t very busy, which made for a relaxed atmosphere. However, the space isn’t wheelchair or stroller-friendly due to the steps, which could be a downside for some diners.

One issue was that we were mistakenly charged for an item we didn’t order, though the staff did make up for it by offering a small takeaway tiramisu.

Given its prime location in the heart of Canary Wharf, this place has the potential to be a top Italian dining spot. With a few tweaks—better accessibility, more menu variety, and attention to small service details—it could truly stand out.

reviews.text: I loved this place. Best vegan Sunday roast I’ve ever had. The mushroom was to die for. The veg and gravy were so tasty. The portion side perfect. Yes it’s pretty expensive I guess £30 a head for main meal but actually I’d go again. The cocktail were generous and strong which I liked. As an older person ( I’m 67 )  I often feel a bit invisible in modern restaurants-slightly ignored. Not here, staff seemed keen to engage and not in a patronising way at all. We felt welcomed , well served and left with a warm feeling of being cared about. Thank you all x

I recently had the pleasure of dining at one of my favorite restaurants in Canary Wharf.

The staff was attentive without being intrusive, ensuring that all our needs were met with promptness and a smile! Every dish we tried was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. The ingredients tasted fresh and high-quality.

Overall, it's a perfect combination of fantastic service and delicious food.
I highly recommend this restaurant.

To begin with i am a big fan of Fallow the youtube channel and ive also dined with my girlfriend at Fallow in December last year. I feel I may have ate here on a day where only the Junior staff were working or i just was not that important cause it all felt very basic. I have been looking forward to this meal for months. The first dish I ordered was the blooming onion and it looked stunning and tasted really yummy but towards the bottom end I felt like there was a lot of oil which did not seem like it was drained out well. The next dish I ordered was the grilled octopus and it was really salty and I hoped for less salt as I ate all of it but it left a bad taste it my mouth. I also conveyed this message to the staff when he asked for feedback. The last savoury dish I ordered was the mortadella flatbread and it lacked a bit of a punchy flavour from the parmesan cheese or may be it was the octopus that changed the taste in my mouth. The banana parfait and the ice tea were the best dishes I ate. I felt the service team needed to be more friendly as i did not feel that. I feel the next time I visit such establishments I need to have a guest with me and only then I will get the respect i need cause it all fell flat. The Ambience of the restaurant is great but will only return to Fallow and definitely not here.

reviews.text: We were looking forward to this place for a while and heard/read all the reviews about this restaurant. It did not disappoint. The moment we walked through the doors, we knew this would be an authentic Indian experience. Hussain (manager) and Monica (waitress) went above and beyond to deliver an exceptional service. They were attentive, very knowledgeable about the food and helpful. The dishes served were 10/10 and the portion sizes were perfect. I would highly x 2 recommend this restaurant for a date night, meet-up,  a group gathering or any occasion. This place delivered and the chefs done good!

Overall amazing! Truly cannot fault a single thing we were served. The service was just so lovely and inviting, the food was some of the best south Asian I’ve had that Is not authentically home made!
I’m so gutted I didn’t take pictures of the ruby biryani and the mutton curry, because they were faultless We just couldn’t wait to dig in!
Those prawns were honestly spectacular! Spicy and just the perfect grill. Think it was by far the best on the menu.

There’s nothing that I didn’t like about this place. The food was amazing. The lamb chops were out of the world. Okra fries (5)are a must. Chicken ruby(5) was amazing. Daal (4.5)was great too. Naans were thin and yum. The paneer roomali roll was great roo (4.5/5)
Our server Massimo was amazing too

reviews.text: It looks like an Italian restaurant in appearance however when I heard a Turkish song playing one day, I realized that the owner is Turkish. Overall, it’s a nice place to go and enjoy food as well as drinks. I tried many dishes there including chicken and pasta and drinks like wine and signature cocktails. They were all amazing. It’s located in a nice and central place, close to my home. Staff is so kind and nice. The view is amazing, looking through the Isle of Dogs. A bit pricey but it is worth it. Highly recommended!

Beautiful Italian restaurant in Canary Wharf. It was relatively busy on a Saturday night; therefore quite loud with the large groups - buts it’s to be expected I suppose. The location itself is stunning, with street parking available nearby. The restaurant is large, spacious, and beautifully decorated – I absolutely love the colour scheme and overall design.

It’s quite rare to find authentic halal Italian, so this really is a gem, even though I went for vegetarian options. All of food was delicious, fresh ingredients, presented well, excellent quality, and the portions are absolutely huge. Not cheap but definitely worth the money.

The service was excellent, with very attentive and friendly waiters. It’s definitely a place I’d recommend and one I’d happily return to. I might even make it one of my regular spots whenever I’m craving Italian.

I also can’t wait for the weather to warm up again so I can sit outside as I love al fresco dining, and this would be the perfect place for it.

Overall, an excellent restaurant in every way.

An outstanding experience from start to finish at Capeesh
My recent visit to Capeesh Bar and Restaurant in Canary Wharf was absolutely fantastic. Everything, from the moment we arrived to the moment we left, was simply exceptional. It's safe to say that this is one of the best Italian dining experiences you can have in London, and I will definitely be returning.
The atmosphere is a perfect blend of modern elegance and welcoming warmth. The chic decor features contemporary lighting and stylish, comfortable furniture, creating a vibrant yet intimate space. We were a large group of 12 and had a fantastic table, with the restaurant offering plenty of great options for both inside dining and outside on the lovely terrace. It's a versatile space perfect for any occasion.
The food was beyond delicious, with each dish being a standout. The menu offers a great choice for all tastes, and the generous portion sizes mean you certainly won't leave hungry. Our table enjoyed a variety of dishes, and everyone raved about the quality, freshness, and authentic Italian flavours. The restaurant's commitment to using quality ingredients really shines through.
To complement our meal, we took full advantage of the excellent 2-for-1 cocktail offer. The cocktails were perfectly mixed and a delightful addition to an already superb afternoon/evening.
What truly elevated our experience, however, was the impeccable service from our waiter, Kumar. He was outstanding throughout the afternoon, effortlessly looking after our large table of 12 with a positive attitude and without any issues. He was consistently attentive, friendly, and always there when we needed something. The service was a masterclass in hospitality.
For anyone looking for an outstanding meal in a beautiful setting with an exceptional team, look no further. I strongly recommend Capeesh Bar and Restaurant and look forward to my next visit!

reviews.text: My visit at Gallio was fantastic. From the attentive staff, to the refreshing bubbles and the delicious plates. We had a vegetarian shawarma with 4 sides and everything was so flavourful and fragrant. We especially loved the cheesy flatbread and the fatoush salad. We would definitely come back for another dinner here! 5 stars!

Me & my friend had a great experience at GALLIO! We went for the bottomless pizza and it was absolutely delicious. Starters were amazing & the bottomless prosecco was great! The mocktails were refreshing and beautifully presented. The service was very friendly and attentive. Perfect place for a tasty meal with great vibes. Highly recommend & we will come again!

The food was amazing! We’re still thinking about the sharing platter — full of flavour and perfect for mixing and matching. The pizzas were light, crispy and delicious, and the girls loved finishing off with the chocolate gelato. The whole place had a relaxed but stylish vibe, great for both families and couples. A lovely spot for an easy, high-quality meal with great service and even better food.
